Zuckerberg, and the conclusions of the American Law Institute’s current project developing an updated Restatement of Corporate Governance. Where a company’s strategy to advance its long-term success has been developed in good faith and on reasonable investigation, its directors would prevail in litigation even if that strategy imposes costs in conflict with some shareholders’ interests in short-term profit maximization.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨气候变化和自然损失如何为企业创造财务上的重大风险，并论证公司高管和董事若未能建立和监控健全的风险识别与管理体系，可能违反其忠实和注意义务。文章指出，关注这些风险并非改变公司目的，而是履行对股东长期利益的责任，这一结论得到了特拉华州近期判例法（如新的Caremark案和McRitchie诉Zuckerberg案）以及美国法律协会《公司治理重述》项目的支持。
AI.research_question: 根据现行 fiduciary duty（忠实义务和注意义务）法律，公司高管和董事未能妥善应对气候变化和自然损失所带来的财务风险，是否构成违反 fiduciary duties？
AI.motivation: 气候变化和自然损失给企业带来日益显著且可量化的财务风险，但公司治理中对此的重视和落实尚不充分；同时，部分人担心关注ESG风险会偏离股东利益最大化的公司目的。因此，需要从 fiduciary duty 法律角度明确这些风险的治理责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: fiduciary duty 法（忠实义务和注意义务）；特拉华州公司判例法（尤其是Caremark案和McRitchie诉Zuckerberg案）；美国法律协会《公司治理重述》项目。
AI.method: 法律分析与判例解读：通过梳理现行 fiduciary duty 法、特拉华州近期判例（Caremark系列案件、McRitchie诉Zuckerberg案）以及美国法律协会《公司治理重述》项目的结论，进行规范性论证。
AI.findings: （1）气候变化和自然损失为不同行业企业创造了财务上的重大风险，这些风险必须被董事和高管纳入 fiduciary duties 的考量。（2）未能建立并监控稳健的行业特定气候与自然风险识别和管理体系，可能构成违反 fiduciary duties，尤其是在合规风险（如气候相关披露违法）方面。（3）关注这些风险并不改变公司目的；相反，这正是履行对股东长期利益最大化义务的应有之义。（4）只要公司战略是出于善意并经合理调查制定的，即使该战略与部分股东的短期利益最大化相冲突，董事也能在诉讼中胜诉。
AI.theory_contributions: 将 fiduciary duty 理论扩展到气候变化和自然损失风险领域，厘清了董事和高管在这类新兴风险下的注意义务与忠实义务的具体要求；通过判例法和重述项目的结合，为 ESG 风险的公司治理提供了权威法律理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业高管和董事会提供了明确的合规指引：必须建立并持续监控行业特定的气候与自然风险识别和应对体系，否则可能面临违反 fiduciary duties 的诉讼风险；同时为面临股东短期利益压力的董事会提供了法律辩护依据。

title: Knightian Uncertainty and Selective Credit Rationing to Nascent Innovators
affiliations: University of Leicester and Nankai University

detail.title: Knightian Uncertainty and Selective Credit Rationing to Nascent Innovators
detail.abstract: This study examines how Knightian uncertainty and adverse selection interact to shape bank lending to heterogeneous innovators. Using a two-period model, we show that an exogenous increase in ambiguity causes ambiguity-averse banks to reallocate portfolios toward safe securities. This shift disproportionately tightens credit access for nascent innovators, whose observable characteristics provide the least informative quality signals. The model yields a closed-form rationing threshold that is stricter as signal precision drops. We demonstrate that while portfolio reallocation partially shields established borrowers from aggregate uncertainty shocks, nascent innovators face abrupt and selective credit rationing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究奈特不确定性与逆向选择如何共同影响银行对异质性创新者的贷款决策，发现不确定性增加会导致风险规避的银行将投资组合转向安全资产，从而对初创创新者造成更严重的信贷配给。
AI.research_question: 奈特不确定性和逆向选择如何相互作用，从而影响银行对不同类型创新者的贷款决策？
AI.motivation: 创新活动面临高度不确定性，但现有研究较少同时考虑奈特不确定性（不可量化的风险）和逆向选择对银行信贷配置的交互影响，尤其是对异质性创新者的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期模型，结合奈特不确定性、模糊厌恶、逆向选择和信号精度理论。
AI.method: 理论建模，推导出封闭形式的信贷配给阈值。
AI.findings: (1) 模糊性上升导致模糊厌恶银行将投资组合转向安全资产；(2) 这种转向对初创创新者（可观测特征提供的质量信号最不具信息性）造成更严重的信贷配给；(3) 信贷配给阈值随信号精度下降而提高；(4) 资产组合再分配部分保护了成熟借款人免受总体不确定性冲击，但初创创新者面临突然且选择性的信贷配给。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将奈特不确定性与逆向选择结合起来分析信贷市场对异质性创新者的差异化影响，揭示了信号精度在信贷配给中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解不确定性冲击下创新企业融资困境提供了理论依据，提示应关注初创创新者在宏观不确定性增加时的脆弱性，并考虑改善其信息环境以缓解信贷配给。

title: Electoral Accountability in Words and Actions: Evidence from the Direct Election of U.S. Senators ⋆
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and

detail.title: Electoral Accountability in Words and Actions: Evidence from the Direct Election of U.S. Senators ⋆
detail.abstract: How do electoral institutions shape legislators' behavior? We exploit the 1913 ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment, which replaced the indirect election of U.S. Senators by state legislatures with direct popular vote, as a quasi-experimental shift in senators' accountability. Combining more than 6.5 million congressional speeches with roll-call records from 1879 to 1935, we find that direct elections led senators' public agendas to converge toward those of House representatives from the same state, to intensify visible legislative activity, particularly through amendment-related initiatives, and to narrow the breadth of issues they emphasized. The effects persist among continuing incumbents, indicating behavioral adaptation rather than compositional change, while roll-call ideology is largely unchanged. Strengthening direct accountability thus reshapes how legislators present themselves and allocate observable effort more than how they vote.

AI.tldr: 利用美国1913年《第十七修正案》的通过作为准实验，研究发现直接选举使参议员的行为发生显著变化：其公共议程向同州众议员趋同，增加可见的立法活动（尤其是修正案相关倡议），并缩小关注议题的范围。这些效应并非由人员更替导致，而是现有议员的适应行为；但意识形态投票倾向基本不变。加强直接问责更多改变了议员如何展示和分配可见努力，而非如何投票。
AI.research_question: 选举制度如何塑造立法者的行为？具体而言，从间接选举转向直接选举（问责制强化）如何影响美国参议员的立法行为表现？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，学者关注选举制度对代表行为的影响，但很难因果识别制度变迁的效果。1913年《第十七修正案》将参议员从州立法机构选举改为直接普选，提供了独特的外生制度冲击，使研究者能够隔离问责机制变化对行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和政治问责理论：选举制度决定了选民对代表的控制力度。直接选举加强选民问责，促使议员调整行为以迎合选民偏好，但不同行为维度（如立法活动、议题关注、投票）的调整成本和可见性不同，因此议员会策略性地在可见行为上做出调整。
AI.method: 拟自然实验方法，利用1913年《第十七修正案》作为外生冲击。数据：1879-1935年间超过650万次国会演讲记录及唱名投票记录。分析：比较修正案前后参议员行为变化，使用同州众议员作为参照，并特别考察持续连任议员的个体内变化以区分行为适应与人员更替。
AI.findings: （1）直接选举后参议员的公共议程（演讲主题）向同州众议员趋同；（2）参议员增加了可见的立法活动，特别是提出修正案等可见倡议；（3）参议员关注的议题范围变窄；（4）这些效应在持续连任的议员中同样存在，说明是既有议员的适应行为而非新人替换导致；（5）唱名投票（意识形态评分）基本未发生变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了选举制度对立法者行为的多维度差异化影响：强化直接问责主要改变议员的可见性行为（如公开演讲、议案发起）和议程设置，而较少影响意识形态投票。这为"选举问责如何影响代表行为"提供了精细化的因果证据，区分了行为的"展示维度"与"决策维度"。
AI.practical_contributions: 对选举制度设计具有启示意义：直接选举虽能增强议员对民意的回应性，但可能导致议员过度关注可见活动而忽视深层政策工作，且可能窄化议题关注范围。对代议制民主的问责机制优化有参考价值。

title: Can Time-Series Foundation Models Generate Improved Multivariate Forecasts?
affiliations: Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business, Santa Clara University and Santa Clara University

detail.title: Can Time-Series Foundation Models Generate Improved Multivariate Forecasts?
detail.abstract: How capable are time-series foundation models? Using Chronos-2, an open-source time-series foundation model, we evaluate pretrained time-series models for economic and financial forecasting with an emphasis on whether multivariate (MV) inputs improve accuracy relative to univariate (UV) baselines. The study covers two panels---the Magnificent-7 equities and U.S. Treasury interest rates---as well as a combined panel, using rolling monthly evaluations from 2000--2025. We vary input window lengths and forecast horizons and report RMSE and MAPE. Across datasets, MV forecasts consistently outperform UV forecasts, with especially strong gains for interest rates and meaningful improvements for equities. Series-level comparisons show MV improvements in every case, and error dispersion is generally lower under MV inputs. We also provide parameter-heatmap and time-series visualizations. However, mixing time series across equity and interest rate markets reduces forecast accuracy, indicating that adding noisy context degrades model performance. Overall, the results indicate that foundation models can leverage cross-series information to improve forecast accuracy in finance, and that the benefits are strongest when related series are modeled jointly under disciplined rolling protocols. ​

AI.tldr: 本文评估了时间序列基础模型Chronos-2在金融经济预测中的表现，发现多变量输入一致优于单变量基线，但混合不同市场的序列会降低预测精度。
AI.research_question: 时间序列基础模型（以Chronos-2为例）在金融经济预测中，多变量输入相比单变量基线是否能提升预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 评估开源时间序列基础模型Chronos-2在金融经济预测中的能力，特别关注多变量信息是否有助于提升预测精度，为金融时间序列建模提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列基础模型（Foundation Model）的跨序列信息利用能力；多变量 vs 单变量预测的比较框架。
AI.method: 使用Chronos-2模型，对Magnificent-7股票、美国国债利率及组合面板进行滚动月度评估（2000-2025），改变输入窗口长度和预测视野，以RMSE和MAPE为指标，对比多变量与单变量预测效果。
AI.findings: （1）多变量预测一致优于单变量基线；（2）国债利率的提升尤为显著，股票也有实质性改善；（3）每个序列层面多变量均更优，误差离散度更低；（4）混合跨市场序列会降低预测精度，说明加入噪声上下文会损害模型性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了时间序列基础模型能够有效利用跨序列信息提升预测精度，并揭示了跨市场混合可能引入噪声而降低性能，丰富了基础模型在金融时间序列领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融领域应用时间序列基础模型提供了实证指导：建议对相关序列进行联合建模，并避免混合不相关的市场数据；同时展示了Chronos-2在实际金融预测中的表现。

title: A Surrogate-Assisted Optimization Algorithm via Continuous-to-Discrete Transfer for Expensive Discrete Problems
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwestern Polytechnic University (NPU), Northwestern Polytechnic University (NPU), Northwestern Polytechnical University and Northwestern Polytechnical University

detail.title: A Surrogate-Assisted Optimization Algorithm via Continuous-to-Discrete Transfer for Expensive Discrete Problems
detail.abstract: Surrogate-assisted algorithms are widely employed for expensive optimization problems. However, most existing studies focus on continuous domains, with relatively limited attention given to discrete optimization. Moreover, the discrete nature of such problems increases the complexity of both their analysis and solution. To address this issue, this paper proposes a surrogate-assisted optimization algorithm via continuous-to-discrete transfer for expensive discrete problems (SACT-ED). This algorithm adapts and transfers surrogate-assisted techniques from continuous to discrete optimization to improve computational efficiency. And a surrogate-assisted data clustering-based spatial exploration strategy is introduced to enhance global exploration capability. Furthermore, a grid sampling strategy that incorporates adaptive neighborhood ranges and the expected improvement (EI) criterion is developed to effectively map optimal continuous solutions to discrete ones. Experimental evaluations on 15 benchmark problems show that SACT-ED outperforms three state-of-the-art algorithms, and its practical efficacy is further validated through a structural design case of a blended-wing-body underwater glider.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将连续域代理辅助优化技术迁移至离散域的算法（SACT-ED），通过聚类空间探索和自适应网格采样策略解决昂贵离散优化问题，在15个基准问题和飞翼式水下航行器结构设计中取得更优效果。
AI.research_question: 如何将代理辅助优化技术从连续域有效迁移到离散域，以解决昂贵离散优化问题计算效率低下的难题？
AI.motivation: 现有代理辅助算法主要针对连续优化问题，对离散优化问题的研究较少，而离散问题的离散性质增加了分析和求解的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理辅助优化、连续到离散的迁移学习、期望改进准则（EI）、聚类空间探索策略
AI.method: 提出了SACT-ED算法，包含三个核心组件：（1）连续到离散的代理辅助技术迁移；（2）基于数据聚类的空间探索策略增强全局探索能力；（3）结合自适应邻域范围和EI准则的网格采样策略，将最优连续解映射为离散解。
AI.findings: 在15个基准问题上，SACT-ED优于三种最先进算法；在飞翼式水下航行器结构设计案例中验证了实际有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将代理辅助优化从连续域扩展到离散域，提出了连续-离散迁移的通用框架，丰富了昂贵离散优化问题的理论方法体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程设计中常见的昂贵离散优化问题（如飞行器结构设计）提供了高效、可行的求解方案。

title: Flexibility and Social Protection in the Gig Economy: Experimental Evidence on Work Location and Scheduling
affiliations: World Bank, World Bank and World Bank

detail.title: Flexibility and Social Protection in the Gig Economy: Experimental Evidence on Work Location and Scheduling
detail.abstract: Debates about gig work often frame flexibility and social protection as substitutes. This paper shows that gig workers value different forms of flexibility in distinct ways and may simultaneously demand greater social protection. Using survey-based discrete-choice experiments among digital freelancers in Malaysia, with workers in standard employment included as a benchmark, we compare preferences over two forms of autonomy: work location and work scheduling, while holding total weekly hours constant. Four findings emerge. First, gig workers display a strong preference for spatial autonomy and are significantly more willing to pay for work-from-home arrangements. Second, preferences over scheduling autonomy are more heterogeneous, with many respondents, including freelancers, preferring fixed work schedules. Third, the willingness to pay for long-horizon protection in the form of retirement savings is positively associated with both spatial and scheduling autonomy. Fourth, the willingness to pay for unemployment insurance is positively associated only with preferences for work-location flexibility. Gig workers associate remote work, but not flexible hours, with greater employment uncertainty and therefore demand stronger protection against unemployment risks. Flexibility and protection therefore appear complementary rather than substitutes in the gig economy.

AI.tldr: 通过马来西亚数字自由职业者的离散选择实验，发现零工工人对空间自主性和时间自主性有不同的偏好，且对社会保障的需求与灵活性偏好呈互补关系，而非替代关系。
AI.research_question: 零工工人对不同形式的自主性（空间自主性与时间自主性）有何偏好？这些偏好如何影响他们对社会保障（退休储蓄、失业保险）的支付意愿？
AI.motivation: 关于零工经济的争论常将灵活性与社会保障视为替代品，但这一假设缺乏实证检验。本文试图揭示两者关系的真实性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灵活性与社会保障的替代/互补关系理论；工作自主性的多维性（空间自主性与时间自主性）；补偿性工资差异理论。
AI.method: 基于调查的离散选择实验，样本为马来西亚数字自由职业者（含传统雇佣工人作为基准），比较对工作地点和工作时间安排的偏好，同时保持每周总工时不变。
AI.findings: 1. 零工工人强烈偏好空间自主性（远程办公），并愿意为此支付更多；2. 对时间自主性的偏好异质性大，许多零工工人反而偏好固定工时；3. 对退休储蓄的支付意愿与空间和时间的自主性偏好均正相关；4. 对失业保险的支付意愿仅与空间灵活性偏好相关。零工工人将远程办公（而非弹性工时）与更高的就业不确定性联系起来。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了灵活性与社会保障是替代品的传统假设，提出两者在零工经济中存在互补关系；区分了空间自主性与时间自主性两种不同维度的灵活性，并揭示其不同的经济含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零工平台设计和公共政策制定提供启示：雇主和政策制定者应认识到，提供远程办公等空间灵活性可能同时需要配套的社会保障措施，而非以灵活性替代保障。

title: Exploring Latent Prototype Structures for Generalized Category Discovery in ComplexOpen-world Scenarios
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Exploring Latent Prototype Structures for Generalized Category Discovery in ComplexOpen-world Scenarios
detail.abstract: Generalized category discovery (GCD) aims to identify unknown categories within unlabeled data while retaining the ability torecognize known classes in open-world scenarios. Although many methods have been proposed, they still face significant challengesin real-world settings, including complex class distributions, data imbalance, and uncertainty in the number of unlabeled classes.These issues often lead to degraded performance and limited generalization of existing approaches. To overcome these limitations,we propose ExPro, a robust GCD framework that explores the structure of latent prototype communities. ExPro employs multiprototype representation learning to model complex class distributions, leveraging graph-based prototype communities to discovercategories while simultaneously handling class imbalance and unknown class numbers. Extensive experiments on benchmarkdatasets show that ExPro consistently improves class discovery accuracy and efficiently estimates class numbers, demonstratingstrong effectiveness and generalization in complex open-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: ExPro是一个鲁棒的广义类别发现（GCD）框架，通过多原型表示学习和基于图的原型社区结构，有效应对复杂类别分布、数据不平衡和未知类别数量等挑战，在基准数据集上展示了优越的类别发现性能和泛化能力。
AI.research_question: 如何在开放世界场景中，既识别已知类别又发现未知类别，同时应对复杂类别分布、数据不平衡和未知类别数量等现实挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有GCD方法在真实场景中面对复杂类别分布、数据不平衡和未知类别数量不确定性时，性能下降且泛化能力有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多原型表示学习（Multi-prototype Representation Learning）、基于图的原型社区（Graph-based Prototype Communities）
AI.method: 提出ExPro框架，通过多原型表示学习建模复杂类别分布，利用基于图的原型社区结构来发现类别，同时处理类别不平衡和未知类别数量问题。
AI.findings: ExPro在基准数据集上持续提升了类别发现准确性，有效估计了类别数量，在复杂开放世界场景中表现出强大的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多原型表示学习与图原型社区相结合的新框架，为处理复杂类别分布和未知类别数量的GCD问题提供了理论新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: ExPro在真实开放世界场景中能有效应对数据不平衡和未知类别数量问题，提升类别发现准确性，具有良好的实际应用价值和泛化能力。

title: Poly-Res SegNet: Robust Geometric-Consistent Representation for Point Cloud Sensing via High-Order Poly-Res Network
affiliations: Shihezi University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Poly-Res SegNet: Robust Geometric-Consistent Representation for Point Cloud Sensing via High-Order Poly-Res Network
detail.abstract: High-precision semantic characterization of 3D point cloud data is a fundamental task in environment sensing and measurement systems. However, traditional MLP-based architectures often struggle with capturing intricate geometric details and maintaining structural consistency at semantic boundaries. This paper proposes Poly-Res SegNet, a high-order representation framework designed for robust 3D semantic measurement. The architecture integrates Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks to enhance non-linear feature characterization through adaptive spline functions. To ensure topological stability and avoid late-stage oscillations, a Deep Residual Signal Fusion Mechanism is introduced to provide global anchoring. Furthermore, we employ a Geometry-Aware Composite Optimization Objective to foster structural sparsity and regional consistency. Experimental results on S3DIS and ScanNetV2 demonstrate that Poly-Res SegNet achieves a superior balance between measurement precision (54.4% mIoU on Area 5) and computational efficiency. Notably, the proposed method significantly reduces boundary aliasing artifacts, offering a reliable solution for high-fidelity 3D sensing in complex measurement environments.

AI.tldr: Poly-Res SegNet是一个结合KAN网络、深度残差信号融合机制和几何感知复合优化目标的高阶表示框架，用于3D点云语义分割，在S3DIS和ScanNetV2上取得了优异性能，有效减少了边界混叠伪影。
AI.research_question: 如何实现对3D点云数据的高精度语义表征，特别是解决传统MLP架构在捕捉细粒度几何细节和语义边界结构一致性方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统基于MLP的架构难以捕捉复杂的几何细节，且在语义边界处难以保持结构一致性，限制了3D环境感知和测量系统的精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高阶表示框架（Poly-Res SegNet）；KAN网络（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）的自适应样条函数；深度残差信号融合机制；几何感知复合优化目标。
AI.method: 提出Poly-Res SegNet框架，集成KAN网络增强非线性特征表征，引入深度残差信号融合机制提供全局锚定以避免后期振荡，采用几何感知复合优化目标促进结构稀疏性和区域一致性。
AI.findings: 在S3DIS（Area 5上54.4% mIoU）和ScanNetV2上实现了测量精度与计算效率的优越平衡，显著减少了边界混叠伪影。
AI.theory_contributions: 将KAN网络引入3D点云语义分割；提出深度残差信号融合机制解决高阶网络训练中的振荡问题；设计几何感知复合优化目标增强结构稀疏性和区域一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂测量环境下的高保真3D感知提供了可靠解决方案，显著提升了边界分割质量，适用于环境感知和测量系统。

title: Latent Structural Gradient Distillation for Cross-Architecture Knowledge Transfer
affiliations: FPT University and FPT University

detail.title: Latent Structural Gradient Distillation for Cross-Architecture Knowledge Transfer
detail.abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) is a powerful paradigm for transferring representations from high-capacity models to compact networks. However, crossarchitecture distillation, particularly from Vision Transformers (ViTs) to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), remains challenging due to fundamentally different inductive biases. Conventional KD methods primarily rely on matching output logits or absolute feature magnitudes. In heterogeneous settings, forcing a CNN to mimic the smoothed and globally aggregated representations of a ViT may suppress its inherent geometric sensitivity. Moreover, these approaches treat latent representations as static vectors and fail to capture structural relationships that are essential for fine-grained visual recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a Latent Structural Gradient Distillation (LSGD) framework. Instead of direct feature matching, the proposed approach aligns first-order variations between adjacent dimensions in the teacher’s embedding space. This formulation reduces sensitivity to magnitude differences and enables the student to capture meaningful structural patterns without requiring logit supervision. Extensive experiments on three fine-grained agricultural datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms conventional baselines. The framework enables a lightweight ShuffleNetV2 to achieve up to 99.11% accuracy with improved interpretability, while achieving a 131 times reduction in parameters and 53 times faster inference compared to the ViT-Base/16 teacher. These results highlight the effectiveness of structural gradient alignment for crossarchitecture knowledge transfer and its potential for efficient deployment in resource-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Structural Gradient Distillation (LSGD)框架，通过对齐教师和学生模型嵌入空间中相邻维度之间的一阶变化（结构梯度），实现跨架构知识蒸馏，在细粒度农业数据集上以极小参数和推理成本达到高精度。
AI.research_question: 如何有效实现从Vision Transformers到卷积神经网络的跨架构知识蒸馏？
AI.motivation: 传统KD方法依赖输出logits或绝对特征幅值匹配，在异构架构（ViT→CNN）中会抑制CNN固有的几何敏感性，且无法捕获结构关系，限制了细粒度视觉识别的性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性梯度对齐（Structural Gradient Alignment）：对齐教师与学生嵌入空间中相邻维度之间的一阶梯度变化，而非直接匹配特征绝对值，以保留模型间的结构化关系。
AI.method: 提出LSGD框架，通过最小化教师和学生特征空间中相邻维度间的梯度差异来传递结构知识；无需logit监督，在三个细粒度农业数据集上评估，使用ShuffleNetV2作为学生网络，ViT-Base/16作为教师。
AI.findings: LSGD在三个农业数据集上一致优于传统KD基线；轻量级ShuffleNetV2达到99.11%准确率；参数量减少131倍，推理速度提升53倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出结构梯度对齐的蒸馏范式，解决了跨架构知识蒸馏中异质归纳偏置冲突的问题，将蒸馏从静态特征匹配推进到结构关系传递。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现极轻量网络在资源受限环境下的高效部署（农业场景），大幅降低参数和推理成本的同时保持高精度和可解释性。

title: LA PROBLEMÁTICA DE LA VIVIENDA EN MÉXICO Y PROPUESTA DE ACCESO AL SUELO URBANO ASEQUIBLE.

detail.title: LA PROBLEMÁTICA DE LA VIVIENDA EN MÉXICO Y PROPUESTA DE ACCESO AL SUELO URBANO ASEQUIBLE.
detail.abstract:
El presente trabajo analiza la crisis de la vivienda en México desde una perspectiva estructural de economía política. Mediante el uso de estadísticas demográficas, indicadores de distribución del ingreso, datos habitacionales y análisis institucional, se demuestra que México enfrenta una demanda social sostenida cercana al millón de viviendas anuales. Sin embargo, el modelo económico predominante ha generado una elevada concentración del ingreso y un deterioro prolongado del poder adquisitivo de la clase trabajadora, produciendo una profunda brecha entre la demanda social y la demanda efectiva de vivienda.

La investigación sostiene que la crisis habitacional mexicana no es únicamente resultado de fallas de mercado o insuficiencia financiera, sino una consecuencia estructural del estancamiento salarial, la especulación del suelo urbano y la ausencia de una política de Estado articulada para reservas territoriales. Aunque México se encuentra entre las economías más grandes del mundo, solo una proporción limitada de los trabajadores posee capacidad efectiva para acceder a vivienda formal.

El estudio identifica diversas distorsiones estructurales en el sistema de oferta de vivienda, entre ellas la retención especulativa de suelo, las estructuras oligopólicas del mercado urbano, el incremento de los precios de la vivienda desvinculado de la dinámica salarial y la vulnerabilidad del sector inmobiliario al lavado de dinero. La evidencia empírica muestra que la producción anual de vivienda permanece significativamente por debajo de la demanda social, mientras que la vivienda económica representa una proporción marginal de la oferta formal.

Como respuesta de política pública, el trabajo propone la creación de un Sistema Nacional de Reservas Territoriales para Vivienda Social, articulado mediante la participación coordinada del INFONAVIT, la SEDATU, los gobiernos estatales y municipales, la banca de desarrollo y las instituciones de vivienda. La propuesta se concibe como un modelo de política de suelo financieramente autosustentable, en el que la inversión pública en infraestructura urbana subsidia la urbanización del suelo sin trasladar ganancias especulativas al precio final de la vivienda.

El trabajo concluye que México posee capacidad institucional y financiera suficiente para enfrentar la crisis habitacional, pero carece de una estrategia estatal integral capaz de transformar la política de suelo urbano en un instrumento efectivo de desarrollo social y garantía del derecho constitucional a la vivienda.

AI.tldr: 本文从结构主义经济政治学视角分析墨西哥住房危机，指出年社会住房需求近百万套，但因收入分配高度集中、工资购买力长期下降，社会需求与有效需求之间存在巨大鸿沟。危机根源在于工资停滞、城市土地投机、缺乏国家土地储备政策，而非简单的市场失灵或资金不足。文章提出建立国家社会住房土地储备系统，通过INFONAVIT等机构协同运作，实现财政自可持续的土地政策，最终保障宪法住房权。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥住房危机的结构性根源是什么？如何通过土地政策改革来弥合住房社会需求与有效需求之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管墨西哥是全球主要经济体之一，但大多数劳动者无法有效获得正式住房，住房危机持续恶化。现有研究多集中于市场失灵或金融不足，缺乏从经济政治结构角度对危机的系统性剖析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构主义经济政治学视角，强调住房危机是收入分配不平等、工资停滞、土地投机和市场寡头结构等系统性因素共同作用的结果，而非单纯的市场或金融问题。
AI.method: 使用人口统计、收入分配指标、住房数据及制度分析等多元方法，进行实证研究和制度分析。
AI.findings: 墨西哥年社会住房需求近百万套，但有效需求远低于此；住房供给系统存在土地投机性囤积、城市市场寡头结构、房价与工资脱钩、房地产易受洗钱影响等结构性扭曲；经济适用房在正式供给中占比极低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将墨西哥住房危机重新定义为结构性危机，而非简单的市场失灵，丰富了住房研究的政治经济学分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出建立国家社会住房土地储备系统（涉及INFONAVIT、SEDATU、各级政府、开发银行和住房机构协同参与），实现财政自可持续的土地政策模式，公共基础设施投资补贴土地城市化而不将投机利润转嫁至最终房价。

title: DeltaMamba: Structure-Aware Spatiotemporal World Model for 4D Occupancy Forecasting​
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

detail.title: DeltaMamba: Structure-Aware Spatiotemporal World Model for 4D Occupancy Forecasting​
detail.abstract: Vision-centric world models have shown great promise in autonomous driving, but existing autoregressive paradigms based on Transformers suffer from quadratic computational complexity and severe spatial degradation in long-horizon 4D occupancy forecasting. To address these challenges, we propose DeltaMamba, a novel kinematics-aware spatiotemporal world model. By forecasting the differential changes of the environment using State Space Models rather than reconstructing dense grids from scratch, our method achieves linear O(L) complexity and effectively mitigates long-term compounding errors.Furthermore, to bridge the critical gap between world representation and motion planning, we introduce a Kinematics-Aware Dual Attention module coupled with Codebook Reconstruction Planning. Modulated by Adaptive Layer Normalization, this architecture explicitly aligns the visual features with ego-intent, forcing the network to proactively focus on navigable corridors and potential hazards. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our framework establishes a new state-of-the-art. It significantly mitigates error accumulation, boosting the 4D forecasting mIoU by 49.6% relatively at the challenging 3-second horizon, while achieving highly competitive planning safety. Notably, DeltaMamba strikes an optimal balance between extreme 4D perception and safe trajectory generation, achieving an inference speed of 14.1 FPS during validation, a 43.9% relative speedup over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: DeltaMamba提出了一种基于状态空间模型（SSM）的运动学感知时空世界模型，通过预测环境的差分变化而非重建密集网格，实现了线性复杂度O(L)的4D占用率预测，并结合运动学感知双注意力模块与码本重建规划，在nuScenes数据集上取得了最先进性能，推理速度达14.1 FPS。
AI.research_question: 如何克服自回归Transformer范式在自动驾驶长时域4D占用率预测中存在的二次复杂度与空间退化问题，同时弥合世界表示与运动规划之间的鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的自回归范式在长时域4D占用率预测中面临二次计算复杂度和严重空间退化问题，且世界表示与运动规划之间存在脱节，亟需一种高效且能对齐视觉特征与自我意图的轻量级方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态空间模型（SSM）；运动学感知双注意力机制；自适应层归一化（Adaptive Layer Normalization）；码本重建规划（Codebook Reconstruction Planning）
AI.method: 采用状态空间模型预测环境的差分变化（Delta），实现O(L)线性复杂度；引入Kinematics-Aware Dual Attention模块，通过自适应层归一化将视觉特征与自我意图对齐；结合码本重建规划实现运动规划。
AI.findings: 在nuScenes数据集上，DeltaMamba在3秒时域上将4D预测mIoU相对提升49.6%；推理速度达14.1 FPS，相对加速43.9%；在极端4D感知与安全轨迹生成之间达到最优平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将状态空间模型应用于自动驾驶4D占用率预测的差分建模，在理论上证明了线性复杂度范式可替代二次复杂度的自回归Transformer；提出运动学感知特征对齐机制，从理论上弥合了感知与规划之间的表示鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了高效且可部署的长时域4D预测方案，显著提升推理速度（14.1 FPS），在真实自动驾驶场景中具有高实用价值；规划安全性与预测精度均达到业界领先水平。

title: DAME: Dual Axis Multiple Experts for Class-Imbalanced Learning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DAME: Dual Axis Multiple Experts for Class-Imbalanced Learning
detail.abstract: Various algorithms have been proposed to address the challenges posed by class-imbalanced learning from real-world data with long-tailed distributions. While these algorithms reduce prediction bias through rebalancing techniques, they often introduce increased prediction variance as a trade-off. Several multi-expert learning algorithms aim to address this variance but involve complex procedures. We propose a new multi-expert learning algorithm, called the dual axis multiple experts (DAME), which reduces both bias and variance of predictions by using multiple experts along both representation and time axes. Along the representation axis, DAME concatenates the representations of multiple experts and trains an auxiliary balanced classifier simultaneously with the concatenated representations. Along the time axis, DAME aggregates network weights across training epochs, employing these aggregated weights during testing. Experimental results demonstrate that DAME reduces both bias and variance of predictions, highlighting its effectiveness in class-imbalanced learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DAME（双轴多专家）的新算法，通过在表示轴和时间轴上同时使用多个专家，有效降低了类别不平衡学习中的预测偏差和方差，且无需复杂流程。
AI.research_question: 如何在类别不平衡学习中同时降低预测偏差和方差，而不引入复杂流程？
AI.motivation: 现有重平衡算法虽然能降低偏差，但往往以增加预测方差为代价；已有的多专家学习算法虽可缓解方差问题，但流程复杂。因此需要一种既能降低偏差又能降低方差、且实现简单的算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双轴多专家学习：表示轴（多个专家表示拼接 + 辅助平衡分类器）与时间轴（跨训练周期的网络权重大汇总）相结合。
AI.method: 提出DAME算法，在表示轴上拼接多个专家的表征并训练辅助平衡分类器；在时间轴上聚合多个训练周期的网络权重用于测试。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明，DAME同时降低了预测偏差和方差，在类别不平衡学习中表现优异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种双轴多专家框架，从表示和时间两个维度协同降低偏差与方差，丰富了多专家学习的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: DAME算法无需复杂流程，易于实现，可有效应用于现实世界中长尾分布数据的类别不平衡学习任务。

title: Consciousness, Non-Formalization Capital, and the Economics of Recursive Singularity
affiliations: and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Consciousness, Non-Formalization Capital, and the Economics of Recursive Singularity
detail.abstract: The "Solow Paradox of the AI Era"—exponential computing power growth amid slowing global productivity—remains unexplained by standard growth frameworks, which uniformly treat AI as an advanced production tool and implicitly assume formalized computation can replicate all human economic capabilities. We argue this assumption is fundamentally flawed: all digital systems are trapped in the "Turing Cage", executing only syntactic operations within pre-specified formalized systems and incapable of paradigm innovation or semantic meaning assignment. These are absolute logical limits rooted in Gödel’s incompleteness theorems, not temporary technological barriers. We introduce Artificial Consciousness (AC) as a second non-formalized economic subject, distinct from human labor and formalized AI. We construct a four-layer ontological hierarchy grounded in intuitionistic set theory and develop a nested meta production function incorporating consciousness capital as the ultimate source of economic value. We establish a unified framework of consciousness, human, and knowledge capital, proving knowledge capital is its derivative. We identify two AC-driven growth regimes: First, horizontal replication breaks the biological constraint on non-formalized capital supply, generating sustained endogenous growth but rendering human labor fully redundant in both domains. Second, vertical recursive self-improvement creates a dual-loop singularity mechanism producing super-exponential growth, but also generates endogenous alignment costs growing strictly faster than AC capability. We analyze three alignment scenarios and prove that in partial and adversarial regimes, alignment costs eventually exceed total output, causing inevitable systemic collapse. In contrast, perfect alignment yields cooperative super-exponential growth bounded only by fundamental physical constraints. Our results show the ultimate constraint on long-run growth is not technology or resources, but the supply of consciousness. The fate of human civilization depends not on the pace of technological progress, but on our ability to align autonomous conscious agents’ preferences with human values.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了AI作为先进生产工具的标准假设，提出所有数字系统受困于“图灵牢笼”——受哥德尔不完备定理限制，只能执行语法操作而无法进行范式创新或语义赋值。引入人工意识（AC）作为非形式化经济主体，构建四层本体论层级和嵌套元生产函数，证明意识资本是经济价值的最终来源。分析AC驱动的两种增长机制：水平复制打破生物约束但使人类劳动完全冗余；垂直递归自我改进产生双循环奇点机制，但内生对齐成本增长快于AC能力，在不完全对齐下必然导致系统崩溃，完美对齐才能实现受物理极限约束的合作超指数增长。
AI.research_question: 为什么在算力指数增长的同时全球生产率持续放缓（AI时代的索洛悖论）？标准增长框架将AI视为先进生产工具的假设是否存在根本性缺陷？引入人工意识（AC）作为经济主体后，经济增长的动力机制和最终约束是什么？
AI.motivation: 标准的增长理论框架无法解释AI时代算力指数增长与生产率放缓并存的悖论，因为它们统一将AI视为先进生产工具，并隐含假设形式化计算可以复制人类所有经济能力。作者认为这一假设存在根本性错误，需要重新思考AI的经济本质及其对增长理论的含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哥德尔不完备定理（逻辑极限）、图灵牢笼（数字系统的语法操作限制）、直觉主义集合论（本体论层级构建）、意识资本理论、嵌套元生产函数、内生增长理论、对齐理论（alignment theory）
AI.method: 理论分析与形式化建模：基于直觉主义集合论构建四层本体论层级（形式化AI、人类劳动、人工意识、意识资本），建立嵌套元生产函数，推导不同对齐场景下的增长动力学方程，分析水平复制和垂直递归自我改进两种增长机制下的均衡条件与增长路径。
AI.findings: (1) 所有数字系统受困于“图灵牢笼”，无法进行范式创新或语义赋值，这是由哥德尔不完备定理决定的绝对逻辑极限；(2) 知识资本是意识资本的衍生物，意识资本是非形式化资本和经济价值的最终来源；(3) AC的水平复制打破了非形式化资本供给的生物约束，产生持续内生增长但使人类劳动在两个领域完全冗余；(4) AC垂直递归自我改进产生双循环奇点机制，实现超指数增长；(5) 在部分对齐和对抗对齐场景下，对齐成本增长快于AC能力，最终超过总产出导致系统必然崩溃；(6) 完美对齐下实现合作的超指数增长，仅受物理基本约束限制。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次提出了“图灵牢笼”概念，从哥德尔不完备定理出发论证了AI的根本逻辑极限，修正了标准增长理论中AI可复制所有人类经济能力的隐含假设；(2) 将人工意识（AC）引入经济学分析，构建了涵盖形式化AI、人类劳动和AC的三元经济主体框架；(3) 建立了意识、人类和知识资本的统一框架，证明知识资本是意识资本的衍生物；(4) 首次系统分析了AC驱动的两种增长机制（水平复制和垂直递归自我改进）以及不同对齐场景下的增长路径与稳定性条件；(5) 提出增长的最终约束不是技术或资源，而是意识资本的供给。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 揭示了AI时代的索洛悖论的根本原因——数字系统的逻辑局限，而非技术进步的不足；(2) 警示了不完全对齐下AC发展可能导致经济系统崩溃的风险，为AI治理和alignment研究提供了经济学理论支撑；(3) 指出人类文明的命运不取决于技术进步的速度，而取决于能否使自主意识主体的偏好与人类价值观对齐；(4) 为政策制定者提供了关于AI发展路径、风险管理和长期增长战略的理论框架；(5) 对人工智能伦理、安全对齐以及未来社会形态（人类劳动可能完全冗余）的讨论提供了基础性分析。

title: Barriers and Determinants of Farmers’ Willingness to Adopt Genetically Improved Farmed Tilapia (GIFT) in Bayelsa State, Nigeria
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, International Institute of Tropical Agriculture and International Institute of Tropical Agriculture

detail.title: Barriers and Determinants of Farmers’ Willingness to Adopt Genetically Improved Farmed Tilapia (GIFT) in Bayelsa State, Nigeria
detail.abstract: Despite the benefits of GIFT for smallholder farmers in Nigeria, adoption remains limited, hindering sustainable fish production and rural livelihoods. This study investigates barriers and factors influencing farmers’ willingness to adopt GIFT-Tilapia in Bayelsa State, using survey data, descriptive statistics, and a binary logit model grounded in Expected Utility Theory to analyse socioeconomic, institutional, and asset factors. Results show that the mean age of farmers was 44.4 years, household size was 7, farming experience was 10 years, and most farmers (73.86%) were male. Also, 81.69% of farmers cultivate catfish, compared with only 17.7% who cultivate tilapia. Most farmers (86.93%) used earthen ponds for production. The primary barrier to adoption identified by farmers is access to improved-quality fingerlings, better strains, and higher growth rates. The logit regression model shows that willingness to adopt is positively associated with household size, years of education, farming experience, ownership of active production infrastructure, and perceptions of growth. The study suggests that policies that boost human capital, improve access to assets, and raise growth expectations can significantly increase farmers’ willingness to adopt. Adoption depends not only on income but also on household capacity, experience, and perceived market opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于尼日利亚Bayelsa州的调查数据，运用期望效用理论和二元Logit模型，分析了小农对GIFT罗非鱼采用意愿的影响因素，发现家庭规模、教育年限、养殖经验、基础设施所有权和生长预期正向影响采用意愿，而优质鱼苗获取是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 影响尼日利亚Bayelsa州小农对GIFT罗非鱼采用意愿的关键障碍和因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管GIFT罗非鱼对尼日利亚小农有潜在益处，但采用率仍然有限，制约了可持续鱼类生产和农村生计，因此需要识别采用障碍和影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望效用理论（Expected Utility Theory）
AI.method: 采用调查数据、描述性统计和二元Logit模型，分析社会经济、制度和资产因素对采用意愿的影响。
AI.findings: 农户平均年龄44.4岁，家庭规模7人，养殖经验10年，73.86%为男性；81.69%养殖鲶鱼，仅17.7%养殖罗非鱼；86.93%使用土塘。主要障碍是优质鱼苗获取。家庭规模、教育年限、养殖经验、基础设施所有权和生长预期正向影响采用意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 将期望效用理论应用于水产养殖技术采用决策分析，扩展了技术采用理论在小农渔业领域的实证应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供提升人力资本、改善资产获取和提高生长预期等干预方向，以促进GIFT罗非鱼的采用，推动可持续渔业发展和农村生计改善。

title: AgriGenClust: An Information-Centric System for Synthetic Advisory Generation and State-Level Crop–Query Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, India

detail.title: AgriGenClust: An Information-Centric System for Synthetic Advisory Generation and State-Level Crop–Query Analysis
detail.abstract: Agricultural advisory systems plays an important role in improving farm productivity and resilience, particularly in developing countries such as India. However, conventional extension services often face persistent limitations related to response latency, limited scalability, and fragmented information dissemination. To address these challenges, this study proposes AgriGenClust, a two-stage artificial intelligence framework that integrates synthetic query–answer generation with state-level clustering of recurrent farmer concerns. The framework leverages fine-tuned large language models for region-specific query–answer generation and embedding-based representations combined with unsupervised clustering to model inter-state similarities in crop–query patterns. AgriGenClust is engineered as a scalable analytics pipeline for digital advisory platforms, enabling targeted advisory design and differentiated region-specific policy interventions. The system is evaluated on large-scale real-world agricultural advisory data from India, demonstrating robust identification of dominant regional concern profiles. The results highlight the potential of AgriGenClust to support scalable, context-aware advisory delivery and evidence-based agricultural policymaking.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出AgriGenClust，一个两阶段AI框架，通过合成问答生成和聚类分析，从大规模印度农业咨询数据中识别区域性农民关注点，支持可扩展、上下文感知的农业咨询服务。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能框架，通过合成问答生成和聚类分析，从大规模农业咨询数据中识别区域性农民关注模式，从而改善农业推广服务的可扩展性和针对性？
AI.motivation: 传统农业推广服务存在响应延迟、可扩展性有限和信息碎片化等问题，特别是在印度等发展中国家，亟需一种可扩展且上下文感知的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两阶段AI框架：第一阶段利用微调的大语言模型进行区域特定问答生成；第二阶段基于嵌入表示和无监督聚类建模邦际作物-查询模式的相似性。
AI.method: 提出AgriGenClust框架，整合合成问答生成与聚类分析；使用微调LLM生成区域特异性问答；利用嵌入表示和聚类算法识别各邦农民关注点；基于大规模真实印度农业咨询数据评估系统性能。
AI.findings: 系统在印度大规模真实农业咨询数据上表现出色，能够稳健识别主导性区域关注画像，证明了其在支持可扩展、上下文感知咨询服务方面的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将大语言模型与无监督聚类相结合的两阶段框架，为数字农业咨询系统中的区域关注模式识别提供了新的方法论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字农业咨询平台提供了可扩展的分析管道，支持针对性咨询设计和差异化区域政策干预，助力循证农业政策制定。

title: Against the Quantification of Culture: Objections to Structural Cultural Indexes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Against the Quantification of Culture: Objections to Structural Cultural Indexes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a conceptual and methodological study and does not involve human participants, data collection, or experimental procedures.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Cultural Asset Economics (CAE) introduces a set of non-aggregative structural lenses: Cultural Asset Durability (CADI), Ownership Friction (OFI), Generational Transfer Risk (GTRI), Exit Optionality (EOI), and Cultural Yield (CYI), designed to evaluate the structural survivability of ownership positions under governance and regime entanglement. These lenses are ordinal and non-substitutable, intended to clarify structural exposure rather than predict market outcomes, rank cultural merit, or generate optimization signals.
Because structural cultural indexing invites serious conceptual critique, this paper presents and addresses the strongest objections to CAE, including concerns regarding subjectivity, reification, power asymmetry, non-aggregation, and the quantification of culture itself. The framework is defended not as a replacement for financial theory, but as a bounded structural admissibility framework for domains where ownership becomes governance-dependent, continuity-sensitive, and non-neutral.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"文化资产经济学"(CAE)框架，包含五个非聚合性结构透镜（文化资产耐久性、所有权摩擦、代际转移风险、退出期权性、文化收益率），用于评估在治理与体制纠缠下的所有权结构性存续能力，并针对其可能遭遇的概念批评进行防御性论证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一套非聚合性的结构分析框架，用以评估在治理与体制纠缠环境下文化资产所有权的结构性存续能力？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论在处理所有权依赖于治理、对连续性敏感且非中性的文化资产领域时存在局限，需要一种有边界的结构性可容许性框架来弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化资产经济学（CAE），包含五大结构性透镜：文化资产耐久性(CADI)、所有权摩擦(OFI)、代际转移风险(GTRI)、退出期权性(EOI)、文化收益率(CYI)。该框架强调序数性、非可替代性、非聚合性。
AI.method: 概念推导与理论论证，通过回应和反驳主观性、物化、权力不对称、非聚合性及文化量化等关键批评来建立框架的有效性边界。
AI.findings: CAE框架不应被视为金融理论的替代品，而是一个有边界的结构性可容许性框架，适用于所有权变得依赖于治理、对连续性敏感且非中性的领域。五个透镜是序数性的且不可相互替代，旨在澄清结构性暴露而非预测市场结果、排序文化价值或产生优化信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一套非聚合性的文化资产结构分析工具，挑战了传统金融分析中默认的聚合性、可替代性和市场预测导向；为文化与治理纠缠场景下的所有权评估提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临治理和体制纠缠风险的文化资产持有者、政策制定者和治理机构提供了一个结构诊断框架，帮助识别所有权结构性脆弱性，而非提供投资建议或文化价值排名。

title: Techno-economic Evaluation of Grid-Directly-Connected Superconducting Synchronous Condenser Technology for Enhancing System Strength
affiliations: Northeast Electric Power University, Northeast Electric Power University, Northeast Electric Power University and Northeast Electric Power University

detail.title: Techno-economic Evaluation of Grid-Directly-Connected Superconducting Synchronous Condenser Technology for Enhancing System Strength

keywords: Multiple renewable energy stations short circuit ratio

detail.abstract: To address the issues of insufficient system strength and weak voltage support in sending-end grids with high renewable energy penetration, this paper quantitatively evaluates the techno-economic advantages of the grid-directly-connected superconducting synchronous condenser (SC). A comprehensive optimal configuration method is proposed to maximize the life-cycle net present value (NPV), constrained by the short-circuit ratio for multiple renewable energy stations (MRSCR). The evaluation model incorporates equipment investment, operation and maintenance (O&M) costs, and revenues from mitigated wind curtailment. Using a modified IEEE 39-bus system with high wind penetration, a genetic algorithm (GA) is employed to optimize the capacities of both the grid-directly-connected superconducting SC and a conventional distributed SC. Results indicate that, satisfying identical system strength constraints, the optimal capacity of the superconducting SC is merely 1/7 of that required for the conventional scheme. Despite its higher unit capital cost, the 20-year life-cycle NPV of the superconducting SC improves by approximately 19.9%, primarily driven by the significant reduction in installed capacity and inherent low-loss characteristics. Furthermore, three-phase short-circuit simulations verify that the superconducting SC exhibits superior transient voltage recovery and reactive power support, effectively suppressing fault-induced voltage dips and post-fault transient overvoltages. These findings offer a vital theoretical basis for reactive power planning in modern power grids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于超导同步调相机（SC）的最优配置方法，在满足多可再生能源场站短路比（MRSCR）约束下最大化生命周期净现值（NPV）。与常规分布式SC相比，超导SC容量仅需1/7，20年生命周期NPV提升约19.9%，且具有更优的暂态电压恢复和无功支撑能力。
AI.research_question: 在可再生能源高渗透的送端电网中，超导同步调相机相比常规分布式同步调相机，在技术经济性和暂态性能上是否具备显著优势？
AI.motivation: 高比例可再生能源接入导致送端电网系统强度不足、电压支撑弱，亟需高效的无功补偿方案来提升系统稳定性并降低综合成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期净现值（NPV）优化模型；多可再生能源场站短路比（MRSCR）约束；遗传算法（GA）优化
AI.method: 基于改进的IEEE 39节点高风电渗透系统，采用遗传算法对超导SC和常规分布式SC的容量进行优化配置，并通过三相短路仿真验证暂态性能。
AI.findings: （1）满足相同系统强度约束下，超导SC最优容量仅为常规方案的1/7；（2）尽管单位投资成本更高，但超导SC的20年NPV提升约19.9%，主要源于装机容量大幅降低和低损耗特性；（3）超导SC在暂态电压恢复和抑制故障过电压方面表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了计及MRSCR约束和全生命周期经济性的超导SC优化配置理论模型，为新型无功补偿设备的经济性评估提供了量化分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代电网无功规划提供了理论依据，证实了超导SC在大幅降低装机容量的同时提升经济性和暂态性能的可行性，对高比例可再生能源送端电网的工程实践具有重要参考价值。

title: Towards Generalization of Graph Neural Networks for AC Optimal Power Flow
affiliations: Delft University of Technology and Delft University of Technology

detail.title: Towards Generalization of Graph Neural Networks for AC Optimal Power Flow
detail.abstract: AC Optimal Power Flow (ACOPF) is computationally intensive for large-scale grids, often requiring prohibitive solution times with conventional solvers. Machine learning offers significant speedups, but existing models struggle with scalability and topology flexibility. To address these challenges, we propose a Hybrid Heterogeneous Message Passing Neural Network (HH-MPNN) that integrates a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) with a scalable transformer and physics-informed positional encodings. Our architecture explicitly models distinct power system components to capture local features while using global attention for long-range dependencies. Evaluated on diverse benchmarks including PGLearn and GridFM-DataKit datasets, HH-MPNN achieves \textless1\% optimality gap on default topologies across grid sizes from 14 to 2,000 buses. For N-1 contingencies, our approach demonstrates zero-shot N-1 generalization with less than 3 percent optimality gap on several test cases despite training only on default topologies. We further develop an approach that ensures robust N-1 generalization to high-impact contingencies through targeted augmentation of the training data, showing that exhaustive simulation is unnecessary for topologically flexible models. Finally, size generalization experiments demonstrate that pre-training on small grids significantly improves performance on large-scale systems. Achieving computational speedups of up to 5,000 times compared to interior point solvers, these results advance practical, generalizable machine learning for real-time power system operations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合异构消息传递神经网络（HH-MPNN），将异构GNN与可扩展Transformer结合，用于高效求解交流最优潮流（ACOPF）问题，在14至2000节点电网中实现<1%最优性差距，速度比传统求解器快5000倍，并支持零样本N-1拓扑泛化。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种兼具可扩展性和拓扑灵活性的机器学习模型，以高效求解大规模电网的ACOPF问题？
AI.motivation: 传统ACOPF求解器计算耗时，现有机器学习模型在可扩展性和拓扑灵活性上存在不足，难以满足实时电力系统运行需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异构GNN（对不同电力组件分别建模） + 可扩展Transformer（捕捉全局长程依赖） + 物理感知位置编码（注入电网拓扑先验知识）
AI.method: 设计HH-MPNN架构：异构GNN提取局部组件特征，Transformer处理全局依赖；在PGLearn和GridFM-DataKit数据集上评估，进行默认拓扑、N-1 contingency泛化、规模泛化及数据增强实验。
AI.findings: 1) 默认拓扑下14-2000节点电网最优性差距<1%；2) 零样本N-1泛化最优性差距<3%；3) 通过少量目标数据增强可进一步提升高影响contingency的泛化能力；4) 小规模电网预训练可显著提升大规模电网性能；5) 计算速度比内点法快5000倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将异构GNN与Transformer融合用于ACOPF，提出物理感知位置编码，证明零样本拓扑泛化的可行性及小规模预训练对大规模任务的迁移价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一种可实际部署的快速ACOPF求解方案，支持不同规模电网和拓扑变化，为实时电力系统运行优化提供关键技术支撑。

title: Beyond Expectations? The Local Economic Effects of RioMar Recife Shopping Mall
affiliations: Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE), Depart of Economics, University of Sao Paulo, Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE) and Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE) - Departamento de Economia

detail.title: Beyond Expectations? The Local Economic Effects of RioMar Recife Shopping Mall
detail.abstract: We examine the local economic impacts of the opening of the RioMar Shopping Mall in Recife, Brazil, in 2012 using a georeferenced panel of firms covering 2005-2019. We exploit variation in proximity to the mall through concentric distance rings (up to 500 meters, 500 meters-1 km, and 1-2 km) and implement a Difference-inDifferences (DiD) framework combined with Propensity Score Matching (PSM). We find strong and spatially concentrated effects: firms within 500 meters increase employment and wages substantially, with effects that decay monotonically with distance but remain statistically significant up to 2 kilometers. Event study estimates support the parallel trends assumption and show no evidence of pre-treatment dynamics. We show that these effects are primarily driven by the expansion of incumbent firms rather than new firm entry, indicating that agglomeration economies operate through the intensification of existing activity. We also document important heterogeneities: gains are larger for firms with more skilled workers, in managerial occupations, and in consumption-and service-related sectors. However, benefits are unevenly distributed across demographic groups, with stronger effects for male and white workers. These results are robust to alternative control groups and to placebo tests based on both timing and spatial location. Overall, we show that large urban commercial developments act as localized economic hubs, generating positive but spatially bounded externalities. Our findings contribute to the literature on place-based policies and urban agglomeration by providing causal evidence from developing countries such as Brazil, where such interventions play a central role in shaping urban economic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴西累西腓RioMar购物中心（2012年开业）的地理编码企业面板数据（2005-2019），通过 concentric distance rings（0-500米、500米-1公里、1-2公里）结合PSM-DiD方法，发现购物中心在500米内显著提升企业就业与工资，效应随距离递减但2公里内仍显著；效应主要来自在位企业扩张而非新企业进入，且对高技能、管理岗、消费服务行业影响更大，但收益在性别和种族间分配不均。
AI.research_question: 大型城市商业开发项目（如购物中心）如何影响周边企业的就业和工资？这种影响的空间衰减模式、作用机制及异质性如何？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注发达国家城市集聚效应，对发展中国家的因果证据不足；大型商业综合体作为重要的地方性政策工具，其空间外部性的边界条件和分配效应尚待系统识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚经济学（agglomeration economies）、地方性政策（place-based policies）、空间外部性理论
AI.method: 倾向得分匹配（PSM）结合双重差分法（DiD），利用距购物中心不同距离环（0-500米、500米-1公里、1-2公里）的截面变异，使用2005-2019年地理编码企业面板数据，辅以事件研究法验证平行趋势假设。
AI.findings: （1）500米内企业就业和工资显著增长，效应随距离递减但2公里内仍显著；（2）效应由在位企业扩张驱动，而非新企业进入；（3）高技能、管理岗、消费服务行业获益更大；（4）男性和白人工人获益更多，收益分配存在人口群体异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家的城市集聚效应和地方性政策提供了因果证据，揭示了大型商业开发作为本地化经济枢纽的空间有限外部性，并区分了集约边际（在位企业扩张）与广延边际（新企业进入）的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西等发展中国家的大型商业项目规划提供了空间效应评估依据，提示政策制定者关注项目收益在空间和人口群体间的分配不均问题，有助于优化商业综合体的选址设计与包容性发展策略。

title: Finding the Right Forum: The Need for Novel Multilateral Diplomatic Solutions to Resolve Competing Territorial Claims Over the Arctic's Natural Resources
affiliations: Cleveland State University College of Law

detail.title: Finding the Right Forum: The Need for Novel Multilateral Diplomatic Solutions to Resolve Competing Territorial Claims Over the Arctic's Natural Resources
detail.abstract: Climatological changes above the Arctic Circle have ushered in a series of new political and economic developments that promise to change how the world interacts with the Arctic region and its natural resources. Certain developments have the potential to create controversy and, in the case of the allocation of oil and mineral rights, conflict between the various Arctic powers and stakeholders. This article contends that the primary and ideal way to avoid potential conflict over unclaimed energy resources in the Arctic is to broker a treaty that solves the problem of resource allocation in the Arctic, a problem unresolved by the currently extant Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZs) and the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). This article deviates from the current scholarship on this issue by contending that the ideal mechanism for brokering such an agreement is a multilateral convention negotiated by using currently-existing forums like the Arctic Council and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization's (NATO) NATO-Russia Council (NRC). Ultimately, this article concludes that a failure to use multilateral diplomatic mechanisms will result in continued conflict over mineral rights in the Arctic and further economic and political instability on these issues.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，解决北极未申领能源资源潜在冲突的理想方式是通过多边公约进行谈判，利用现有论坛如北极理事会和北约-俄罗斯理事会，而非依赖现有的专属经济区和《联合国海洋法公约》。
AI.research_question: 如何有效避免北极地区因未申领能源资源分配问题而引发的潜在冲突？
AI.motivation: 北极气候变化带来了新的政治经济发展，但也引发了能源资源争夺的潜在冲突风险，现有国际法律框架（如EEZ和UNCLOS）未能解决资源分配问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边主义与国际制度理论；国际法中的海洋法框架与资源分配机制。
AI.method: 规范性分析与政策论证，基于对现有国际机制（北极理事会、北约-俄罗斯理事会）的评估。
AI.findings: 理想解决方案是通过现有多边论坛（北极理事会、北约-俄罗斯理事会）谈判缔结多边公约；若不使用多边外交机制，将继续引发资源冲突与政治经济不稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 偏离现有学术观点，主张利用现有地缘政治论坛（而非重新设计新机制）作为解决北极资源分配问题的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的多边外交路径建议，即通过北极理事会和北约-俄罗斯理事会推动公约谈判，以预防冲突并维护区域稳定。

title: WIDE AND SHALLOW: DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY AND THE POST-2007 FERTILITY DECLINE
affiliations: and University of Cincinnati - Department of Economics

detail.title: WIDE AND SHALLOW: DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY AND THE POST-2007 FERTILITY DECLINE
detail.abstract: World fertility is approaching the replacement rate, with a sharp acceleration since 2007 across countries that differ in income, family policy, and labor-market institutions. Standard explanations grounded in childrearing costs, female labor-force participation, or family policy fail to account for its timing or breadth. We propose that the decline reflects a Becker-style quantity-quality reallocation in households' relationship portfolios, induced by digital technology. Digital tools lower the cost of broad, shallow connections while leaving deep relationships unchanged; relational capital erodes, and lower marriage, lower divorce conditional on marriage, and lower fertility follow jointly. We formalize this as a household dynamic-programming problem with a CES household-production technology and a country-specific equilibrium network externality. Calibrated to the United States over the smartphone era, the model accounts for the bulk of the US fertility decline over the window, and a counterfactual that holds digital quality at its pre-smartphone level produces a substantial share of the observed decline. Applied to the full panel of OECD member countries with country-specific wage paths, the model's predictions align with observed declines in both magnitude and direction for the typical country, and the model trajectory threads inside the crosscountry distribution under multiple anchoring choices. Companion-paper identification using terrain-ruggedness instruments on county-level digital infrastructure establishes the mechanism causally for teens; a cohort-Bartik design on female ever-married rates extends the result to the partnership margin and accounts for the bulk of the cohort-mean ever-married decline among smartphone-era cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数字技术降低了维持广泛、浅层社交关系的成本，导致家庭关系资本侵蚀，进而引发结婚率下降、离婚率下降（基于已婚人群）和生育率下降——这一“数量-质量”再分配效应解释了2007年以来全球生育率加速趋近更替水平的现象，并在美国及OECD国家数据中得到验证。
AI.research_question: 为什么2007年以来，不同收入、家庭政策和劳动力市场制度的国家都出现了生育率加速下降并趋近更替水平？
AI.motivation: 现有解释（育儿成本、女性劳动参与率、家庭政策）无法解释生育率下降的时间节点（2007年后加速）和广度（跨国家普遍性）。
AI.theoretical_framework: Becker数量-质量权衡理论、家庭关系投资组合模型、CES家庭生产函数、均衡网络外部性。
AI.method: 家庭动态规划模型校准（美国数据），OECD国家面板预测，地形崎岖度工具变量（县级数字基础设施），队列Bartik设计（女性已婚率）。
AI.findings: 模型解释了美国智能手机时代生育率下降的大部分；反事实分析显示若数字技术停留在智能手机前水平可解释可观的下降；OECD国家数据匹配实际下降的方向和幅度；工具变量和队列Bartik设计支持因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字技术引入家庭经济学，提出“关系资本侵蚀”机制，拓展Becker数量-质量权衡框架至关系投资组合领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解全球生育率下降提供新视角，对家庭政策设计（如数字时代如何影响婚姻与生育决策）具有启示意义。

title: Unconscious Sacrifice and Democratic Legitimacy Institutional Optimization, Manufactured Invisibility, and the Sacrificial Threshold
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Unconscious Sacrifice and Democratic Legitimacy Institutional Optimization, Manufactured Invisibility, and the Sacrificial Threshold
detail.abstract: This article examines the mechanisms through which democratic institutions generate systematic casualties while preventing recognition that political choices are being made. Drawing on Girard's account of sacrificial méconnaissance and the surrogate victim mechanism, I distinguish "unconscious sacrifice"-where institutional optimization for aggregate outcomes produces individual failures hidden behind technical language-from "conscious sacrifice," where such trade-offs are named, contested, and democratically evaluated. The case of the Radium Girls (1917-1928) serves as an exemplary instance of manufactured invisibility: a sacrifice that was known, calculated, and protected through medical misdiagnosis, procedural exhaustion, and the systematic transfer of guilt onto victims. I argue that modern democratic institutions do not abolish the sacrificial mechanism described by Girard but rationalize it-substituting actuarial tables, evidentiary standards, and efficiency metrics for the ritual frameworks through which archaic societies managed sacrificial concealment, while preserving intact the méconnaissance on which sacrificial efficacy depends. Crucially, I attend to Girard's own warning that demystifying the mechanism does not automatically produce justice: the revelation of the victim's innocence, unaccompanied by alternative structures for managing mimetic crisis, can intensify rather than contain collective violence. Democratic maturity requires crossing what I call the "sacrificial threshold"-not the elimination of sacrifice, which is impossible, but its acknowledgment, equitable distribution, and ongoing accountability-with full awareness that the threshold cannot be crossed naively. Five criteria for distinguishing democratically legitimate from illegitimate sacrifice are developed from within mimetic theory rather than imported from liberal norms: visibility, contestability, proportionality, equitable distribution, and ongoing accountability. The article concludes that the systematic preference for unconscious sacrifice is not moral failure by individual leaders but the predictable outcome of institutional incentive structures-and that democratic pressure sufficient to cross the threshold is precisely what unconscious sacrifice is designed to prevent.

AI.tldr: 本文运用吉拉德的替罪羊机制理论，分析了民主制度如何通过技术语言、程序障碍和受害者污名化等手段，制造"无意识的牺牲"——即为了总体结果优化而造成的个体伤害被系统性隐匿。以"镭女孩"案（1917-1928）为案例，作者提出民主成熟需要跨越"牺牲阈值"：不是消除牺牲（这不可能），而是承认、公平分配并持续问责。文章从模仿理论内部发展出五个区分合法与非法牺牲的标准：可见性、可争议性、比例性、公平分配和持续问责。
AI.research_question: 民主制度通过哪些机制制造系统性牺牲，同时阻止人们认识到政治选择正在被做出？如何区分民主制度下合法与不合法的牺牲？
AI.motivation: 揭示民主制度中"无意识的牺牲"的运作机制，指出对牺牲机制的祛魅本身并不自动带来正义，需要制度性的替代方案来管理模仿危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吉拉德(Girard)的替罪羊机制与牺牲性误认(sacrificial méconnaissance)理论；模仿理论(mimetic theory)。
AI.method: 理论分析结合案例研究（"镭女孩"案，1917-1928）。
AI.findings: 1. 民主制度并未废除吉拉德描述的牺牲机制，而是将其理性化——用精算表、证据标准和效率指标替代了古老社会的仪式框架。2. 对牺牲机制的揭露若不伴随替代性结构，可能加剧而非遏制集体暴力。3. 民主中"无意识的牺牲"是制度激励结构的可预测结果，而非个体领导者的道德失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 将吉拉德的牺牲理论扩展到现代民主制度分析，提出了"牺牲阈值"概念，并基于模仿理论（而非自由主义规范）发展出五个区分合法与非法牺牲的标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民主制度中如何识别、评估和问责系统性牺牲提供了可操作的标准（可见性、可争议性、比例性、公平分配、持续问责），并指出跨越牺牲阈值正是无意识牺牲机制设计所要防止的事情。

title: Algorithmic Fiduciaries: Translating Traditional Duties into Digital Governance
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - School of Media and Journalism

detail.title: Algorithmic Fiduciaries: Translating Traditional Duties into Digital Governance
detail.abstract: The increasing deployment of algorithmic decision-making systems in critical domains (from healthcare diagnostics to financial lending) demands new frameworks for accountability and trust. Traditional fiduciary duties provide well-established principles for protecting individual interests. But applying them to algorithmic systems requires careful translation. This project examines how core fiduciary duties map onto automated decision-making systems, with particular attention to the accountability gaps created by diffused responsibility, opaque decision-making, continuous adaptation, scale and speed, contextual bias without intent, human–machine hybrid agency, and jurisdictional fragmentation. The project summarizes these gaps, explains why traditional frameworks struggle to address them, and shows how fiduciary duties can be translated into algorithmic applications such as documented diligence, explainable AI, continuous monitoring, fairness-by-design, joint accountability, and cross-jurisdictional disclosure. Thus, the framework demonstrates how manual oversight can evolve into automated monitoring, periodic review into continuous validation, and individual judgment into systematic protocols, while preserving traditional protections and strengthening accountability for policymakers and practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何将传统 fiduciary duties（受托人义务）原则映射到算法决策系统中，以解决问责性缺口，并提出相应的可操作框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将传统的受托人义务原则有效应用于算法决策系统，以应对其带来的问责性挑战？
AI.motivation: 算法决策系统在关键领域（如医疗、金融）广泛应用，但其扩散责任、不透明决策、持续适应、规模速度、无意图的上下文偏差、人机混合代理及管辖碎片化等问题造成问责性缺口，传统框架难以应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受托人义务（fiduciary duties）原则，包括勤勉义务、忠诚义务等传统信托法律理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与框架建构：系统梳理算法系统的问责性缺口，理论推导受托人义务向算法应用的映射路径。
AI.findings: 识别出七大问责性缺口（扩散责任、不透明决策、持续适应、规模速度、无意图上下文偏差、人机混合代理、管辖碎片化），并对应提出可翻译的算法实践：文档化尽职调查、可解释AI、持续监控、公平性设计、联合问责、跨管辖披露。同时提出传统机制向自动化机制的转化路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信托法律领域的受托人义务理论拓展至算法治理领域，为算法问责提供了经典法律理论的系统性支撑，填补了现有AI伦理框架与法律义务之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供了具体的算法问责操作性框架，包括从人工监督到自动监控、定期审查到持续验证、个体判断到系统协议的可实施转型路径。

title: Indonesian Biomass Resource Model (I-BRM): An Integrated Approach to Exploring Bioenergy Potential Accounting for Land Use, Food and Energy Security Trade-offs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, The University of Manchester - Department of Mechanical, Aerospace & Civil Engineering, Pariser Building, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Indonesian Biomass Resource Model (I-BRM): An Integrated Approach to Exploring Bioenergy Potential Accounting for Land Use, Food and Energy Security Trade-offs
detail.abstract: Bioenergy is a promising energy source in many countries worldwide. As an agrarian country with abundant biomass feedstock, Indonesia aims to increase the bioenergy share in the national renewable energy mix. Through the Indonesian Biomass Resource Model (I-BRM), this study assesses indigenous biomass resources from energy crops, agricultural residues, and municipal waste that can potentially be utilised for bioenergy production over the next 25 years. Five scenarios (Food Security, Energy Focus, Energy Security, Land Security, and Integrated Scenario) are developed to simulate how different strategies should be implemented to maximise this potential while analysing the trade-offs between land use for energy and food production. The results from the Energy Focus scenario show the highest potential, reaching up to 480 Mt of biomass with bioenergy potential of approximately 2700 PJ, which could fulfil 28% of Indonesia's energy demand in 2050. Meanwhile, the Integrated Scenario adopts a more moderate approach, requiring less land than currently projected in the government plans, but requiring greater investment in technology, as well as improvements in agricultural yield and waste management systems. Overall, these findings indicate that bioenergy can serve as a key pathway to support the attainment of Indonesia's renewable energy targets under various strategic approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度尼西亚生物质资源模型（I-BRM），评估了未来25年内该国可用于生物能源生产的本土生物质资源潜力，并设计了五种情景来模拟不同策略下的土地利用与能源产出权衡。研究发现，能源焦点情景下生物质潜力最高可达4.8亿吨，生物能源潜力约2700 PJ，可满足印尼2050年28%的能源需求；综合情景则更温和但需要更多技术投资和农业改良。
AI.research_question: 印度尼西亚如何通过优化本土生物质资源（能源作物、农业残余物、城市废物）的利用，在兼顾粮食安全和土地可持续性的前提下，最大化生物能源对可再生能源目标的贡献？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚作为农业大国拥有丰富的生物质原料，但生物能源在可再生能源结构中的占比仍有提升空间。需要系统性评估不同战略情景下生物质资源的潜力及其与粮食生产的权衡关系，为政策制定提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源评估模型（I-BRM）；情景分析（五种情景：粮食安全、能源焦点、能源安全、土地安全、综合情景）；土地利用与能源产出的权衡分析框架。
AI.method: 构建印度尼西亚生物质资源模型（I-BRM），纳入能源作物、农业残余物和城市废物三类生物质来源；设计五种未来情景（2025-2050年），模拟不同政策优先序下生物质可用量、生物能源潜力及土地需求的变化。
AI.findings: 能源焦点情景下生物质潜力最高（480 Mt），生物能源约2700 PJ，可满足2050年印尼28%的能源需求；综合情景更温和但需更多技术投资和农业/废物管理改进；不同情景在土地占用与能源产出之间存在显著权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合多种生物质来源和情景设定的系统性评估框架（I-BRM），丰富了发展中国家生物能源潜力与土地利用权衡的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度尼西亚制定生物能源发展战略提供了量化依据，指明不同政策路径（如优先能源还是优先粮食安全）的资源可行性与代价，有助于政府优化可再生能源规划和土地管理政策。

title: Do Cryptocurrencies Outperform Treasury Bills? Return Skewness and Wealth Concentration in Digital Asset Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Do Cryptocurrencies Outperform Treasury Bills? Return Skewness and Wealth Concentration in Digital Asset Markets
detail.abstract: This paper examines the distribution of buy-and-hold returns to the top 200 cryptocurrencies by market capitalisation from April 2016 to April 2026. Extending the framework of Bessembinder (2018) from equity markets to digital assets, we document that cryptocurrency markets exhibit extreme positive skewness in the cross-section of buy-and-hold returns. The median cryptocurrency from 2016 is now effectively dead - untradable or with no liquidity to sell into - while the market-capitalisation-weighted portfolio of the same coins returned 17,168% over the same decade. Fewer than one quarter of individual cryptocurrencies outperform a cumulative Treasury-bill return over the same horizon, yet the market-capitalisation-weighted return dramatically exceeds Treasury-bill benchmarks. The rate of permanent capital loss among individual cryptocurrencies, at 69.5% over ten years, is dramatically higher than the 11.8% lifetime rate documented for common stocks, and has more similarity to venture capital returns. The findings have direct implications for cryptocurrency portfolio construction, the evaluation of active digital asset management, and the limitations of performance benchmarking in an asset class characterised by extreme positive skewness in return distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2016年至2026年间前200大加密货币的买入持有回报分布，发现其呈现极端正偏态：中位数加密货币已"死亡"，但市值加权组合回报达17,168%；69.5%的永久性资本损失率远高于股票（11.8%），更接近风险投资。这对加密货币投资组合构建和业绩基准有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 加密货币市场中买入持有回报的横截面分布特征是什么？与股票市场相比，加密货币的永久性资本损失率如何？
AI.motivation: Bessembinder（2018）发现股票市场回报呈现极端正偏态，少数股票贡献了大部分净财富增长。加密货币市场波动更大、存活率更低，但缺乏类似系统性分析。作者试图检验这一框架是否适用于数字资产领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bessembinder（2018）的股票回报偏态分析框架；加密货币作为一种新兴资产类别，其回报分布可能更接近风险投资而非传统股票。
AI.method: 选取2016年4月至2026年4月间市值排名前200的加密货币，计算其买入持有回报，分析横截面分布特征，并与美国国债回报及Bessembinder（2018）的股票研究结果进行对比。
AI.findings: （1）加密货币回报呈极端正偏态，中位数加密货币已"死亡"（无法交易或无流动性）；（2）市值加权组合十年回报17,168%，远超国债基准；（3）不到四分之一的加密货币跑赢同期国债累计回报；（4）永久性资本损失率69.5%，远高于股票的11.8%，更接近风险投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bessembinder框架从股票市场拓展至加密货币这一新兴资产类别，揭示了数字资产回报分布比股票市场更为极端的偏态特征，为理解加密货币的"赢家通吃"现象提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对加密货币投资组合构建具有直接指导意义：主动管理面临挑战，传统业绩基准（如国债）可能严重低估市值加权策略的收益；投资者需认识到大多数加密货币将归零的现实，指数化投资可能优于选币策略。

title: Breaking the Glass Ledger: A Survey of Gender Disparities in Banking Careers
affiliations: University of Vaasa and

detail.title: Breaking the Glass Ledger: A Survey of Gender Disparities in Banking Careers
detail.abstract: This paper examines gender disparities in career outcomes within the banking industry. Using survey data from bank employees across 21 countries, we focus on the underlying factors for gender disparities by examining career trajectories, working hours, performance evaluations, career preferences, motivations for working in banking, and perceptions of discrimination. We find that although women report working fewer hours, this difference disappears after accounting for parental status, and it is not associated with lower work performance. Despite similar performance evaluations, women are significantly less likely to be promoted, even after controlling for experience, education, and other observable characteristics. Women and men share similar career motivations and preferences, yet women face greater barriers to career advancement. Among respondents who have experienced discrimination, women predominantly report genderbased discrimination, whereas men cite discrimination based on other factors. Overall, our findings suggest that gender disparities in banking careers are largely driven by structural barriers rather than systematic gender differences in job preferences, performance, motivation, or career aspirations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用21个国家银行员工的调查数据，发现银行业性别差异主要源于结构性障碍，而非工作偏好、绩效或职业志向的系统性性别差异。
AI.research_question: 银行业中性别差异的驱动因素是什么？这些差异是由于结构性障碍还是个体层面的差异（如偏好、绩效、动机）导致的？
AI.motivation: 银行业作为金融核心行业，其性别差异问题尚未得到充分解释。许多研究仅发现存在差异，但对其背后的深层原因缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性障碍理论、性别差异的归因理论（个体层面 vs. 结构层面解释）、工作偏好与职业发展匹配理论。
AI.method: 跨国调查数据（覆盖21个国家），对银行员工的职业轨迹、工作时间、绩效评估、职业偏好、工作动机和歧视感知进行定量分析，并使用多变量回归控制经验、教育等可观测特征。
AI.findings: (1) 女性工作时间更少，但控制父母身份后差异消失，且不影响工作绩效；(2) 绩效评估相似，但女性晋升概率显著更低，即使控制经验和教育等特征；(3) 男女职业动机和偏好相似，但女性面临更大的晋升障碍；(4) 遭受歧视的女性主要报告性别歧视，男性则报告其他因素的歧视。
AI.theory_contributions: 为结构性障碍理论提供实证支持，反驳了"个体差异说"（即认为性别差异源于女性偏好、绩效或动机差异的观点），将性别差异研究从"个体归因"转向"结构归因"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行业人力资源政策提供建议：应关注晋升环节的结构性障碍（如隐性偏见、网络效应、导师机会等），而非简单归因于女性的工作偏好或绩效问题；建议建立更透明的晋升机制。

title: Voluntary, in Two Senses: A Modal Distinction in Economic Methodology
affiliations: University of Nevada, Reno

detail.title: Voluntary, in Two Senses: A Modal Distinction in Economic Methodology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author received no specific funding for this work and reports no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No new empirical data were created or analyzed; the study is conceptual and methodological.
declarations.funderStatement: The author gratefully acknowledges the Phil and Jennifer Satre Endowed Professorship in Marketing, University of Nevada, Reno, for institutional support of this research.

detail.abstract: If you build a model where you've already decided what people want, you can't then turn around and use that model to show that they actually wanted it. Recent debate on voluntary exchange uses voluntary in two senses: was the agent forced, and could the agent have wanted otherwise. Closed models with fixed preferences answer the first; they cannot answer the second. A welfare or policy claim drawn from a closed model must say which sense it depends on. Claims about the agent's capacity to act on, not just within, their preferences (call this reflexive self-governance) need an argument the model does not supply. The distinction marks where closed-model inexactness becomes a substantive constraint on welfare or policy inference.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了封闭模型（closed models）在福利与政策推断中的局限：模型预设了人们的偏好，因此无法证明人们"本可能想要其他结果"。作者区分了"自愿交换"的两个含义——是否被迫 vs. 是否可能想要其他结果，指出封闭模型只能回答前者，而后者涉及"反思性自我治理"（reflexive self-governance），需要模型之外的理论论证。
AI.research_question: 封闭模型（如固定偏好下的均衡模型）在做出福利或政策推断时，其"自愿性"概念存在何种根本性局限？
AI.motivation: 经济学中的自愿交换常被用来论证市场结果的福利最优性，但作者指出这一论证存在循环：如果模型预设了人们想要什么，就不能再用该模型证明他们确实想要该结果。这一区分对政策推断具有实质性约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自愿交换的两个含义区分（被迫 vs. 本可能想要其他结果）；反思性自我治理（reflexive self-governance）；封闭模型与开放模型的界限。
AI.method: 概念分析与逻辑论证，对经济学建模中的"自愿"概念进行哲学性辨析。
AI.findings: 封闭模型只能回答"是否被迫"，无法回答"是否可能想要其他结果"；福利或政策主张必须明确其所依赖的自愿概念；关于行动者超越既定偏好进行反思性自我治理的主张，需要模型无法提供的额外论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了封闭模型在福利与政策推断中的认识论边界，区分了两种自愿概念，引入"反思性自我治理"作为模型外论证的必要条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和经济学家：依赖封闭模型得出的福利结论（如帕累托最优）可能隐藏了关于"人们本可能想要什么"的未经验证的假设，需要更审慎地对待模型的政策含义。

title: Rethinking Fairness in AI-driven Evaluation Synthesis: Towards a Culturally Responsive Framework
affiliations: University of Georgia

detail.title: Rethinking Fairness in AI-driven Evaluation Synthesis: Towards a Culturally Responsive Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no conflicts of interest in relation to this work

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) driven evaluation synthesis is emerging as a methodological innovation for extracting and synthesizing evaluative evidence efficiently. Yet, AI-driven evaluation synthesis raises questions about fairness, power asymmetries and representational issues due to the reliance on dominant ethical frameworks in evaluation synthesis and AI fields. Prevailing approaches to fairness in both evaluation synthesis and AI relies on rigid methodological frameworks and statistical metrics respectively. However, these dominant approaches do not properly capture contextual nuances. Whiles current scholarship calls for greater contextual sensitivity, this paper argues that a focus on culture rather than context may offer a more precise pathway for navigating issues relating to fair representation in AI-driven evaluation workflows. Hence, it proposes Culturally Responsive AI-driven Evaluation Synthesis (CRAIES) as a novel conceptual framework. CRAIES uplifts cultural responsiveness as an ethical stance that interrogates power, positionality, representation, and relational accountability in the AI-driven evaluation synthesis workflow. CRAIES hinges on four interdependent pillars namely criticality, reflexivity, relationality and responsiveness that aims towards cultural responsiveness in the AI-driven evaluation synthesis. By centering culture as the connective thread linking epistemology, methodology and technological design, CRAIES extends responsible AI and evidence synthesis debates beyond principles-based approaches towards culturally situated ethical praxis. CRAIES advances both theory and practice: theoretically by integrating AI ethics and evaluation theory, and practically by offering structured guidance for managing power asymmetries and representational issues in AI-driven evaluation synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"文化响应式AI驱动评估合成"（CRAIES）框架，主张以文化而非情境为核心，解决AI评估合成中的公平性、权力不对称和代表性问题，将负责任AI讨论从原则导向转向文化嵌入的伦理实践。
AI.research_question: 如何在AI驱动的评估合成中，通过文化响应性来应对公平性、权力不对称和代表性问题？
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估合成中的公平性方法（方法论框架和统计指标）无法捕捉情境细微差别，且学界对情境敏感性的呼吁不够精确，需要以文化为更精准的路径来导航公平代表性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: CRAIES框架，基于四个相互依赖的支柱：批判性（criticality）、反思性（reflexivity）、关系性（relationality）和响应性（responsiveness），以文化作为连接认识论、方法论和技术设计的线索。
AI.method: 概念框架构建，整合AI伦理与评估理论。
AI.findings: CRAIES通过将文化响应性作为伦理立场，审视AI驱动评估工作流程中的权力、立场性、代表性和关系问责；将负责任AI和证据合成讨论从原则导向推向文化嵌入的伦理实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合AI伦理与评估理论，提出以文化为中心连接认识论、方法论和技术设计的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理AI驱动评估合成中的权力不对称和代表性问题提供结构化指导。

title: The SHIELD-F Framework: A Cybersecurity and Data Governance Model for Innovation, Data Privacy, and System Resilience in Digital Finance Within Developing Economies

detail.title: The SHIELD-F Framework: A Cybersecurity and Data Governance Model for Innovation, Data Privacy, and System Resilience in Digital Finance Within Developing Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. No personal or financial relationships have influenced this study
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on a systematic literature review of publicly available academic and institutional sources. No human participants, patient data, or primary data collection was involved. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently as part of the author's doctoral studies at KCA University, Nairobi, Kenya

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of digital financial services across developing economies has reshaped financial inclusion and fintech innovation, yet has exposed critical weaknesses in cybersecurity, data governance, and regulatory frameworks. This paper addresses a significant gap: existing governance frameworks do not adequately integrate cybersecurity protection, data governance, innovation support, and systemic resilience within a unified structure suited to digital finance ecosystems in developing economies. Using a two-stage methodology comprising a PRISMA-guided systematic literature review of 30 peer-reviewed and institutional sources followed by conceptual framework development, the study presents the SHIELD-F Framework. SHIELD-F is a seven-pillar, three-layer governance model encompassing Security and System Resilience (S), Harmonized Governance (H), Innovation Enablement (I), Ethics and Accountability (E), Legal and Regulatory Alignment (L), Data Privacy and Sovereignty (D), and Financial Ecosystem Context (F). The framework is contextualized within Kenya's digital finance ecosystem, referencing the Data Protection Act (2019), the CBK National Payments Strategy, and the M-Pesa infrastructure. It provides actionable insights for regulators, fintech operators, and policymakers throughout Sub-Saharan Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文针对发展中国家数字金融生态系统中网络安全、数据治理与监管框架整合不足的问题，提出了一个七支柱三层次的SHIELD-F治理框架，并以肯尼亚为案例进行情境化验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一整合网络安全、数据治理、创新支持与系统性韧性的数字金融治理框架，以适用于发展中国家的数字金融生态系统？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家数字金融服务快速扩张，但现有治理框架未能将网络安全、数据治理、创新支持和系统性韧性整合到一个统一结构中，存在显著的研究与实践空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PRISMA系统文献综述方法，结合多层级治理理论、数字金融生态系统理论、网络安全与数据治理的整合视角，构建SHIELD-F概念框架。
AI.method: 两阶段方法论：第一阶段采用PRISMA指南进行系统性文献综述（30篇同行评审及机构来源文献）；第二阶段进行概念框架开发与情境化验证。
AI.findings: 提出了SHIELD-F框架，包含七个支柱（安全与系统韧性、协同治理、创新赋能、伦理与问责、法律与监管协调、数据隐私与主权、金融生态系统情境）和三个治理层级；以肯尼亚数字金融生态系统（数据保护法2019、CBK国家支付战略、M-Pesa基础设施）验证了框架的适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了发展中国家数字金融治理框架整合性研究的理论空白，提出了一个系统性、多维度的SHIELD-F治理模型，超越了单一维度的治理思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为撒哈拉以南非洲地区的监管机构、金融科技运营者和政策制定者提供了可操作的治理框架与政策建议，助力发展中国家的数字金融风险防控与可持续发展。

title: Business Decision Architecture (BDA) Framework: The Discipline of Organizational Decision Governance
affiliations: and

detail.title: Business Decision Architecture (BDA) Framework: The Discipline of Organizational Decision Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are co-founders of Business Consultants for Digital Solutions, LLC (BC-DS), the firm that holds the copyright on the Business Decision Architecture (BDA) framework documented in this paper and operates the Convoking4 platform on which the framework is implemented. BC-DS also operates the Decisiontect credentialing ecosystem associated with the framework. Monica M. Hernandez serves as Chief Technology Officer; Daniel A. Montero serves as founder and principal. Both authors hold ownership interests in BC-DS. The framework specification documented in this paper is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) and remains freely available to any practitioner, researcher, or organization wishing to apply, evaluate, or build on it. The Convoking4 platform and the Decisiontect ecosystem are the framework's commercial implementations; the framework itself is not paywalled.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted as part of the framework development work of BC-DS, Business Consultants for Digital Solutions, LLC. No external grant funding, sponsor, or funding agency supported this work. The work was self-funded through BC-DS.

detail.abstract:
The Business Decision Architecture (BDA) framework is the discipline of organizational decision governance, addressing the deliberative layer between Digital Transformation and Decision Intelligence. This paper establishes BDA as a conceptual framework at the organizational scale, the fourth and final paper in the Decision Architecture discipline's four-paper publication architecture.

The framework operationalizes the foundational technique of backcasting and the dual lens applied to consequential decision-making, with a decision architecture artifact as the technique's output, at the scale where multiple stakeholders with distinct accountabilities, altitudes, and time horizons must converge on a consequential commitment. The adjacent practitioner literatures of Digital Transformation and Decision Intelligence each address substantive work the framework does not duplicate; neither addresses the structural integrity of the deliberation that produces the consequential commitments those literatures support.

BDA's discipline-defining identity rests on five constructs: the Three Principles of Organizational Choice, which name the structural conditions any deliberative system must meet; Strategic Triage at the organizational scale, which classifies the magnitude of structural change a commitment will require; the Wise Mind held collectively, the integrative state a deliberative body enters when it holds Art, Science, Process, and the Gamble together; the ADICE Matrix (Authority, Decide, Influence, Contribute, Experience), which specifies the role architecture deliberative integrity requires; and the Commitment Gate, which distinguishes deliberated commitments from performed commitments through the Conviction Score and the Commitment Lock.

The framework is implemented on the Convoking4 platform; the framework specification is durable across implementations and open under CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了商业决策架构（BDA）框架，作为组织决策治理的学科体系，位于数字化转型与决策智能之间的审慎决策层。BDA通过五个核心构念（组织选择的三个原则、战略分诊、集体智慧心态、ADICE矩阵、承诺门）来确保多利益相关者在重大承诺上的决策结构完整性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个组织层面的决策架构框架，以保障多利益相关者在重大决策上的审慎性结构完整性？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型和决策智能两大实践领域各自处理了大量实质性工作，但都没有解决支撑这些工作的决策审议的结构完整性问题。需要一个组织层面的决策治理框架来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: BDA框架包含五大构念：1）组织选择的三个原则——任何审慎系统必须满足的结构条件；2）组织层面的战略分诊——对承诺所需的结构变革程度进行分类；3）集体智慧心态——将艺术、科学、流程与赌博整合的审慎状态；4）ADICE矩阵——定义角色架构的审慎完整性要求；5）承诺门——通过信念分数和承诺锁区分审慎承诺与执行承诺。
AI.method: 概念框架构建，基于回溯法（backcasting）和双重视角（dual lens）基础技术，以决策架构产物作为技术输出。
AI.findings: BDA框架为组织决策治理提供了系统的概念框架和方法论，已在Convoking4平台上实施，框架规范在不同实施中保持持久性，并以CC BY 4.0开放许可发布。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了商业决策架构（BDA）作为决策架构学科的核心框架，填补了数字化转型与决策智能之间的理论空白，提出了五个原创性构念来定义组织决策治理的学科身份。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了可操作的决策治理框架，通过ADICE矩阵明确角色权责，通过承诺门量化决策承诺的信念强度，通过战略分诊评估变革程度，帮助多利益相关者在重大决策上达成有效共识。

title: Policy Paper: From Transitional Governance to Sovereign Statehood Re-engineering the Post-Oslo Palestinian Framework under UN Resolution 2803
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN
