detail.title: Policy Paper: From Transitional Governance to Sovereign Statehood Re-engineering the Post-Oslo Palestinian Framework under UN Resolution 2803
detail.abstract: This policy paper examines the strategic implications of the Israeli legislative move to abolish the Oslo Accords. Utilizing Functional & Engineering Dissection Analysis (FEDA) and Sovereign Stability Theory (SST), the paper argues that the formal termination of the accords by Israel removes the legal and functional "buffer" that has managed the conflict for decades. The analysis concludes that this shift serves as a catalyst for the international community to implement UN Resolution 2803, Furthermore, the paper provides a strategic framework for managing the transition, addressing operational risks, and transforming institutional accumulation into sovereign state organs. Transitioning the Palestinian political entity from a "transitional administrative body" to a full "State under Occupation" with a permanent sovereign mandate.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了以色列废除《奥斯陆协议》的战略影响，运用功能与工程解构分析（FEDA）和主权稳定理论（SST），论证该举动消除了管理冲突数十年的法律与功能性"缓冲"，进而促使国际社会实施联合国第2803号决议，推动巴勒斯坦政治实体从"过渡行政机构"转变为拥有永久主权授权的"被占领土国家"。
AI.research_question: 以色列废除《奥斯陆协议》的战略影响是什么？如何将巴勒斯坦政治实体从过渡行政机构转变为被占领土国家？
AI.motivation: 分析以色列废除《奥斯陆协议》这一立法举措的地缘政治后果，并为其后的制度转型提供战略框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能与工程解构分析（FEDA）和主权稳定理论（SST）。
AI.method: 政策分析，结合FEDA和SST理论框架进行演绎推理。
AI.findings: 以色列废除《奥斯陆协议》消除了管理冲突的法律与功能性缓冲，成为国际社会实施联合国第2803号决议的催化剂；巴勒斯坦政治实体应从"过渡行政机构"转型为"被占领土国家"。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FEDA和SST应用于分析中东和平进程中的制度转型问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理过渡期、应对操作风险以及将制度积累转化为主权国家机构提供了战略框架。

title: The AI-powered Recruitment Consulting Strategy
affiliations: and Barry University - Andreas School of Business

detail.title: The AI-powered Recruitment Consulting Strategy
detail.abstract: As the world recovers from the AI digital disruption crisis, the world economy is still in flux. Many jobs disappeared from the scene as many organizations adjust their workforce. Attracting the best skills and best talent has also been a challenge for many organizations. Traditional recruitment consulting strategies are outdated, and our recommendation is to move to use the AIpowered recruitment consulting strategy. The AI-powered recruitment consulting strategy revolutionizes the process of recruiting and attracting future human resources for the organization and brings extraordinary results. Results such as developing innovation and assembling a pool of top talent to better meet the ever-increasing needs of today's ever-changing business environment will be enhanced with this new recruitment consulting strategy. Much of what we share in this article comes from our management consulting experience as senior management consultants of McKinsey and Company in Sydney, Australia.

AI.tldr: 本文基于麦肯锡悉尼分公司的高级管理咨询经验，提出在AI数字颠覆危机后，传统招聘咨询策略已过时，建议组织采用AI驱动的招聘咨询策略，以更有效地吸引顶尖人才、推动创新，应对不断变化的商业环境。
AI.research_question: 在后AI数字颠覆危机时代，组织如何通过AI驱动的招聘咨询策略更有效地吸引顶尖人才和最佳技能？
AI.motivation: AI数字颠覆危机导致许多岗位消失，组织在劳动力调整中面临吸引顶尖人才的巨大挑战，而传统招聘咨询策略已无法满足当前需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI驱动的人力资源管理理论、数字化转型理论、战略招聘与人才管理理论。
AI.method: 基于麦肯锡高级管理咨询顾问在悉尼分公司的实践经验和案例分享，属于经验性/反思性论述，未明确提及系统性的实证研究方法。
AI.findings: AI驱动的招聘咨询策略能彻底革新组织的人才吸引和招聘流程，带来开发创新、汇聚顶尖人才库等非凡成果，从而更好地满足当今快速变化的商业环境需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并阐述了AI驱动招聘咨询策略作为一种新型战略框架的必要性和有效性，为后危机时代的人力资源管理理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在数字化转型背景下提供了具体的AI招聘咨询策略建议，帮助管理者应对人才短缺和招聘挑战，提升创新能力和人才竞争力。

title: A STUDY ON ENHANCING EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT THROUGH REWARDS AND RECOGNITION
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A STUDY ON ENHANCING EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT THROUGH REWARDS AND RECOGNITION
detail.abstract:
Employee engagement is a critical factor in organizational success, influencing productivity, retention, and overall workplace satisfaction. This project report investigates the efficacy of rewards and recognition programs in enhancing employee engagement within the context of Google India Private Limited Recognizing the pivotal role of engaged employees in fostering innovation and driving company growth, this study delves into the strategies employed by Google to motivate and retain its workforce. By examining existing literature on employee engagement, rewards systems, and organizational behaviour, this report aims to provide insights into the mechanisms through which rewards and recognition initiatives contribute to heightened engagement levels. 

Drawing on both quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, this project undertakes a comprehensive analysis of Google's rewards and recognition framework. Through surveys, interviews, and case studies, the study assesses employee perceptions of the effectiveness of existing reward programs and identifies areas for improvement. Furthermore, it explores the alignment between Google's organizational culture, values, and reward structures, shedding light on the extent to which these initiatives resonate with employees' intrinsic motivations and professional aspirations. By analysing data gathered from multiple sources, this report offers actionable recommendations for refining and optimizing rewards and recognition strategies to foster a more engaged and motivated workforce at Google India Private Limited.

The findings of this study underscore the significance of tailored rewards and recognition approaches in cultivating a culture of appreciation and empowerment within the workplace. By acknowledging employees' contributions and achievements, organizations like Google can reinforce positive behaviours, strengthen employee morale, and nurture a sense of belonging and loyalty. Moreover, this research underscores the importance of aligning reward systems with organizational goals and values to ensure sustained engagement and performance excellence. Through continuous evaluation and adaptation of rewards and recognition initiatives, Google and similar organizations can create an environment where employees feel valued, motivated, and committed to driving collective success. 

The study concludes by providing actionable recommendations for senior management at Google to continuously refine and enhance rewards and recognition programs in alignment with evolving organizational goals and employee needs. These recommendations aim to foster sustained engagement, productivity, and a positive organizational culture at Google, ensuring its position as a leader in the tech industry.

AI.tldr: 本文以Google印度私人有限公司为案例，通过混合研究方法（问卷调查、访谈、案例研究）考察奖励与认可计划对员工敬业度的影响。研究发现，定制化的奖励与认可方法能够营造感恩与赋权文化，提升员工士气、归属感和忠诚度。研究建议将奖励体系与组织目标及价值观对齐，并持续优化相关举措，以维持员工敬业度和绩效卓越。
AI.research_question: 奖励与认可计划如何以及在多大程度上影响Google印度私人有限公司的员工敬业度？
AI.motivation: 员工敬业度是影响组织成功（生产力、留存率、工作满意度）的关键因素，而Google作为科技行业领导者，其激励机制值得深入探究，以揭示奖励与认可计划提升敬业度的具体机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 员工敬业度理论、奖励与认可体系理论、组织行为学中的内在动机与外在激励理论、组织文化与价值观对齐理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：定量（问卷调查）与定性（访谈、案例研究）相结合，对Google印度公司的奖励与认可框架进行综合分析，评估员工对现有奖励计划的感知并识别改进领域。
AI.findings: 定制化的奖励与认可方法有助于营造感恩与赋权文化；认可员工贡献能强化积极行为、提升士气、培养归属感与忠诚度；将奖励体系与组织目标及价值观对齐对维持敬业度和绩效卓越至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并深化了奖励与认可计划对员工敬业度影响机制的理解，特别强调了奖励体系与组织文化、价值观及员工内在动机对齐的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Google印度公司高级管理层提供了优化奖励与认可计划的 actionable 建议，以持续提升员工敬业度、生产力和积极的组织文化，巩固其行业领先地位。

title: Reading the Room: Creative Observation and the Genesis of Gray-Area Work

detail.title: Reading the Room: Creative Observation and the Genesis of Gray-Area Work

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This working paper is part of the Hackquire™ project, an illustrated non-fiction book and related creative research initiative that may be commercially published in the future. The authors declare this project connection for transparency. No external funder influenced the content of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This working paper does not report clinical, experimental, or personally identifiable participant research. It is based on creative observation, desk research, and conceptual analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable. This working paper does not report clinical, experimental, or personally identifiable participant research. It is based on creative observation, desk research, and conceptual analysis.

detail.abstract: This working paper is intended for publishing professionals, creative researchers, workplace practitioners, organisational behaviour researchers, and readers assessing the conceptual development of Hackquire™. It examines how gray-area workplace situations begin, not only at the visible incident, but earlier, in the gap between formal structure and informal interpretation. It focuses on weak signals: small cues in communication, context, documentation, ownership, responsibility, silence, timing, visibility, and workplace behaviour that shape how work is understood before it is formally named. This is not the Hackquire™ book. It does not reproduce the book's full entries.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨灰色地带工作情境如何从正式结构与非正式解释之间的裂隙中产生，聚焦于沟通、语境、文档、所有权、责任、沉默、时机、可见性和工作行为中的微弱信号，这些信号在工作被正式命名之前塑造了人们对工作的理解。
AI.research_question: 灰色地带工作情境是如何在正式结构与非正式解释之间的裂隙中开始形成的？
AI.motivation: 帮助出版专业人士、创意研究者、职场从业者、组织行为研究者评估Hackquire™的概念发展，理解灰色地带问题不仅始于可见的事件，更早地始于结构性裂隙中的微弱信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hackquire™概念框架，强调正式结构与非正式解释之间的张力，以及微弱信号理论。
AI.method: 概念性论文/工作论文，基于Hackquire™框架进行理论推演与分析。
AI.findings: 灰色地带工作情境的起源可追溯至正式结构与非正式解释之间的裂隙，微弱信号（如沟通、语境、文档、所有权、责任、沉默、时机、可见性、工作行为中的细小线索）在这一过程中起关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将灰色地带问题的研究视角从可见事件前移至结构性裂隙和微弱信号阶段，拓展了组织行为学中对灰色地带形成机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为职场从业者和管理者提供了识别灰色地带早期信号的框架，帮助其在问题正式命名前进行干预。

title:
The Cost Frontier of Cryptographically Relevant Quantum Computing:
Capital Intensity, Technological Expectations, and Security Investment
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title:
The Cost Frontier of Cryptographically Relevant Quantum Computing:
Capital Intensity, Technological Expectations, and Security Investment
detail.abstract: Quantum threats to public-key cryptography are commonly described as a future technical threshold. This framing omits the central economic question. The relevant unit is not the number of physical qubits, logical qubits, or gates, but the cost per successful cryptographic key broken. This paper develops a techno-economic cost-frontier model for cryptographically relevant quantum computing. It combines published resource estimates for RSA-2048 and elliptic-curve discrete logarithms with public capital-commitment evidence, cloud-access pricing, public quantum R&D, firm financials, and engineering constraints. The model annualises capital costs and accounts for utilisation, fixed and variable operating costs, run-success probability, failed-run time, setup costs, and target costs. AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个技术经济成本前沿模型，将量子威胁从单纯的技术阈值问题重新定义为经济成本问题。模型以破解RSA-2048和椭圆曲线离散对数的每次成功成本为核心单位，综合了资源估算、资本承诺、云定价、研发支出、公司财务和工程约束，通过年化资本成本、利用率、固定和可变运营成本、运行成功概率等因素量化量子计算的经济可行性。
AI.research_question: 量子计算机破解公钥密码学的经济成本是多少？如何从技术经济角度而非单纯技术阈值角度评估量子威胁？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将量子威胁描述为"未来技术阈值"，忽略了核心经济问题。破解公钥密码学的相关单位不是量子比特或门操作数量，而是每次成功破解加密密钥的成本。需要建立技术经济模型来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术经济成本前沿模型，结合了：资源估算（RSA-2048和椭圆曲线离散对数）、资本承诺证据、云访问定价、公共量子研发、公司财务数据、工程约束。采用年化资本成本框架，考虑利用率、固定和可变运营成本、运行成功概率、失败运行时间、设置成本和目标成本。
AI.method: 技术经济建模方法：整合量子计算资源估算数据与经济成本数据，构建成本前沿模型，通过年化资本成本和多维度成本因素量化每次成功破解的单位成本。
AI.findings: （基于摘要信息有限，部分推断）量子威胁的经济门槛可能与纯技术门槛存在显著差异；成本前沿模型提供了比单纯量子比特数量更精确的威胁评估框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将经济成本分析框架引入量子安全威胁评估，提出了以"每次成功破解成本"替代"量子比特/门数量"作为量子威胁的核心度量单位，建立了技术经济成本前沿模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和安全专家提供了评估量子加密威胁实际时间线的经济分析工具；帮助组织更准确地判断量子安全转型的紧迫性和投资决策；为密码学迁移规划提供了基于成本效益的决策依据。

title: A Smart Building Directrix Load Formulation Method for Smart Building Clusters Based on Directional Aggregation Mechanism

detail.title: A Smart Building Directrix Load Formulation Method for Smart Building Clusters Based on Directional Aggregation Mechanism
detail.abstract: Accurate formulation of customer directrix loads for smart buildings is an important foundation for guiding smart buildings to exert their demand response potential. However, due to the diversity of types and time coupling characteristics of adjustable resources, existing customer directrix load(CDL) formulation methods do not consider the regulatory characteristics of adjustable loads themselves, resulting in a low response rate. To this end, this paper proposes a customer directrix load formulation method for smart building clusters based on a directional aggregation mechanism, describing the problem of customer directrix load formulation for smart building clusters as a mixed integer linear programming problem under the constraints of cluster response capacity, and realizing the directional aggregation of response resources in the cluster by embedding specific aggregation objectives. First, to accurately construct the directional aggregation target curve of the smart building cluster, we obtain typical cluster load curves through multi-feature extraction and clustering algorithms, predict the response demand curve using the LSTM neural network, and then superimpose the two to obtain the ideal customer directrix load. Then, taking the ideal customer directrix load as the aggregation direction, we use the feasible region projection method to directionally project the high-dimensional time-series operation space inside the cluster into the external feasible region of the cluster. Finally, taking the boundary of the cluster's external feasible region as the constraint, the cluster directrix load generation and decomposition optimization model that considers the cluster response capability is constructed to achieve cluster directrix load formulation and refined decomposition into differentiated smart building load types. Case studies show that compared with traditional methods, the proposed method can effectively improve the aggregation effect of the cluster's response capacity and ensure the accessibility of the load cluster directrix load.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于定向聚合机制的智能建筑集群客户基准负荷（CDL）制定方法，通过多特征提取、聚类算法和LSTM神经网络构建理想基准负荷，并利用可行域投影方法实现集群响应资源的定向聚合与精细化分解，有效提升了响应容量聚合效果和基准负荷的可达性。
AI.research_question: 如何制定考虑可调资源自身调节特性的智能建筑集群客户基准负荷，以提高需求响应率？
AI.motivation: 现有客户基准负荷制定方法未充分考虑可调资源类型的多样性及时间耦合特性，导致响应率较低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定向聚合机制、可行域投影方法、混合整数线性规划
AI.method: 多特征提取与聚类算法获取典型集群负荷曲线；LSTM神经网络预测响应需求曲线；两者叠加得到理想基准负荷；可行域投影方法将高维时序运行空间投影为集群外部可行域；构建考虑集群响应能力的基准负荷生成与分解优化模型。
AI.findings: 与传统方法相比，所提方法能有效提升集群响应容量的聚合效果，并确保负荷集群基准负荷的可达性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了定向聚合机制，将集群响应资源的聚合问题建模为混合整数线性规划问题，并引入可行域投影方法实现高维运行空间到外部可行域的转换。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能建筑集群的客户基准负荷制定提供了可行方法，能够实现差异化楼宇负荷类型的精细化分解，提升需求响应执行效果。

title:
The Geometry and Dynamics of Power:
A Statistical Mechanics Framework for Nonequilibrium Political Systems

detail.title:
The Geometry and Dynamics of Power:
A Statistical Mechanics Framework for Nonequilibrium Political Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This study formulates a statistical mechanics framework for nonequilibrium political dynamics by extending the Geometry of Power (Caesar Edward, 2025) to include porosity, vorticity, and viscosity as coupled fields in a multidimensional state space. Political regimes evolve as stochastic trajectories governed by path integrals, where the dynamics are driven by a free-action potential combining expected action, entropy, temperature, and external pressure. Porosity captures structural permeability and enables nonlocal transitions. Vorticity induces rotational dynamics and cyclical behavior, while viscosity introduces resistance and stabilizes trajectories. The resulting Langevin dynamics and associated Fokker–Planck equation describe the evolution of probability distributions over political states in the presence turbulence. Empirical calibration using political and economic indicators, combined with a Monte Carlo simulation, generates trajectory ensembles from which entropy, turbulence, and phase transitions are identified. When applied to East Africa, the framework reveals distinct dynamical regimes of stability, circulation, and confinement. The results demonstrate that political systems evolve through coupled stochastic processes rather than deterministic transitions, providing a unified basis for analyzing instability and structural change.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个非平衡政治动力学的统计力学框架，将孔隙度、涡度和粘度作为耦合场引入权力几何模型，通过路径积分、朗之万方程和福克-普朗克方程描述政治系统的随机演化，并在东非地区进行了实证校准与蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.research_question: 政治系统如何通过耦合的随机过程而非确定性转变进行演化？如何用统计力学框架量化分析政治不稳定性和结构性变化？
AI.motivation: 传统政治转型分析多依赖确定性模型，难以捕捉政治系统中的随机性、非线性动力学和相变现象。作者希望引入统计力学工具，为政治不稳定性和结构变迁提供统一的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非平衡统计力学、路径积分理论、朗之万动力学、福克-普朗克方程；核心概念包括孔隙度（结构渗透性）、涡度（旋转动力学与周期行为）、粘度（阻力与轨迹稳定化）、自由作用势（期望行动、熵、温度与外部压力的组合）。
AI.method: 理论建模（统计力学框架构建）、实证校准（使用政治与经济指标）、蒙特卡洛模拟生成轨迹集合，识别熵、湍流和相变。
AI.findings: 在东非应用中识别出稳定性、循环和受限三种不同动力学机制；政治系统通过耦合随机过程演化，存在明确的相变和湍流特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 将孔隙度、涡度和粘度作为耦合场引入政治动力学，拓展了权力几何理论；建立了政治系统随机演化的统计力学统一框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政治不稳定性和结构性变化的量化分析提供了新工具，特别是对东非地区政治动态的实证诊断具有政策参考价值。

title: Hybrid Micro-Agents, Directed Mutation, and Token-Mediated Cognition: A Multi-Scale Theory of Human-AI Organizational Learning

detail.title: Hybrid Micro-Agents, Directed Mutation, and Token-Mediated Cognition: A Multi-Scale Theory of Human-AI Organizational Learning
detail.abstract: March's (1991) organizational learning model treats micro-agents as homogeneous and human-an assumption structurally untenable as AI agents become active participants in organizational decisions. This paper extends a companion multi-scale model by reconceiving the agent population as hybrid: human and AI agents are structurally distinct token classes with different belief representations, learning regimes, and participation costs. Four extensions are formalized: a hybrid micro-agent population, directed mutation as turnover reframing, a tripartite learning regime model, and token budgets as a mesoscale participation constraint, implemented as an extended Colored Petri Net with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation interface. Production simulations (30 seeds, 40 conditions) show balanced hybrid compositions outperform homogeneous baselines on rugged landscapes; stochastic turnover uniquely damages fitness relative to directed mutation at identical revision counts; and a token budget threshold B* exists below which AI participation generates negative net fitness. Observer-dependence SNR is 12.75× across five reference templates.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展March(1991)组织学习模型，引入人类与AI智能体异质性混合种群。通过有色Petri网和RAG接口实现四种扩展，发现平衡的混合组成在崎岖地形上优于同质基线，随机更替损害适应度，且存在AI参与产生负净适应度的代币预算阈值B*。
AI.research_question: 当AI智能体成为组织决策的主动参与者时，人类-AI混合种群的组织学习动态如何？混合种群的最优组成和约束条件是什么？
AI.motivation: March(1991)的组织学习模型将微观智能体视为同质且人类的，这一假设在AI成为组织决策参与者后结构上不再成立。需要重新概念化智能体种群为异质混合体。
AI.theoretical_framework: March(1991)组织学习模型、异质智能体种群理论、定向突变与随机更替理论、三方学习机制、代币预算约束理论
AI.method: 形式化四种扩展（混合微智能体种群、定向突变、三方学习机制、代币预算），扩展有色Petri网实现，配备检索增强生成(RAG)接口。进行30个种子、40种条件的生成仿真。
AI.findings: 1. 平衡的混合组成在崎岖地形上优于同质基线；2. 随机更替在相同修改次数下相比定向突变独特地损害适应度；3. 存在代币预算阈值B*，低于该阈值AI参与产生负净适应度；4. 观察者依赖的SNR为12.75×（跨五个参考模板）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织学习理论扩展到人类-AI混合种群场景；形式化区分人类与AI的结构差异（信念表征、学习机制、参与成本）；定义代币预算作为中尺度参与约束的新理论概念；区分随机更替与定向突变对适应度的不同影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计人机混合团队提供最优组成比例指导；揭示AI参与存在负收益阈值，指导组织控制AI部署规模；提供基于代币预算的AI参与管理框架；为理解不同"更替"机制（随机vs定向）对组织适应度的影响提供实践洞见。

title: Paradigm Upgrade of Statistical Governance in Early Childhood Education Against the Backdrop of Low Fertility: A Comparative Analysis of China and South Korea
affiliations: Seoul National University

detail.title: Paradigm Upgrade of Statistical Governance in Early Childhood Education Against the Backdrop of Low Fertility: A Comparative Analysis of China and South Korea
detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of low fertility, early childhood education (ECE) in China is undergoing a historic transition from scale expansion to quality development. Drawing on the governance knowledge-production theories of Desrosères, Scott, and Porter, this paper compares China’s National Statistical Bulletin on Educational Development (2022–2024) with South Korea’s 2022 Survey Report on Actual Conditions of Early Childhood Education. It constructs an analytical framework distinguishing two statistical paradigms: resource-allocation and efficacy-evaluation. The study finds that China’s Statistical Bulletin produces a paradox in which gross enrollment rates rise alongside mass kindergarten closures—a demographic artifact rather than genuine quality improvement. By contrast, South Korea’s survey captures institutional operational pressures, teacher salary difficulties, and family childcare costs through three-dimensional measurement of institutions, teachers, and parents. This paper argues that advancing high-quality ECE in China requires a dual-track governance knowledge-production system that combines the existing Statistical Bulletin with a national ECE survey on actual conditions, enabling demand-responsive, precision-matched policymaking.

AI.tldr: 本文比较中韩两国学前教育统计体系，揭示中国统计公报因只关注资源投入指标（如毛入园率）而产生"入园率上升与幼儿园大量关停并存"的悖论，而韩国通过三维度（机构、教师、家长）实况调查能捕捉真实运营压力。建议中国建立"统计公报+全国学前教育实况调查"的双轨治理知识生产体系。
AI.research_question: 中国学前教育统计体系是否存在结构性缺陷？如何借鉴韩国经验构建更有效的治理知识生产体系？
AI.motivation: 在低生育率背景下中国学前教育从规模扩张转向质量发展，但现有统计体系可能无法真实反映教育质量状况，亟需反思和改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Desrosères、Scott和Porter的治理知识生产理论，构建了"资源配置型"与"效能评估型"两种统计范式的分析框架。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比中国《全国教育事业发展统计公报》（2022-2024）与韩国《2022年学前教育实况调查报告》。
AI.findings: 中国统计公报产生"毛入园率上升与大量幼儿园关停并存"的悖论，这是人口效应而非质量提升；韩国通过机构、教师、家长三维度测量，能捕捉到机构运营压力、教师工资困难和家庭育儿成本等真实信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了统计范式选择如何影响政策认知：资源配置型统计可能掩盖人口结构变化下的真实教育质量状况，提出将统计体系视为治理知识生产系统加以分析的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国学前教育政策制定提供统计体系改革建议：建立"统计公报+全国学前教育实况调查"的双轨体系，实现需求响应型、精准匹配的政策制定。

title: Manipulation, Insider Information, and Regulation in Leveraged Event-Linked Markets

detail.title: Manipulation, Insider Information, and Regulation in Leveraged Event-Linked Markets
detail.abstract: The introduction of leverage on prediction-market event contracts raises three structurally distinct questions that have not been addressed jointly: how leverage changes manipulation incentives, how it interacts with informed-trading rents, and how regulatory frameworks should respond. This paper develops a theoretical framework for the first two and a synthesis of the existing regulatory landscape for the third. The principal analytical move is a two-axis manipulation taxonomy distinguishing market-price manipulation from real-world outcome manipulation, where the manipulator affects the underlying event itself. Continuous-underlying derivative markets generally do not make outcome manipulation a venue-level payoff channel; event-linked markets do. Within this taxonomy, leverage plays asymmetric roles: it scales market-price manipulation linearly but shifts the cost-benefit threshold for outcome manipulation, and it scales informed-trading rents in three ways (direct multiplication, Sharpe-ratio preservation, detection-cost amortization). Section 7 connects Paper 1's pre-emption and halt-protocol findings (CC-007b, CC-008) to three manipulation channels: pre-emption introduced by the dynamic-margin engine, halt-arbitrage introduced by the resolution-zone halt protocol, and strategic bad-debt-shifting that no engine in Paper 1's framework family addresses. The framework's manipulation-resistance contribution is a re-allocation of attack surface, not a net reduction. The regulatory synthesis covers principal jurisdictions (US, EU, UK, Singapore, offshore) and identifies three regulatory-arbitrage pathways. The paper concludes with 14 recommendations for venue operators, regulatory bodies, and the research community, separated into framework-independent and framework-conditional categories.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论框架，分析杠杆如何影响预测市场事件合约中的操纵激励、知情交易租金及监管应对，并提出了一个双轴操纵分类法，区分市场价格操纵与真实结果操纵。
AI.research_question: 杠杆在预测市场事件合约中如何改变操纵激励、如何与知情交易租金相互作用，以及监管框架应如何回应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献未联合处理杠杆引入预测市场后引发的三个结构性问题（操纵激励变化、知情交易租金变化、监管应对），本文填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双轴操纵分类法：市场价格操纵 vs. 真实结果操纵（操纵者影响事件本身）。杠杆在操纵中的不对称作用；知情交易租金的三种放大机制。
AI.method: 理论建模与现有监管格局的综合分析。
AI.findings: 1) 连续标的衍生品市场通常不使结果操纵成为场所层面的支付渠道，事件关联市场则相反；2) 杠杆对市场价格操纵呈线性放大，对结果操纵则改变成本-收益阈值；3) 杠杆通过直接乘数、夏普比率维持、检测成本摊销三种方式放大知情交易租金；4) 分析了保证金引擎抢先交易、暂停套利、战略坏债转移三种操纵渠道；5) 识别了三种监管套利路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次联合分析杠杆对预测市场操纵激励、知情交易租金的影响；提出双轴操纵分类法，明确了杠杆在不同操纵类型中的不对称作用；揭示了杠杆放大知情交易租金的三种机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出14条针对交易场所运营者、监管机构和研究社区的建议（分框架独立与框架条件两类）；梳理了主要司法辖区（美国、欧盟、英国、新加坡、离岸）的监管格局，识别监管套利路径。

title: The Auditor and the Algorithm: Automation Bias in AI-Assisted Cybersecurity Control Assessment
affiliations: Student

detail.title: The Auditor and the Algorithm: Automation Bias in AI-Assisted Cybersecurity Control Assessment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. The AI Cyber Assurance Agent discussed in this paper was built by the author as part of a GRC automation portfolio deployed at their employer. No party had editorial influence over the study design or manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a study protocol and has not yet involved human participants. Ethics approval will be obtained from the author's institutional review board prior to participant recruitment. The study design follows the British Psychological Society's Code of Ethics and Research Conduct, and the protocol has been pre-registered on the Open Science Framework.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted as part of the author's MSc in Information Security and Digital Forensics at the University of East London, using the author's own research instrument and infrastructure.

detail.abstract: The AI Cyber Assurance Agent — a multi-agent system built by the researcher, deployed in production at a major telecommunications provider, and part of a 13-tool open-source GRC automation portfolio with over 760 tests — evaluates IT general controls and returns compliance verdicts of Met, Partially Met, or Not Met. Those verdicts feed directly into audit reports, regulatory filings, and certification decisions. No published research has examined whether AI-generated verdicts bias the human auditors who review them. This paper proposes the first empirical study of automation bias in AI-assisted cybersecurity auditing, using the AI Cyber Assurance Agent as the research instrument. It introduces Risk-Asymmetric Automation Bias (RAAB), a framework predicting that automation bias is not uniform across AI recommendation directions: auditors override AI "Met" verdicts more readily than AI "Not Met" verdicts because the professional risk of being too lenient exceeds the risk of being too strict. The paper proposes a between-subjects experimental design with practising security assurance professionals, a 20-control stimulus set drawn from the same ITGC control framework the AI system assesses in production, and five research questions examining how AI verdict presence, AI correctness, evidence quality, control type, and individual attitudes to AI moderate the bias effect. A verdict withholding protocol — implementable directly in the researcher's existing GRC tooling pipeline — provides an immediately actionable mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究AI辅助网络安全审计中的自动化偏差，提出风险非对称自动化偏差（RAAB）框架，预测审计师对AI给出"达标"裁决更容易推翻，而对"未达标"裁决更易接受。
AI.research_question: AI生成的合规裁决是否会对审查这些裁决的人类审计师产生自动化偏差？这种偏差在不同AI推荐方向（达标 vs 未达标）上是否不对称？
AI.motivation: AI Cyber Assurance Agent已在大型电信运营商生产环境中部署，其裁决直接影响审计报告、监管申报和认证决策。然而，尚无任何已发表研究检验AI生成裁决是否会对人类审计师产生偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险非对称自动化偏差（RAAB）框架：自动化偏差并非均匀分布在不同AI推荐方向上；审计师更容易推翻AI的"达标"裁决，而更少推翻AI的"未达标"裁决，因为专业上过于宽松的风险大于过于严格的风险。
AI.method: 组间实验设计（between-subjects），以在职安全保证专业人员为被试，采用20项ITGC控制测试的刺激材料集，检验5个研究问题，涉及AI裁决存在性、AI正确性、证据质量、控制类型和个人对AI态度等调节变量。
AI.findings: 提出RAAB框架，预期发现审计师对AI"达标"裁决的推翻率高于对AI"未达标"裁决的推翻率。同时提出裁决保留协议（verdict withholding protocol）作为可行缓解措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将自动化偏差研究引入AI辅助网络安全审计领域；提出风险非对称自动化偏差（RAAB）这一新理论框架，揭示了专业风险不对称如何塑造人机交互中的偏差模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为部署AI审计工具的组织提供了经验证据，说明AI裁决可能引入的偏差风险；提出可直接实现的裁决保留协议作为缓解措施；为审计行业监管政策和AI辅助审计最佳实践提供参考。

title: Hungry Clouds: Labour Market and Environmental Externalities from Data-Intensive Development
affiliations: Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS)

detail.title: Hungry Clouds: Labour Market and Environmental Externalities from Data-Intensive Development
detail.abstract: Data centers are critical digital infrastructures whose rapid expansion creates environmental externalities through electricity and water consumption, as well as local economic impacts that remain largely unstudied. This paper provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of how data center entry affects local economies in the United States. Using novel spatial data on US data center facilities and two research designs, I present evidence that data center entry generates significant, sector-specific local effects. It increases service-sector establishments and employment, particularly in ICT, professional services, finance and real-estate, while increasing net exits of manufacturing establishments. These effects persist for around nine years post-entry. I also present evidence that suggests increased electricity costs as a potential mechanism. These findings suggest that spatial policies aimed at minimising environmental externalities of data centers need to account for their heterogeneous local economic impacts to avoid misleading welfare assessments. To quantify the welfare effects of alternative spatial policies, I develop a quantitative spatial equilibrium model that incorporates endogenous data center location choice, sector-specific local impacts on firms, and spatial heterogeneity in environmental damages of data center location. Through counterfactual analysis, I aim to evaluate the allocative efficiency of existing state tax incentives and optimal location-specific taxes.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了美国数据中心进入对地方经济的影响，发现其显著增加服务业（ICT、专业服务、金融等）的就业和机构，但导致制造业净退出，并通过提高电价等机制发挥作用。基于此构建定量空间均衡模型，评估现有税收激励和最优区位政策的福利效应。
AI.research_question: 数据中心进入如何影响美国地方经济？不同空间政策（州税收激励、区位特定税收）的福利效应如何？
AI.motivation: 数据中心快速扩张带来电力和水消耗等环境外部性，但其对地方经济的异质性影响尚未被充分研究。现有的空间政策多聚焦于最小化环境外部性，忽略了数据中心对地方经济不同部门的差异化影响，可能导致福利评估偏误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量空间均衡模型，纳入内生数据中心选址、部门特定地方影响、环境损害的空间异质性。
AI.method: 利用美国数据中心的细粒度空间数据，采用两种实证研究设计（双重差分/事件研究等），结合定量空间均衡模型进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 数据中心进入增加ICT、专业服务、金融与房地产等服务业就业与机构数，但导致制造业净退出；效应持续约9年；电价上涨是潜在机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在空间均衡框架中纳入数据中心选址的内生性、部门异质性地方影响及环境损害的空间异质性，改进了因只关注环境外部性而忽视经济异质性效应的现有政策评估模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化评估数据中心区位政策的福利效应工具；指出现有州税收激励可能存在配置无效率，建议采用考虑地方经济异质性影响的区位特定税收政策。

title: Measuring Water Misallocation in California
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)

detail.title: Measuring Water Misallocation in California
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes and applies new methods to value water rights and assess misallocation across competing uses in California, the world’s fourth largest economy. The empirical strategy combines detailed microdata on farms, evapotranspiration, historical water rights, and the hydrological flow network in order to isolate sources of inefficiency within the hydrological network, assess distributional implications of water access under current property rights, and evaluate alternative mechanisms for water reallocation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新方法评估加州水权价值及水资源错配，利用微观数据与水文网络分析效率损失与分配影响。
AI.research_question: 如何量化水权价值并评估水资源在不同用途间的错配程度？
AI.motivation: 加州作为全球第四大经济体，水资源分配效率对经济发展和民生至关重要，但现有产权制度可能导致严重错配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水权估值理论、资源错配理论、水文网络经济学。
AI.method: 结合农场微观数据、蒸散发数据、历史水权记录及水文流动网络，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 识别出水文网络内部的低效率来源，揭示当前产权下水资源分配的不平等影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了水权估值与错配分析的新方法论，拓展了资源经济学在水文网络中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加州及其他地区的水资源再分配机制设计提供了实证依据和政策参考。

title: Interest Rate Caps, Competition, and Strategic Borrowing: Evidence from Kenya
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Interest Rate Caps, Competition, and Strategic Borrowing: Evidence from Kenya
detail.abstract:
We study Kenya’s 2016 interest-rate regulation, which capped bank lending rates but left one digital platform, called M-Shwari, exempt on the lending side while imposing a deposit-rate floor across all lenders in the market. Using borrower-level administrative data, survey data, and an RD around the implementation date, we show three main results. First, lending on the exempt platform rose, but with the safest borrowers substituting away toward cheaper capped credit. Second, riskier borrowers increase their savings to build up their credit limits. Third, on the supply side, M-Shwari raises the limits for the safest borrowers in an attempt to retain them. We build and estimate a simple model of screening and credit limit-setting to interpret these reallocations and compute welfare. The observed carve-out for M-Shwari preserves access for high-risk borrowers but yields a slight aggregate welfare decline relative to pre-policy. However, a uniform (across all lenders) interest rate cap counterfactual generates substantially larger welfare losses by entirely eliminating credit for high-risk borrowers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了肯尼亚2016年利率管制政策，该政策对银行放贷利率设定了上限，但豁免了一个名为M-Shwari的数字借贷平台，同时对所有贷款机构设定了存款利率下限。研究发现：豁免平台贷款增加但最安全借款人转向更便宜的受限信贷；高风险借款人通过增加储蓄提高信用额度；平台通过提高安全借款人额度来留住客户。基于模型分析，该政策虽保留了高风险借款人的信贷渠道，但总体福利略有下降，而统一利率上限会导致更大福利损失。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚2016年利率管制政策（对银行放贷利率设上限，同时豁免M-Shwari数字借贷平台）如何影响不同类型借款人的信贷获取、储蓄行为以及平台供给策略，并产生怎样的福利效应？
AI.motivation: 利率管制政策在全球范围内被广泛采用，但其对信贷市场的影响尚不明确，尤其是在存在数字金融平台豁免条款的情况下。已有研究多关注统一利率上限的效果，对选择性豁免政策的效应缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用筛选与信用额度设定模型；福利经济学框架
AI.method: 采用借款人层面行政数据、调查数据以及围绕政策实施日期的断点回归设计（RD），同时构建并估计了信用筛选与信用额度设定的结构模型。
AI.findings: 1）M-Shwari平台贷款增加，但最安全借款人转向更便宜的受限信贷产品；2）高风险借款人通过增加储蓄提升信用额度；3）供给方面，M-Shwari提高最安全借款人额度以挽留客户；4）福利分析显示，豁免政策虽保留高风险借款人信贷渠道，但总体福利略低于政策前；统一利率上限将导致更高福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了信用筛选与信用额度设定的理论模型，揭示了利率管制下借贷双方在"豁免-受限"双重市场中的行为调整机制，为理解选择性利率管制的福利效应提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了利率管制政策设计的实证依据，表明选择性豁免（如保留数字平台）可部分缓解利率上限对高风险借款人的负面影响，但无法完全消除福利损失；统一利率上限则会造成更严重的后果。

title: When Desire Outruns Reality: The Habenular Algorithm Beneath the History of Philosophy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When Desire Outruns Reality: The Habenular Algorithm Beneath the History of Philosophy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Self
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Twenty-five centuries of philosophy, East and West, can be read as a sustained and largely unconscious project of managing a single biological event: the organismic response to the gap between desire and reality. Donald Nathanson's formulation-when desire outruns reality, shame ensues-provides the affective language for what the lateral habenula, a phylogenetically ancient structure in the epithalamic region of the diencephalon, implements neurophysiologically as negative prediction error. This position paper maps the major philosophical traditions onto that substrate, identifies three fundamental strategies-reduce desire, improve reality, reframe the gap-and argues that Silvan Tomkins' affect theory and the ethical teaching of the Beatitudes arrive, by different routes, closest to the biological bedrock. The paper concludes with Tomkins' concept of nuclear scripts, which explains not merely why we suffer but why insight so rarely resolves that suffering. Philosophy has not ended. It has, at last, located its foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文从神经生物学基础出发，提出两千五百年的东西方哲学本质上是一场管理"欲望与现实差距"这一生物事件的宏大工程。通过将Nathanson的羞耻理论、外侧缰核的负向预测误差编码、Tomkins的情感理论与《八福》伦理教导相联结，论证哲学终于找到了其生物学根基。
AI.research_question: 哲学传统的深层生物学基础是什么？东西方哲学如何从神经生物学和情感理论的角度被重新理解？
AI.motivation: 作者试图弥合哲学思辨与神经生物学之间的鸿沟，为哲学传统寻找一个统一的生物学解释框架，从而回答为什么人类普遍存在哲学思考这一根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Donald Nathanson的羞耻理论（欲望超出现实即产生羞耻）、外侧缰核（lateral habenula）的负向预测误差神经机制、Silvan Tomkins的情感理论与核脚本（nuclear scripts）概念、《八福》（Beatitudes）伦理教导。
AI.method: 立场论文（position paper），通过理论整合与概念映射的方式，将哲学传统、情感理论与神经生物学发现进行跨学科联结。
AI.findings: 哲学史可被解读为三种基本策略：减少欲望、改善现实、重构欲望与现实之间的差距；Tomkins的情感理论与《八福》伦理教导最接近生物学基础；核脚本概念解释了为什么洞见（insight）很少能真正解决人类的痛苦。
AI.theory_contributions: 为哲学传统提供了一个统一的神经生物学解释框架；将外侧缰核的负向预测误差功能与羞耻情感和哲学思考联系起来；重新定位了Tomkins情感理论在哲学-生物学对话中的地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示了哲学与神经科学交叉研究的可能方向；为理解人类痛苦的根源和"知易行难"这一古老困境提供了生物学解释。

title: On the Negative Consequences of Low-Wage Offshoring for Innovation
affiliations: Statistics Canada, York University and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: On the Negative Consequences of Low-Wage Offshoring for Innovation
detail.abstract:
Conventional wisdom holds that offshoring intermediates to China stimulates innovation. This is not entirely compelling. On the one hand, (a) offshoring lowers marginal costs and expands sales, thereby increasing the returns to innovation, especially for large firms. On the other hand, (b) offshoring low-quality intermediates reduces the costs of older-generation products, thereby reducing the returns to innovating into newer generations. We examine these two opposing forces over 2002-2011 for 6,024 Canadian firms. Our empirical strategy regresses measures of innovation, such as R&D, on imports of intermediate inputs. To address endogeneity, we construct a model-consistent shift-share instrument whose shocks are the often-dramatic improvements in the quality of HS6 Chinese intermediate inputs. We find that greater offshoring reduced R&D spending over 2002-2011 by 15% as (1) firms engaged in R&D in 2002 reduced their expenditures, and (2) firms not initially engaged in R&D were discouraged from starting up new R&D projects. Our model explains these findings: Rising quality of Chinese intermediates is a positive supply shock (rather than a negative China shock) that raises profits for all offshorers, raises innovation for the largest offshorers (channel a above), and lowers innovation for all other offshorers (channel b). These predictions are confirmed in the data.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"将中间产品外包到中国会促进创新"的传统观点，通过对2002-2011年6024家加拿大企业的分析发现，中国中间品质量提升作为正向供给冲击，总体上使企业研发支出减少了15%，仅对最大的外包企业有创新激励作用。
AI.research_question: 将中间产品外包到中国是促进还是抑制了企业的创新活动？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为外包到中国会促进创新，但这一结论并非完全成立。外包同时存在两种相反的力量：（a）降低边际成本、扩大销售，增加创新回报；（b）低成本低质量中间品降低了旧产品的成本，减少了向新一代产品创新的回报。作者希望系统性地检验这两种力量的净效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文构建了一个包含两种对立机制的理论模型：（1）正向渠道——外包降低边际成本、扩大规模，提高创新回报（尤其对大型企业）；（2）负向渠道——低质量中间品降低旧产品生产成本，削弱升级创新的动力。中国中间品质量提升被视为正向供给冲击，而非传统的"中国冲击"。
AI.method: 采用2002-2011年6024家加拿大企业的面板数据，以研发支出等创新指标作为因变量，以中间品进口为核心解释变量。为解决内生性问题，构建了基于模型一致性的shift-share工具变量，其冲击来源是中国HS6位码中间品质量的显著提升。
AI.findings: （1）总体上，外包使企业研发支出在2002-2011年间减少了15%；（2）原本从事研发的企业减少了研发投入；（3）原本不从事研发的企业更不愿意启动新的研发项目；（4）仅对最大的外包企业有创新促进作用，其余企业创新均受抑制。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）挑战并修正了"外包促进创新"的传统观点，揭示其净效应为负；（2）提出了外包影响创新的双重机制模型（规模效应 vs. 替代效应），解释了不同规模企业的异质性反应；（3）将中国中间品质量提升重新定义为正向供给冲击，区别于传统的负向"中国冲击"叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供警示：依赖中国中间品外包可能抑制本土企业创新，尤其是中小企业的研发投入；（2）建议企业在制定外包战略时需权衡短期成本节约与长期创新能力之间的关系；（3）为发展中国家或新兴市场的政策评估提供了经验证据。

title: The Postpandemic U.S. Immigration Surge: New Facts and Inflationary Implications
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, , Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas

detail.title: The Postpandemic U.S. Immigration Surge: New Facts and Inflationary Implications
detail.abstract:
The U.S. experienced an extraordinary surge in immigration from 2021 to 2024, which triggered widespread discussions about its macroeconomic impact, particularly on inflation. To determine the impact of the immigration surge, we first document the salient features of these new immigrants: they are primarily low-skilled relative to the existing workforce and more likely to be hand-to-mouth consumers. We then incorporate these features into a heterogeneous agent model with capital-skill complementarity. We find that the supply- and demand-side effects of the immigration surge roughly cancel out, causing a negligible response of inflation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2021-2024年美国移民激增对通胀的影响，发现供给和需求效应大致抵消，通胀响应可忽略不计。
AI.research_question: 2021-2024年美国移民激增对通货膨胀有何宏观经济影响？
AI.motivation: 美国在2021-2024年经历了非同寻常的移民激增，引发了关于其宏观经济影响（尤其是对通胀影响）的广泛讨论，需要严谨的量化分析来回答这一政策关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体模型（Heterogeneous Agent Model），资本-技能互补性（Capital-Skill Complementarity）。
AI.method: 首先通过数据描述新移民的特征（低技能为主、更多为月光族消费者），然后将这些特征纳入带有资本-技能互补性的异质性主体模型，进行定量模拟分析。
AI.findings: 移民激增的供给效应（劳动力增加压低工资和成本）与需求效应（消费增加推高价格）大致相互抵消，导致通胀的净响应可忽略不计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将移民特征（低技能、高边际消费倾向）与资本-技能互补性相结合，拓展了异质性主体模型在移民宏观经济学中的应用，揭示了供需效应相互抵消的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于大规模移民对通胀影响的量化证据，缓解了公众对移民激增会显著推高通胀的担忧。

title: Competitive Exposure and Entrepreneurial Experimentation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Competitive Exposure and Entrepreneurial Experimentation
detail.abstract:
Entrepreneurs learn by experimenting, but experiment choices are often public. A closed beta, private pilot, or public launch not only generates evidence; it also reveals what kind of entrepreneur would choose that action. We develop a dynamic model in which a founder chooses between stealthy and public experiments while potential entrants infer from both actions and outcomes. Public outcomes are modelled as garblings of the founder's private experimental evidence, so public leakage informs outsiders without giving the founder information beyond the private signal already observed. The key state variable is competitive exposure: the public runway before entry becomes attractive. Exposure is depleted by two forces, leakage burn from public outcomes, and action burn from public inference about experiment choice. This distinction implies that competition can distort experiment design without forcing earlier scale: lower-confidence founders choose stealthier tests, while higher-confidence founders spend exposure to obtain faster private learning through more public tests. Scale is accelerated only when exposure reduces the value of waiting more than it reduces the value of scaling. Finally, exogenous funding gates make observable scale more selective and, therefore, more informative to entrants. The analysis shows that entrepreneurial experimentation is not merely private learning under uncertainty; it is public action under competitive inference.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个动态模型，研究创业者在选择秘密实验（如封闭测试）与公开实验（如公开发布）时，如何被潜在进入者通过行为和结果进行推断，揭示了竞争性曝光作为关键状态变量如何影响实验设计、规模决策和融资节奏。
AI.research_question: 创业者的实验选择（秘密vs公开）如何受到竞争性进入者推断的影响？竞争性曝光如何塑造实验设计、规模化时机和融资门槛？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多将创业实验视为私人学习过程，但现实中实验选择往往是公开的，会向潜在竞争者传递信号。本文旨在弥补这一理论空白，将竞争性推断纳入创业实验决策模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态信号博弈模型；公开结果作为私人实验证据的"加噪"（garbling）；竞争性曝光（competitive exposure）作为关键状态变量；泄漏燃烧（leakage burn）与行动燃烧（action burn）的双重耗损机制。
AI.method: 动态理论建模，通过数学推导分析创业者在不同信心水平下的实验选择均衡，以及竞争性曝光对实验设计、规模化决策和融资门槛的影响。
AI.findings: （1）竞争可以扭曲实验设计而不必迫使提前规模化：低信心创始人选择更隐蔽的测试，高信心创始人通过更公开的测试换取快速私人学习；（2）规模化加速仅发生在曝光降低了等待价值大于降低规模化价值时；（3）外生融资门槛使可观测的规模化行为更具选择性，从而对进入者传递更丰富的信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 将竞争性推断引入创业实验理论，区分了"泄漏燃烧"（来自公开结果）和"行动燃烧"（来自对实验选择的推断）两种竞争性曝光耗损机制，揭示了实验选择本身作为信号的经济学含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者在秘密与公开实验策略之间的权衡提供了理论指导，帮助理解不同信心水平下的最优实验设计；对投资者设计融资门槛和加速器项目安排具有启示意义。

title: Opt In? Opt Out?
affiliations: Harvard University, Boston University and Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: Opt In? Opt Out?
detail.abstract:
Cadaveric organ shortages leave thousands without life-saving transplants each year. Countries differ in using opt-in (informed consent) or opt-out (presumed consent) systems for donor registration. Using newly assembled cross-country panel data and an event-study design, this paper provides evidence that presumed-consent laws increase organ donation only when strictly enforced and family veto power is limited; weak opt-out regimes show negligible or even negative effects. A theoretical signaling model provides a plausible mechanism when opt-in or opt-out yields more donations, emphasizing the roles of donation propensity, signaling costs, and the family’s ability to overturn defaults. A large laboratory experiment further tests these mechanisms, showing that opt-in generally produces equal or higher donation rates unless signaling is costly and family veto power is minimal. The results underscore that defaults alone rarely increase donations unless paired with strong institutional enforcement.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨国面板数据、理论模型和实验室实验，研究发现默认同意（opt-out）器官捐献制度只有在严格执法且限制家属否决权时才能提高捐献率，否则效果微弱甚至为负；而明确同意（opt-in）制度在多数情况下表现相当或更好。
AI.research_question: 默认同意（opt-out）与明确同意（opt-in）两种器官捐献登记制度，哪种能更有效地提高实际器官捐献率？其作用机制和制度约束条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球每年有成千上万人因器官短缺而无法获得移植救治，各国采用不同的捐献同意制度（opt-in vs. opt-out），但现有证据对哪种制度更有效存在争议，且缺乏对制度执行强度和家属否决权等约束条件的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递模型（signaling model），强调捐献倾向（donation propensity）、信号成本（signaling costs）以及家属推翻默认选择的能力（family veto power）三个关键机制。
AI.method: 三种方法互补：① 跨国面板数据的双重差分/事件研究设计；② 理论信号传递模型；③ 实验室实验。
AI.findings: ① 默认同意制度只有在严格执法且家属否决权有限时才能提高捐献率；宽松的opt-out制度效果微弱甚至为负。② 实验室实验中，opt-in制度在大多数情况下产生相等或更高的捐献率，除非信号成本高且家属否决权很低。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了默认效应对器官捐献的作用边界条件——制度执行强度和家属否决权是决定性调节变量；提出了信号传递机制解释不同制度效果的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确的制度设计建议：单纯改变默认选项不足以提高器官捐献率，必须搭配严格执法和限制家属否决权等配套制度。

title: Extreme Equilibria: The Benefits of Correlation
affiliations: Analysis Group, Princeton University and Princeton University

detail.title: Extreme Equilibria: The Benefits of Correlation
detail.abstract:
Correlated equilibria arise naturally when agents communicate or rely on intermediaries such as recommendation systems. We study when a given Nash equilibrium can be improved within the set of correlated equilibria for general objectives. Our key insight is a detail-free criterion: any Nash equilibrium with three or more randomizing agents is generically improvable. We refine this insight to specific classes of games and objectives, including Pareto and utilitarian welfare, and provide constructive methods to obtain improvements. Our findings underscore the ubiquity of improvable Nash equilibria and the crucial role of correlation in enhancing strategic outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在一般目标下，只要存在三个或以上随机化行为的代理人，任何纳什均衡都能在关联均衡集合中被改进，并提供了具体的构造方法。
AI.research_question: 在关联均衡集合中，给定的纳什均衡何时可以被改进？
AI.motivation: 当代理人通过沟通或依赖推荐系统等中介互动时，自然会产生关联均衡。研究纳什均衡能否在关联均衡中被改进，有助于理解相关性在提升战略结果中的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关联均衡理论、纳什均衡改进准则、帕累托最优与社会福利函数
AI.method: 理论证明（无细节依赖的通用准则）、分类分析（针对不同博弈类型和目标函数）、构造性方法
AI.findings: 任何包含三个或以上随机化代理人的纳什均衡在一般意义下都是可改进的；针对帕累托改进和功利主义社会福利等特定目标，提供了具体的改进构造方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个无需细节信息的通用准则，揭示了纳什均衡在关联均衡中可改进的普遍性，拓展了对均衡关系与相关性作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为推荐系统、通信协议等依赖中介的互动场景提供了改进策略设计的理论基础与构造方法，有助于提升实际博弈中的整体绩效。

title: The Causal Effects of Expected Depreciations
affiliations: Inter-American Development Bank, University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Universidad de los Andes and Inter-American Development Bank

detail.title: The Causal Effects of Expected Depreciations
detail.abstract:
We construct a novel measure of one-year-ahead exchange rate forecasts and nowcasts for non-financial firms. We then study a randomized information intervention that provides a subset of firms with a publicly available exchange rate forecast. This information treatment persistently shifts exchange rate expectations and perceptions, with stronger effects for non-exporting firms. We link survey responses with administrative customs data and estimate a positive intertemporal elasticity of import demand to exogenous changes in expected future exchange rates. Our findings highlight the role of intertemporal substitution after anticipated changes in trade costs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建非金融企业一年期汇率预测指标，并进行随机信息干预实验，发现提供公开汇率预测会持久改变企业的汇率预期和认知，且对非出口企业影响更大。结合调查与海关数据，估计出进口需求对预期汇率变化的跨期弹性为正，凸显了预期贸易成本变化下的跨期替代作用。
AI.research_question: 非金融企业的汇率预期如何形成？提供公开汇率预测信息会如何影响企业的汇率预期、认知及其进口决策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对企业层面的汇率预期形成机制及其对实际贸易行为的影响知之甚少，尤其是缺乏因果证据。本研究通过随机信息干预实验，旨在识别外部信息对企业汇率预期的因果效应，并量化预期汇率变化对进口需求的跨期弹性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期理论、信息粘性理论、跨期替代理论（预期贸易成本变化下的进口需求跨期弹性）
AI.method: 构建非金融企业一年期汇率预测与即时预测指标；随机信息干预实验（向部分企业提供公开汇率预测）；将企业调查数据与行政海关数据匹配；估计进口需求的跨期弹性。
AI.findings: 1. 信息干预持久地改变了企业的汇率预期和认知，对非出口企业影响更强；2. 预期未来汇率的变化对进口需求具有正向的跨期弹性，即企业会根据预期的汇率变动（贸易成本变化）调整进口时机。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了企业层面汇率预期形成的信息摩擦与干预效应的因果证据；揭示了预期汇率变动通过跨期替代渠道影响进口需求的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业汇率风险管理、央行汇率沟通策略以及贸易政策制定提供了微观层面的实证依据；表明公开汇率预测信息可以影响企业实际贸易行为。

title: Authority Figures and the Polarization of Gender Norms
affiliations: American University of Beirut, Boston University - Department of Economics, Simon Fraser University (SFU), World Bank - Development Impact and Simon Fraser University (SFU)

detail.title: Authority Figures and the Polarization of Gender Norms
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how authority figures in higher education shape gender norms over the long run. We exploit the random assignment of first-year students to faculty advisors at an elite university in the Middle East and combine administrative records with an alumni survey measuring gender attitudes up to 24 years later. Women assigned to female advisors adopt more egalitarian views about politics and work, while men become more conservative. These effects are strongest among religious students and in male-dominated STEM fields, where female authority is especially counter-stereotypical. The effects may persist through reinforcement, as women assigned to female advisors later sort toward female instructors and more gender-themed courses. Our results do not appear to be driven by generic exposure to successful women. Instead, they point to a distinct role for authority in transmitting gender norms: randomized exposure to high-achieving female peers has little effect, while the largest impacts come from senior and high-value-added female advisors. A simple framework combining belief updating and identity-based status threat helps explain these patterns of female empowerment and male backlash. More broadly, our findings reveal a progress paradox whereby gains in female representation in elite authority expand opportunities for women while intensifying backlash among men, thereby deepening gender polarization.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用某中东精英大学新生随机分配导师的自然实验，发现女性导师长期影响学生性别观念：女生变得更平等，男生变得更保守，尤其在宗教学生和STEM领域。这种效应通过后期课程选择强化，且源于权威角色而非同辈影响，揭示了女性权威代表进步与男性反冲并存的"进步悖论"。
AI.research_question: 高等教育中的权威人物如何长期塑造学生的性别规范？
AI.motivation: 以往研究关注同辈或榜样对学生观念的短期影响，但对权威角色（如导师）的长期效应及其机制（特别是男性和女性可能存在的差异化反应）缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念更新理论（belief updating）与基于身份的地位威胁理论（identity-based status threat）：女性接触女性权威会更新对女性能力的信念从而更平等；男性则因地位威胁而产生反冲，变得更为保守。
AI.method: 利用某中东精英大学新生随机分配导师的自然实验，将行政数据与最长24年后的校友调查数据结合，采用随机分配带来的因果识别策略。
AI.findings: （1）女性被分配到女性导师后，对政治和工作的性别观念更平等；男性则变得更保守。（2）效应在宗教学生和男性主导的STEM领域最强，因女性权威在这些情境下更具反刻板印象性。（3）女性导师通过后期选课（更多女性教师和性别主题课程）强化效应。（4）效应并非来自接触成功女性同辈，而是来自高级别、高附加值的女性导师权威角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"进步悖论"：女性在精英权威中的代表性提升既为女性创造机会，又强化男性反冲，加深性别极化。结合信念更新与地位威胁理论解释了不对称的性别效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育中女性导师的配置和性别平等政策提供因果证据：增加女性权威代表虽有益于女性，但需配套措施缓解男性反冲，避免性别极化加剧。

title: How does Medicare Eligibility affect Choice and Utilization? Evidence from Veterans
affiliations: University of California, Irvine, Department of Veterans Affairs and Stanford University - VA Palo Alto Health Care System

detail.title: How does Medicare Eligibility affect Choice and Utilization? Evidence from Veterans
detail.abstract:
We examine how Medicare affects health care utilization for those who age in with a more narrow health insurance network by studying veterans enrolled in the Veterans Health Administration (VA). Given the limited geographic density of VA hospitals, we posit that Medicare expands the insurance network for VA enrollees. Using regression discontinuity methods, we find that veterans' inpatient hospitalization rate increases by approximately 3.3 percent at 65. Further, there are large reallocations across health insurance payers. Individuals increasingly use Medicare for hospitalizations once it becomes available, while VA, commercial, and other federal insurance programs are used less. We also find substantial reallocations among individuals that gain access to hospitals closer to their homes and among those who visit the hospital for more postponeable medical procedures. However, we do not find evidence that the average quality rating of the hospital selected at 65 changes nor do we find evidence that VA hospital wait times affect the move to Medicare; rather, individuals choose hospitals that are relatively closer. Lastly, our results suggest that Medicare may compete with other federal programs to provide health care for select populations, such as veterans.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过研究退伍军人从仅使用VA医疗系统过渡到同时享受Medicare（65岁）的过程，发现Medicare扩大了保险网络，使得住院率增加约3.3%，并导致保险支付方的大规模重新分配（更多使用Medicare，减少使用VA和其他保险），患者倾向于选择离家更近的医院，但医院平均质量评级没有显著变化。
AI.research_question: Medicare如何影响那些原本拥有较窄医疗保险网络（VA退伍军人健康管理局）的人群的医疗利用行为？
AI.motivation: VA系统的地理密度有限，因此当退伍军人满65岁获得Medicare资格时，实际上拓宽了其可获得的医疗服务网络。这一自然实验有助于理解保险网络广度对医疗服务利用的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保险网络理论、医疗利用行为理论、医疗服务竞争理论
AI.method: 使用断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity），以65岁为阈值，对比VA退伍军人在获得Medicare前后的医疗利用变化。
AI.findings: 1. 65岁后住院率增加约3.3%；2. 保险支付方发生大规模重新分配：Medicare使用增加，VA、商业保险等减少；3. 患者倾向于选择离家更近的医院；4. 更多进行可推迟的医疗程序；5. 医院平均质量评级无显著变化；6. VA等待时间不影响转向Medicare的决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了保险网络扩展如何影响医疗利用的边际变化，以及不同公共保险计划之间的替代和竞争关系，丰富了医疗保健利用和保险设计的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了Medicare与VA等联邦医疗计划之间竞争与互补关系的实证证据，有助于优化多保险体系下的资源配置和医疗服务网络设计。

title: Secondary Markets for VC-Backed Startup Equity
affiliations: Owen Graduate School of Management at Vanderbilt University,  and Vanderbilt University - Finance

detail.title: Secondary Markets for VC-Backed Startup Equity
detail.abstract: This paper provides the first systematic evidence on secondary markets for equity in VC-backed startups, a fast-growing segment of private capital markets. Using proprietary data from a large intermediary, we show that shares typically trade at a discount to prior venture capital valuations, with discounts narrowing when buyer demand is strong. We find that market activity responds to new information: in an event study, order flow and prices react quickly to VC financing events. Furthermore, secondary prices are forward-looking and predict future VC valuations. These signals are partially incorporated by mutual funds valuing their startup holdings. By providing both liquidity and price discovery, secondary markets are becoming an integral part of private capital markets, and their importance is likely to grow as startups remain private longer.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了风投支持初创企业股权的二级市场，发现股票通常以低于先前风投估值的折价交易，市场活动对新信息反应迅速，二级市场价格具有前瞻性并能预测未来风投估值。
AI.research_question: 风投支持初创企业的股权二级市场如何运作？其价格发现功能和流动性提供作用如何？
AI.motivation: 初创企业保持私有状态的时间越来越长，二级市场作为私人资本市场中快速增长的部分，其重要性与日俱增，但此前缺乏系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格发现理论、市场效率理论、信息传导机制
AI.method: 使用来自大型中介机构的专有数据，通过事件研究法分析市场对VC融资事件的反应，并检验二级价格对未来VC估值的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1) 二级市场股票通常以低于风投估值的折价交易，买方需求强劲时折价收窄；2) 市场活动对新信息反应迅速，订单流和价格能快速响应VC融资事件；3) 二级价格具有前瞻性，能预测未来VC估值；4) 共同基金在估值其持有的初创企业时部分吸收了这些价格信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示了私人资本市场中二级市场的价格发现功能，补充了关于非公开市场信息效率的理论，证明二级市场在风投估值形成中扮演重要角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者（包括共同基金）在估值初创企业时提供参考依据；为初创企业、风投机构和二级市场参与者理解市场定价机制提供实证基础；为监管机构理解私人资本市场的运作提供洞见。

title: Separations Revisited: Do Layoffs or Quits Drive Lower Separation Rates in High-Quality Firms?
affiliations: Georgetown University, CEMFI and Centre for Monetary and Financial Studies (CEMFI)

detail.title: Separations Revisited: Do Layoffs or Quits Drive Lower Separation Rates in High-Quality Firms?
detail.abstract:
A well-known empirical regularity is that high-productivity firms have lower worker separation rates, but it is unclear whether this pattern reflects quits or layoffs. Using matched employer-employee data from Brazil that distinguish the reason for each separation, we show that the productivity-separation gradient is driven primarily by layoffs rather than quits. We then propose and test a mechanism in which downward wage rigidity prevents firms from adjusting wages in response to adverse shocks, causing those shocks to translate into layoffs. High-productivity firms are less exposed because their larger markdowns provide a buffer between productivity and wages. Consistent with this mechanism, we find that firms with higher markdowns have lower layoff rates, and that markets with stronger wage rigidity exhibit both higher layoff rates and a steeper productivity-layoff gradient. These findings suggest that productivity differences across firms shape not only wages, but also workers' exposure to job loss.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 高生产率企业的员工离职率更低，但这一现象主要由裁员（而非主动辞职）驱动。机制在于：向下工资刚性阻止企业根据负面冲击调整工资，导致冲击转化为裁员；高生产率企业因拥有更大的加价幅度（markdowns）作为缓冲，因此裁员率更低。
AI.research_question: 高生产率企业员工分离率更低的现象，究竟是由主动辞职还是裁员驱动？背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有文献发现高生产率企业员工分离率更低，但未能区分这是由员工主动辞职还是企业裁员导致的，因此无法准确理解生产率与劳动力流动之间的关系及其背后的经济机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向下工资刚性（Downward Wage Rigidity）；加价幅度（Markdowns）缓冲机制。
AI.method: 使用巴西雇主-员工匹配数据（区分每次离职的原因），结合实证分析与机制检验。
AI.findings: （1）生产率-离职梯度主要由裁员驱动，而非主动辞职；（2）高生产率企业因加价幅度更大，能在负面冲击下提供缓冲，从而裁员率更低；（3）加价幅度越高的企业裁员率越低；（4）工资刚性越强的市场，裁员率越高且生产率-裁员梯度越陡。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生产率差异如何通过工资刚性与加价幅度影响工人失业风险，将企业生产率异质性与劳动力市场风险分配联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解企业裁员行为的微观基础提供依据，提示工资刚性政策可能影响不同生产率企业的就业稳定性。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Intellectual Property Governance: Challenges for Public Administration Meenaz,independent researcher, May,2026
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Intellectual Property Governance: Challenges for Public Administration Meenaz,independent researcher, May,2026

declarations.funderStatement: Self funded

detail.abstract: This study examines the intersection of artificial intelligence, intellectual property, and public administration and exploring how AI helps reshaping innovation processes and regulatory frameworks. Through a mixed-method approach, combining a systematic literature review and expert insights, the research explores AI's disruptive impact on IP regimes and administrative governance. The findings reveal a gap between traditional IP laws and the rapid pace of AI innovation, highlighting the urgent need for public institutions to develop flexible and adaptive governance models. Based on the previous insights, this paper offers concrete policy recommendations to ensure AI's integration into IP governance is ethical, accountable, transparent, and aligned with public interests.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了人工智能、知识产权与公共行政的交叉领域，分析AI如何重塑创新流程与监管框架。采用混合方法（系统文献综述+专家意见），发现传统知识产权法律与AI创新速度之间存在鸿沟，呼吁公共机构建立灵活、适应性强的治理模式，并提出政策建议以确保AI融入IP治理时符合伦理、问责、透明及公共利益。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响知识产权制度与公共行政治理，以及如何在AI驱动下重塑创新流程与监管框架？
AI.motivation: 传统知识产权法律难以跟上AI创新的快速发展，存在制度滞后与治理缺口，亟需探索适应性治理模式以应对AI带来的颠覆性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权理论、公共行政理论、创新治理理论、适应性治理理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：系统文献综述 + 专家意见（专家洞察）
AI.findings: 传统IP法律与AI创新速度之间存在显著差距；公共机构亟需发展灵活、适应性的治理模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI对传统知识产权理论的挑战，拓展了适应性治理在AI与IP交叉领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体政策建议，确保AI融入IP治理时符合伦理、问责、透明与公共利益原则。

title: Earnings Management and Price Informativeness
affiliations: Stanford University,  and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Earnings Management and Price Informativeness
detail.abstract:
We investigate the relationship between stock prices and future earnings in China's A-share market. In the cross-section, firms with higher market valuations report higher earnings over the subsequent one to five years, suggesting that stock prices contain information about future fundamentals. In the time series, however, we find evidence of earnings reversal: higher stock prices predict weaker earnings growth three to five years ahead, consistent with short-term earnings management induced by stock-price pressures. We further document such earnings management through non-recurring gains and losses (NRGLs) and use the 2020 delisting rule reform as a natural experiment to examine these mechanisms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中国A股市场中股价与未来盈利的关系，发现横截面上高估值公司未来盈利更高，但时间序列上高股价预测三到五年后盈利下滑，表明存在短期盈余管理行为。进一步通过非经常性损益（NRGLs）和2020年退市制度改革自然实验验证了这一机制。
AI.research_question: 中国A股市场中，股价与未来盈利之间存在怎样的关系？股价是否包含关于未来基本面的信息？
AI.motivation: 探究新兴市场（中国）中股价的信息含量，以及股价压力是否导致管理层进行短期盈余管理行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股价信息含量理论、盈余管理理论、市场有效性理论
AI.method: 横截面回归分析、时间序列分析、非经常性损益（NRGLs）检验、2020年退市制度改革作为自然实验
AI.findings: 横截面上高估值公司未来1-5年盈利更高；时间序列上高股价预测3-5年后盈利下滑（盈利反转）；企业通过非经常性损益进行盈余管理；2020年退市制度改革影响了这一机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新兴市场中股价与盈利关系的横截面与时间序列非对称性，丰富了盈余管理动机理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别和防范上市公司短期盈余管理行为提供参考；为投资者理解中国股市定价机制提供实证依据。

title: Bachelors Without Bachelor's: Gender Gaps in Education and Declining Marriage Rates
affiliations: Yale University, Cornell University and Harvard University

detail.title: Bachelors Without Bachelor's: Gender Gaps in Education and Declining Marriage Rates
detail.abstract:
Over the past half-century, U.S. four-year colleges have shifted from enrolling mostly men to enrolling mostly women, while the economic position of non-college men has weakened markedly. We examine how these changes correspond with the evolving structure of marriage markets across cohorts and places. As college men have become increasingly scarce, college women have maintained stable marriage rates by marrying high-earning non-college men. This shift—combined with the broader economic decline of non-college men—has sharply reduced the pool of economically stable partners available to non-college women: the share of non-college men who earn above the national median and are not married to college women has fallen by more than 50%. Cross-area evidence shows that education gaps in marriage are smaller where non-college men face lower rates of joblessness and incarceration. Taken together, the evidence suggests that deteriorating outcomes for men have primarily undermined the marriage prospects of non-college women.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 过去50年，美国四年制大学从男性为主转向女性为主，同时非大学男性的经济地位显著下滑。大学学历女性通过与高收入非大学男性结婚维持了稳定的婚姻率，但这导致非大学女性的经济稳定伴侣池大幅缩减（减少超过50%）。跨地区证据表明，非大学男性失业率和监禁率越低，教育婚姻差距越小。总体而言，男性境况恶化主要损害了非大学女性的婚姻前景。
AI.research_question: 大学性别比例变化和男性经济地位下滑如何影响不同教育背景女性的婚姻市场前景？
AI.motivation: 过去半个世纪，美国四年制大学从多数为男性转变为多数为女性，同时非大学男性的经济地位显著恶化。这两个趋势如何交织影响婚姻市场结构尚不清楚，因此本文探究这些变化对不同群体婚姻前景的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婚姻市场匹配理论、教育梯度与婚姻选择、劳动力市场与婚姻市场互动
AI.method: 跨队列与跨地区比较分析，使用美国人口普查和当前人口调查（CPS）数据，考察不同出生队列和地区间婚姻市场结构的变化
AI.findings: （1）大学男性变得稀缺，但大学女性通过与高收入非大学男性结婚维持了稳定的结婚率；（2）非大学女性的经济稳定伴侣池大幅缩减，非大学男性中收入超过全国中位数且未与大学女性结婚的比例下降了超过50%；（3）跨地区证据显示，非大学男性失业率和监禁率越低的地方，教育婚姻差距越小。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了教育性别比例变化与男性经济地位下滑对婚姻市场的差异化影响机制，特别是识别出非大学女性群体受到的冲击最为严重。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国婚姻市场结构变化、教育性别差距的社会后果以及低收入群体的家庭形成困境提供实证依据，对政策制定者关注非大学男性的就业和监禁问题具有启示意义。

title: The Persistence of Power: How Family Origins Shape Political Representation and Policy
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, University of Texas at Austin, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: The Persistence of Power: How Family Origins Shape Political Representation and Policy
detail.abstract:
In the United States, long hailed as the land of opportunity, is access to political office truly open across society, or do the most privileged children disproportionately rise to enter political life? This question speaks to a longstanding concern that elite families may entrench themselves in positions of power, reproducing a form of hereditary privilege within a democratic system. We study the family backgrounds of U.S. politicians over the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries and show that children from wealthy and privileged households have been substantially overrepresented in elected office. This imbalance has changed little over time and, at the highest levels of office, varies little across political parties. To test whether political access depends on family resources, we exploit the sudden economic shock caused by the end of slavery. Despite the large and concentrated losses at the top of the wealth distribution, the children of slaveholders continued to enter government at high rates. Finally, we examine whether politicians' socioeconomic origins shape policy by constructing a new sample of close elections linked to detailed information on U.S. House candidates' family backgrounds. Comparing otherwise similar districts in which a candidate from a high socioeconomic status family narrowly wins rather than loses, we find that districts represented by higher status candidates are less likely to support pro-tax positions in roll-call voting. Together, the evidence across our analyses shows that family background strongly predicts entry into political office and has measurable consequences for policy choices.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了19世纪末20世纪初美国政治家的家庭背景，发现富裕和特权家庭的子女在民选职位中占比过高，且这种不平等随时间变化不大。即使奴隶制终结导致上层财富遭受巨大冲击，奴隶主的子女仍以高比例进入政府。此外，出身高社会地位家庭的议员在税收投票中更不支持加税立场，说明家庭背景不仅影响政治准入，还对政策选择产生可衡量的影响。
AI.research_question: 在美国这个被誉为"机会之地"的国家，政治职位的获取是否真正向社会各阶层开放，还是说最特权的子女能够不成比例地进入政治生活？
AI.motivation: 长期以来人们担忧精英家庭可能通过权力世袭在民主体系中形成特权继承，本文旨在检验美国政治中是否存在这种不平等现象及其政策后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治精英再生产理论、代际优势传递理论
AI.method: 历史数据分析（19世纪末20世纪初美国政治家家庭背景数据）、利用奴隶制终结作为外生经济冲击的准自然实验、结合候选人家庭背景信息与选举结果数据的断点回归设计
AI.findings: 1）富裕和特权家庭子女在民选职位中显著超额代表，且这种不均衡长期未改变；2）即使奴隶制终结导致大量财富损失，奴隶主子女仍持续高比例参政；3）出身高社会经济地位家庭的议员在税收投票中更不支持加税立场。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政治精英再生产理论提供了美国历史背景下的实证证据，揭示了家庭背景在民主政治准入中的持续作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了美国政治体系中代际特权问题的严重性，指出家庭背景不仅影响谁能够进入政坛，还实质性影响税收等关键政策的制定方向。

title: Youth Mental Health and School Smartphone Bans: Early Evidence
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research

detail.title: Youth Mental Health and School Smartphone Bans: Early Evidence
detail.abstract:
This paper is the first to examine the causal effects of school smartphone bans on the mental health of youth in the US. Time series data show that the mental health of youth has been declining for the past decade. Several researchers argue that easy access to social media and other internet sites provided by smartphones is to blame. To provide causal evidence of the effects of these bans, I rely on synthetic difference-in-difference models and the National Survey of Children’s Health (NSCH) from 2016 to 2024. Currently, there are data for only one state with two post-ban periods and two states with one post-ban period, which makes the results preliminary evidence only. The outcome variables are screentime and measures of psychological wellbeing. Overall, these early results provide no clear evidence that the school ban policy reduced screentime or improved psychological wellbeing. Future studies with additional years of data, when they are available, are needed to increase power and to estimate the longer-term effects of school bans on youth mental health.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文首次利用合成双重差分模型和2016-2024年全国儿童健康调查数据，研究美国校园智能手机禁令对青少年心理健康的因果影响，初步发现禁令并未显著减少屏幕时间或改善心理健康。
AI.research_question: 美国校园智能手机禁令对青少年心理健康和屏幕时间是否存在因果影响？
AI.motivation: 过去十年青少年心理健康持续下滑，部分研究者认为智能手机提供的社交媒体和互联网便利是罪魁祸首，但目前缺乏校园禁令因果效应的直接证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 屏幕时间与心理健康关系的因果推断；学校政策干预的效果评估。
AI.method: 采用合成双重差分模型（synthetic difference-in-differences），使用2016-2024年全国儿童健康调查（NSCH）数据。
AI.findings: 初步结果显示，校园智能手机禁令并未明显减少青少年屏幕时间，也未能显著改善其心理健康状况。该发现仅为初步证据，因仅有一个州有两个禁令后时期、两个州有一个禁令后时期，数据量有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为美国校园智能手机禁令对青少年心理健康的因果效应提供实证证据，填补了该领域因果推断的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者具有警示意义：简单地实施校园手机禁令可能不足以解决青少年心理健康问题，需要更全面的干预策略。同时指出未来需要更多年份数据以评估长期效果。

title: How Much of Mortgage Default Reflects Life Events? Evidence on Causal Attribution under Probabilistic Behavior
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and University of California Berkeley

detail.title: How Much of Mortgage Default Reflects Life Events? Evidence on Causal Attribution under Probabilistic Behavior
detail.abstract: We develop a latent structural propensity model of mortgage default that separates incentives from execution and characterizes causal attribution when default behavior is probabilistic. In this setting, observed outcomes no longer reveal their underlying cause, and attribution depends on behavioral responses and the informativeness of comparison groups. We show that commonly used benchmark-based attribution methods need not recover the underlying causal share and can overstate the role of life events. Because the benchmark-based estimator is nonlinear in observable moments, aggregation across heterogeneous environments introduces additional distortion, so causal shares are not identified from benchmark comparisons alone.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个潜在结构违约模型，将违约激励与执行分离，分析在违约行为概率化时如何归因因果关系，发现基于基准的归因方法可能高估生活事件的作用且无法识别因果份额。
AI.research_question: 在抵押贷款违约行为呈概率化的情况下，如何正确进行因果归因？传统基于基准的比较方法是否能够准确识别违约的因果来源？
AI.motivation: 现有违约归因方法通常假设观测结果直接反映其潜在原因，但实际中违约行为是概率性的，导致观测结果无法直接揭示原因，需要更精确的归因模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在结构倾向模型（Latent Structural Propensity Model），将违约激励（incentives）与执行（execution）分离，结合贝叶斯归因理论和比较组信息性分析。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与推导，比较不同归因方法（基准法 vs. 因果法）的估计性质，分析异质性环境下的聚合偏差。
AI.findings: （1）基于基准的归因方法无法恢复真实的因果份额，可能高估生活事件的作用；（2）基准估计量是非线性的，在异质性环境下聚合会引入额外偏差，因此仅凭基准比较无法识别因果份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了将违约激励与执行分离的潜在结构模型，揭示了基准归因方法在概率性违约场景下的根本性局限，为因果归因理论提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和政策制定者提供了更准确的违约归因方法指导，避免高估不可控因素（如生活事件）的因果作用，从而优化风险管理和政策干预设计。
