affiliations: University of Illinois at Springfield

detail.title: Strengthening Disaster Response in Illinois: How Universities and Community Organizations Build Local Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute of Government and Public Affairs Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Illinois Institute of Government & Public Affairs Policy Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Illinois faces mounting threats from both natural disasters and public health emergencies. The state has experienced a sharp rise in billion-dollar weather events and recorded over 40,000 deaths from COVID-19. This policy brief examines how universities and community organizations contributed to Illinois’s capacity for disaster response, drawing on interviews with 29 emergency professionals across 10 counties. The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) advocates a whole community approach, emphasizing collaboration among government agencies, private organizations, nonprofits, and individuals to enhance disaster resilience (Dai & Azhar, 2024; Kapucu et al., 2010). While many partnerships proved essential during the pandemic, persistent challenges remain. These include gaps in volunteer systems, resource disparities between rural and urban counties, and insufficient training for novel disaster scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了伊利诺伊州大学和社区组织在应对自然灾害和公共卫生紧急事件中的作用，基于对10个县29名应急专业人员的访谈，发现合作伙伴关系至关重要，但仍存在志愿者系统缺口、城乡资源差异和新灾难场景培训不足等挑战。
AI.research_question: 大学和社区组织如何为伊利诺伊州的灾害应对能力做出贡献？
AI.motivation: 伊利诺伊州面临自然灾害（如十亿美元级天气事件增加）和公共卫生紧急事件（超过4万新冠死亡病例）的双重威胁，需要评估现有合作模式的成效与不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: FEMA倡导的"全社区方法"理论，强调政府机构、私营组织、非营利组织和个人之间的协作以增强灾害韧性。
AI.method: 对伊利诺伊州10个县的29名应急专业人士进行访谈。
AI.findings: 许多合作伙伴关系在疫情期间发挥了重要作用，但存在三大挑战：志愿者系统存在缺口、城乡县之间的资源差距明显、针对新型灾难场景的培训不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并扩展了"全社区方法"理论在地方层面的应用，揭示了该理论在实践中面临的城乡资源不均衡等现实障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊利诺伊州及其他地区的灾害应对政策制定者提供了改进方向，包括优化志愿者管理系统、缩小城乡资源差距、加强新型灾难场景的培训。

title: Assessing daily service facility resilience and nonlinear planning mechanisms under compound flooding in a high-density coastal city
affiliations: Northeastern University, Northeastern University (USA) and Northeastern University

detail.title: Assessing daily service facility resilience and nonlinear planning mechanisms under compound flooding in a high-density coastal city
detail.abstract: Ensuring continuous access to daily services is a fundamental requirement for sustainable and socially resilient cities. However, in high-density coastal cities, compound flooding can disrupt daily service provision not only through physical inundation, but also by impairing road-based accessibility and service continuity. To examine how compound flooding affects service continuity and resilience, this study takes the central urban area of Dalian, China, as a case and develops an integrated framework linking compound flood simulation, road trafficability adjustment, dynamic accessibility measurement, resilience assessment, and nonlinear mechanism identification. Resilience is measured through four capacities—resistance, absorption, recovery, and reconfiguration—and further synthesized into a composite resilience indicator. The results show that: (1) compound flooding affects daily service facilities primarily through road-network-mediated accessibility loss rather than direct facility damage; (2) composite resilience is shaped by the configuration of multiple capacities, with weak recovery and reconfiguration acting as key bottlenecks in some areas; (3) composite resilience exhibits a core–periphery spatial pattern and can be classified into four types: balanced-resilient, buffer-dominant, recovery-lagging, and system-vulnerable; and (4) commercial centrality, road loop ratio, road node density, and service facility density show nonlinear and threshold-like effects on resilience. This study shifts the focus of service-facility resilience assessment from static facility exposure to dynamic service continuity, providing implications for climate-adaptive service planning, community life-circle optimization, and resilience planning in coastal cities.

AI.tldr: 本研究以大连中心城区为例，构建了耦合洪水模拟、道路通行性调整、动态可达性测量、韧性评估和非线性机制识别的综合框架，发现复合洪水主要通过路网可达性损失而非直接设施损毁影响日常服务供给，并将服务设施韧性分为四种类型。
AI.research_question: 复合洪水如何影响沿海高密度城市的日常服务连续性与韧性？
AI.motivation: 确保日常服务的持续获取是可持续和社会韧性城市的基本要求，但复合洪水不仅通过物理淹没，还会损害基于道路的可达性和服务连续性，而现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韧性四维能力框架（抵抗、吸收、恢复、重构）及综合韧性指标；非线性与阈值效应分析。
AI.method: 以大连中心城区为案例，构建集成框架：复合洪水模拟 + 道路通行性调整 + 动态可达性测量 + 韧性评估 + 非线性机制识别。
AI.findings: (1)复合洪水主要通过路网可达性损失影响服务设施，而非直接设施损毁；(2)综合韧性由多重能力配置塑造，恢复和重构是部分区域的关键瓶颈；(3)综合韧性呈现核心-边缘空间格局，可分为四种类型；(4)商业中心性、道路环路比、路网密度和服务设施密度对韧性呈非线性阈值效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将服务设施韧性评估从静态设施暴露转向动态服务连续性，提出了综合韧性指标和四类韧性类型学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沿海城市的气候适应性服务规划、社区生活圈优化和韧性规划提供了启示。

title: Limited Marginal Benefit of Reasoning-Heavy Deployment in ESG Narrative Scoring: Evidence from 4-Model Consensus on Japanese Listed Firms

detail.title: Limited Marginal Benefit of Reasoning-Heavy Deployment in ESG Narrative Scoring: Evidence from 4-Model Consensus on Japanese Listed Firms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or intervention. The analysis was based on corporate disclosure materials and model-generated outputs.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Automated scoring of ESG narrative disclosures with large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction, yet whether reasoning-heavy frontier models add value commensurate with their cost remains empirically unsettled. We evaluate this question on a corpus of ten Japanese listed firms across three rubric axes (quantitative targets, progress-tracking infrastructure, and external-standard alignment) using a four-model consensus design that combines claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5.5 (with reasoning enabled), gemini-3.1-pro-preview, and deepseek-v4-pro. Across the resulting 120 firm×axis×model scores, the pooled mean absolute deviation between the reasoning-on model and each reasoning-off counterpart is 0.38/5 points; only 2% of pairwise comparisons reach a two-point deviation, and none exceeds two points. Inter-model agreement is moderate overall (weighted κ = 0.36, 0.30, 0.65 for the three axes). Per-firm token-level cost accounting indicates that the single reasoning-on OpenAI arm alone costs roughly 5.6× as much per firm as the three-provider reasoning-off ensemble, for scoring outcomes that differ only within small margins. In this span-based ESG narrative scoring setting, deploying a reasoning-heavy frontier model did not materially improve scoring outcomes relative to reasoning-off model outputs and consensus scores, while increasing operational cost. The evidence is based on a cross-model proxy rather than a within-model ablation; we discuss this and other limitations and outline practical implications for cost-effective ESG auto-scoring pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了在ESG叙事性披露自动评分中，使用推理密集型前沿大语言模型是否值得其高昂成本。基于10家日本上市公司、3个评分维度、4个模型的共识设计，发现推理型模型与无推理模型评分差异极小（平均偏差0.38/5分），但成本高出5.6倍，因此推理型模型在ESG评分中性价比不高。
AI.research_question: 在ESG叙事性披露自动评分中，推理密集型前沿大语言模型（如Claude Opus、GPT-5.5推理版等）带来的评分改进是否足以证明其高昂成本的合理性？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在ESG自动评分中的应用日益普及，推理型前沿模型成本显著高于普通模型，但其增量价值尚未得到严格实证检验。本文旨在为ESG评分实践提供成本效益方面的经验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多模型共识设计（four-model consensus design），通过比较推理开启与推理关闭模型的评分差异（均绝对偏差）、评分一致性（加权Kappa系数）以及成本差异，评估推理型模型的边际价值。
AI.method: 语料为10家日本上市公司，评分轴包括：定量目标、进展追踪基础设施、外部标准对齐。采用4模型共识设计（Claude Opus 4-7、GPT-5.5推理版、Gemini 3.1 Pro预览版、DeepSeek V4 Pro），共120个公司×轴×模型评分。分析推理开启与推理关闭模型的评分偏差、一致性（加权Kappa）及每公司token成本。
AI.findings: 1) 推理型与无推理型模型的平均绝对偏差仅为0.38/5分；2) 仅2%的配对比较达到2分偏差，无任何配对超过2分；3) 模型间一致性中等（加权κ=0.36, 0.30, 0.65）；4) 仅OpenAI推理型模型一家成本即为三家无推理模型总和的5.6倍；5) 推理型模型未显著改善评分结果，但显著增加了运营成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 为LLM在ESG评分中的应用提供了首个系统的成本效益实证分析，揭示了推理型前沿模型在特定结构化评分任务中的边际收益递减现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ESG自动评分实践提供了明确的成本效益指引：在跨度型（span-based）ESG叙事评分场景中，推理型模型性价比低，建议使用无推理模型或多模型共识方案以实现成本有效的ESG自动评分流水线。

title: A Predictive Current Control Strategy for PMSM Drives in Electric Vehicles: Comparative Analysis and Simulation Study
affiliations: University of Transport and Communications and University of Transport and Communications

detail.title: A Predictive Current Control Strategy for PMSM Drives in Electric Vehicles: Comparative Analysis and Simulation Study

keywords.keywords: Predictive current control Model predictive control Electric vehicle drives PMSM motor controlFinite control set MPC

detail.abstract: . A comprehensive review of predictive current control techniques for EV drives. • Comparative analysis of deadbeat, FCS-MPCC, and CCS-MPC strategies. • Simulation study under representative EV operating conditions. • Predictive control achieves faster dynamic response and lower current ripple. • Future research directions for predictive control in EV motor drives.

AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了电动汽车驱动中预测电流控制技术，比较了无差拍、FCS-MPCC和CCS-MPC三种策略，在代表性工况下进行仿真研究，发现预测控制具有更快的动态响应和更低的电流纹波，并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车驱动系统中，不同预测电流控制技术（无差拍、FCS-MPCC、CCS-MPC）的性能差异如何？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车驱动对电流控制要求高，传统PI控制动态响应慢、电流纹波大，需要探索更优的预测控制策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测电流控制理论，包括无差拍控制、有限集模型预测电流控制（FCS-MPCC）和连续控制集模型预测控制（CCS-MPC）。
AI.method: 文献综述与仿真研究，在代表性电动汽车运行工况下对比不同预测控制策略。
AI.findings: 预测控制相比传统方法具有更快的动态响应和更低的电流纹波；无差拍、FCS-MPCC和CCS-MPC各有优劣，适用于不同场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了电动汽车驱动预测电流控制的理论框架，明确了各策略的适用条件与性能边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车电机驱动控制器的选型与设计提供了参考依据，指出了未来研究方向。

title: Cryptocurrency Prediction Markets through the Derivatives Lens: Evidence from Kalshi and Polymarket
affiliations: Seoul National University, Seoul National University and Seoul National University

detail.title: Cryptocurrency Prediction Markets through the Derivatives Lens: Evidence from Kalshi and Polymarket
detail.abstract: Cryptocurrency prediction markets have grown rapidly, yet their prices have been studied almost exclusively as probability forecasts. Because the binary contracts traded on these platforms are structurally identical to cash-or-nothing digital options, the standard derivatives pricing toolkit applies directly. We exploit this equivalence on 113,338 Bitcoin and Ethereum contracts traded on Kalshi and Polymarket between September 2025 and February 2026, extracting implied volatility surfaces, risk-neutral densities, and variance risk premia from prediction market prices for the first time. Risk-neutral skewness recovered from multi-strike Kalshi events is near zero, and the implied volatility smile is pronounced and roughly symmetric, contrasting with the persistent left-skewed smirk that crash-protection demand produces in equity index options. Implied variance exceeds realized variance across all contract series, documenting a positive variance risk premium in prediction markets. The VRP differs markedly across platforms, with Polymarket's roughly 16 times larger than Kalshi's, a pattern consistent with Polymarket's forward-start contract design, which anchors pre-window prices near 0.50 and inflates implied variance. Calibration analysis shows that both venues are systematically underconfident, with Polymarket exhibiting more severe probability distortion. A cross-platform comparison of matched contracts is consistent with much of this divergence reflecting the structural distinction between fixed-strike and forward-start contracts. The derivatives framework reveals risk pricing information in prediction markets that probability-based analysis alone cannot detect.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将衍生品定价框架应用于加密货币预测市场（Kalshi和Polymarket），从11.3万份比特币和以太坊合约中提取隐含波动率曲面、风险中性密度和方差风险溢价，发现预测市场存在正向方差风险溢价、对称的微笑曲线以及平台间的系统性差异。
AI.research_question: 如何利用衍生品定价框架从加密货币预测市场的二元合约中提取风险定价信息，并揭示概率分析无法检测的风险特征？
AI.motivation: 加密货币预测市场快速增长，但其价格几乎仅被作为概率预测来研究。由于二元合约在结构上与现金或空头数字期权等同，标准衍生品定价工具可以直接适用，但这一等价关系尚未被充分利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 衍生品定价理论（期权定价框架）、隐含波动率曲面、风险中性密度、方差风险溢价（VRP）、风险中性偏度。
AI.method: 对2025年9月至2026年2月间Kalshi和Polymarket上113,338份比特币和以太坊合约进行实证分析，提取隐含波动率曲面、风险中性密度和方差风险溢价，并进行跨平台比较和校准分析。
AI.findings: （1）风险中性偏度接近零，隐含波动率微笑曲线明显且基本对称，与股票指数期权的左偏微笑形成对比；（2）隐含方差超过已实现方差，存在正向方差风险溢价；（3）Polymarket的VRP约为Kalshi的16倍，这与Polymarket的前向启动合约设计有关；（4）两个平台均表现出系统性信心不足，Polymarket的概率扭曲更为严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将衍生品定价框架系统性地应用于预测市场，揭示了概率分析无法检测的风险定价信息；发现了预测市场与股票期权市场在隐含波动率形态上的根本差异；识别了合约设计（固定行权价 vs. 前向启动）对风险溢价的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场参与者和监管者提供了理解市场风险定价的新视角；揭示了不同平台的系统性偏差特征，有助于投资者识别套利机会和评估市场效率；为预测市场合约设计提供了实证依据。

title: Riding the Storm: Governance Dynamic Capabilities Amidst Bitcoin's Turbulence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Riding the Storm: Governance Dynamic Capabilities Amidst Bitcoin's Turbulence
detail.abstract: In the last few years, the volatility of Bitcoin has been a key feature of the cryptocurrency market, providing both threats and benefits to companies in different industries. This paper attempts to investigate how the firms react in terms of changing the corporate governance to achieve sustainability in the volatility created by the effect of the external shock on the market environment, induced by Bitcoin's price fluctuations. In terms of dynamic capability theory, we define Governance Dynamic Capabilities (GDCs) as the ability of firms to alter their corporate governance structure and practices to deal with market volatility. Based on firm-level data obtained from Refinitiv, we argue that although there is a lot of uncertainty caused by Bitcoin, companies operating in the Information Technology and Software sector sustain themselves through active implementation of designated governance committees and achieve a shareholder-oriented board structure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨比特币价格波动这一外部冲击如何影响企业为追求可持续发展而调整公司治理。基于动态能力理论，提出"治理动态能力"（GDCs）概念，并利用Refinitiv公司层面数据发现，在比特币引发的不确定性中，信息技术与软件行业的公司通过设立专门治理委员会和构建股东导向的董事会结构来维持企业可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 在比特币价格波动带来的外部市场冲击下，企业如何通过调整公司治理结构来实现可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 比特币的高波动性既是威胁也是机遇，但现有研究缺乏对企业如何通过治理变革应对比特币波动这一外部冲击的系统性理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（Dynamic Capability Theory）；治理动态能力（Governance Dynamic Capabilities, GDCs）——企业改变公司治理结构和实践以应对市场波动的能力。
AI.method: 基于Refinitiv的公司层面数据，对信息技术与软件行业的企业进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 尽管比特币带来巨大的不确定性，但信息技术与软件行业的公司通过积极设立专门治理委员会和构建股东导向的董事会结构，能够实现可持续发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"治理动态能力"（GDCs）这一新概念，将动态能力理论延伸至公司治理领域，解释了企业如何通过治理结构的动态调整来应对外部市场冲击。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息技术与软件行业的企业提供了应对比特币波动性的具体治理策略（设立专门治理委员会、股东导向的董事会结构），也为其他行业应对类似外部冲击提供了参考。

title: Can International Transportation Corridors Mitigate Corporate Supply Chain Risk? A Quasi-Natural Experiment Based on the Opening of China-Europe Railway Express
affiliations: Ocean University of China and Wuxi University

detail.title: Can International Transportation Corridors Mitigate Corporate Supply Chain Risk? A Quasi-Natural Experiment Based on the Opening of China-Europe Railway Express
detail.abstract: This study examines whether international transportation corridors mitigate corporate supply chain risk, using the opening of China-Europe Railway Express (CRE) as a quasi-natural experiment. Drawing on panel data of Chinese listed companies from 2008 to 2023, we employ the multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) method to systematically evaluate the causal effect and its underlying mechanisms. We find that the launch of the CRE significantly reduces corporate supply chain risk, and this effect is robust to a range of robustness checks and endogeneity corrections. Mechanism analysis reveals that this effect operates through promoting supply chain diversification, improving supply chain efficiency, and alleviating corporate financing constraints. Furthermore, the reduction in supply chain risk generates cascading economic effects—enhancing firms’ supply chain stability, operating revenue, and cross-regional investment capacity. This study enriches the literature on infrastructure externalities and supply chain risk management and provides policy implications for optimizing international transportation layout and boosting firms’ global competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中欧班列开通作为准自然实验，基于2008-2023年中国上市公司面板数据，采用多期DID方法发现国际运输走廊能显著降低企业供应链风险，机制包括促进供应链多元化、提升供应链效率和缓解融资约束。
AI.research_question: 国际运输走廊（中欧班列）能否以及如何降低企业供应链风险？
AI.motivation: 在全球化与供应链风险日益凸显的背景下，基础设施互联互通对微观企业供应链安全的影响尚未得到充分实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施外部性理论、供应链风险管理理论
AI.method: 多期双重差分法（Multi-period DID），基于2008-2023年中国上市公司面板数据
AI.findings: 中欧班列开通显著降低企业供应链风险，机制为供应链多元化、供应链效率提升和融资约束缓解；进而提升供应链稳定性、营业收入和跨区域投资能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了基础设施外部性理论在供应链风险管理领域的应用，拓展了对国际运输走廊微观经济效益的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化国际运输布局、提升企业全球竞争力提供了政策依据，建议通过发展国际运输走廊来防范供应链风险。

title: Enhancing GARCH Models with Elasticity: Evidence and Properties
affiliations: University of Western Ontario

detail.title: Enhancing GARCH Models with Elasticity: Evidence and Properties
detail.abstract: We propose a discrete-time model that combines the popular stylized features known as GARCH and local-volatility, while preserving leverage. The local-vol depends on the stock price relative to an adaptive reference process rather than on the raw price level. The reference process follows a slow-moving recursion that filters out long-run growth while preserving a genuine price-based signal. The general setting for the variance multiplies a GARCH kernel by a local factor. In particular we consider three specification for the GARCH, and a downside local factor so volatility responds only when the stock lies below its reference level. The model remains fully observation-driven, introduces no latent state beyond the filtered conditional variance, and is estimated under standardized Student-t innovations. We derive the state recursion, positivity, filterability, and a short result clarifying the distinction between downside elasticity and innovation-driven leverage. Empirically, in a daily equity-index sample of S&P500 returns, the local specification significantly improves the log-likelihood of the classical GARCH model and the Heston–Nandi (HN)-GARCH, with little change in the NGARCH. Sandwich-based standard errors imply p-values of order 10−7 for the local-volatility parameters, δ and κ in the relevant cases. In one-step-ahead out-of-sample forecasting on a longer daily sample of returns, using an expanding window through 2015 and quarterly re-estimation from 2016 to 2024, the local factor improves cumulative predictive log score and lowers average QLIKE. For robustness, additional analyses of six international indexes are also included.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将GARCH与局部波动率（local volatility）相结合的离散时间模型，其中局部因子以股票价格相对于一个自适应参考过程的偏离程度来定义，且仅在下行（价格低于参考水平）时触发。模型在保持完全观察驱动的同时显著提升了拟合优度和预测表现，并在S&P500及多个国际指数上得到验证。
AI.research_question: 如何将GARCH模型与局部波动率特征相结合，构建一个既能捕捉波动聚集性（GARCH）又能体现价格水平依赖的非对称波动响应（local volatility）的离散时间模型？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中GARCH模型擅长刻画波动聚集与杠杆效应，但缺乏对价格水平本身的依赖；而局部波动率模型（如随机波动率或连续时间模型）在离散时间设定下估计复杂。作者希望在保留GARCH类模型观察驱动、易于估计等优势的前提下，引入一个基于价格相对于自适应参考过程的局部因子，以更灵活地捕捉下行市场的额外波动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. GARCH框架（含Heston-Nandi GARCH、NGARCH等变体）；2. 局部波动率思想（价格水平依赖的波动响应）；3. 自适应参考过程（慢速递归过滤长期增长趋势）；4. 下行局部因子（仅当价格低于参考水平时激活）；5. 杠杆效应与下行弹性的区分理论。
AI.method: 离散时间观察驱动模型；最大似然估计（标准化Student-t创新）；对比多种GARCH规范（经典GARCH、HN-GARCH、NGARCH）；样本内拟合（S&P500日度数据）；一步向前滚动窗口预测（2016–2024年季度重估）；稳健性检验（六大国际指数）。
AI.findings: 1. 在S&P500样本内，加入下行局部因子显著提升了经典GARCH和HN-GARCH的对数似然，局部波动率参数的p值达10⁻⁷量级；2. NGARCH变化不大，说明其自身已部分捕获了下行效应；3. 预测表现上，局部因子提升了累积预测对数得分，降低了平均QLIKE；4. 在六大国际指数上结果稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在离散时间GARCH框架内系统性地引入价格相对于自适应参考过程的局部波动率机制；2. 理论上澄清了"下行弹性"（downside elasticity）与"创新驱动杠杆效应"（innovation-driven leverage）之间的区别；3. 证明了模型的状态递归性、正性、可过滤性等性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个既保留GARCH简洁性又增强波动率预测能力的实用模型，易于估计和实现；2. 对风险管理、期权定价和资产配置等实务领域具有潜在应用价值；3. 在国际指数上的稳健性表明该模型具有跨市场的适用性。

detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization and increasing vehicle density have significantly intensified traffic congestion in metropolitan and semi-urban regions. Efficient traffic management requires accurate short-term and long-term traffic flow prediction to support intelligent transportation systems. This paper presents a web-based traffic flow prediction system built using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks. The system is trained on city-wise historical traffic datasets and is capable of learning complex temporal dependencies present in traffic patterns. Multiple LSTM models are developed and trained for different cities, including Kalaburagi, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, and Kolkata. A Flask-based backend integrates the trained models with a lightweight web interface, enabling users to obtain real-time traffic flow predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed LSTM-based approach achieves superior prediction accuracy compared to conventional machine learning methods, highlighting its suitability for smart city traffic planning and congestion mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于LSTM神经网络的城市级交通流预测系统，利用历史数据训练模型并通过Flask后端提供Web端实时预测，实验证明比传统机器学习方法更准确。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于LSTM神经网络的城市交通流预测系统，实现高精度的短期和长期交通流量预测？
AI.motivation: 快速城市化和车辆密度增加导致交通拥堵加剧，需要准确的交通流预测来支持智能交通系统和智慧城市规划。
AI.theoretical_framework: LSTM（长短期记忆）神经网络，能够学习交通模式中复杂的时序依赖关系。
AI.method: 针对多个城市（Kalaburagi、德里、孟买、浦那、海得拉巴、加尔各答）分别训练LSTM模型；使用Flask后端集成模型并构建轻量级Web界面，提供实时预测服务。
AI.findings: LSTM模型在交通流预测准确性上优于传统机器学习方法，适用于智慧城市交通规划与拥堵缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了LSTM在多城市交通流预测任务中的有效性，展示了深度学习模型在城市级时序预测中的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可用的Web端实时交通流预测系统；为城市规划者和交通管理部门提供了实用的拥堵缓解工具。

title: Riding the Storm: Governance Dynamic Capabilities Amidst Bitcoin's Turbulence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Riding the Storm: Governance Dynamic Capabilities Amidst Bitcoin's Turbulence
detail.abstract: In the last few years, the volatility of Bitcoin has been a key feature of the cryptocurrency market, providing both threats and benefits to companies in different industries. This paper attempts to investigate how the firms react in terms of changing the corporate governance to achieve sustainability in the volatility created by the effect of the external shock on the market environment, induced by Bitcoin's price fluctuations. In terms of dynamic capability theory, we define Governance Dynamic Capabilities (GDCs) as the ability of firms to alter their corporate governance structure and practices to deal with market volatility. Based on firm-level data obtained from Refinitiv, we argue that although there is a lot of uncertainty caused by Bitcoin, companies operating in the Information Technology and Software sector sustain themselves through active implementation of designated governance committees and achieve a shareholder-oriented board structure.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨比特币价格波动引发的市场不确定性如何影响企业治理变革。基于动态能力理论，提出"治理动态能力"概念，发现信息技术和软件行业的企业通过设立专门治理委员会和构建股东导向的董事会结构来应对比特币价格波动带来的外部冲击。
AI.research_question: 比特币价格波动引发的市场外部冲击如何影响企业改变公司治理结构以实现可持续性？
AI.motivation: 比特币波动性是加密货币市场的关键特征，对各行各业企业既是威胁也是机遇。现有研究较少关注企业如何通过调整治理结构来应对比特币波动带来的外部市场冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（Dynamic Capability Theory）——本文将治理动态能力（GDCs）定义为企业改变公司治理结构和实践以应对市场波动的能力。
AI.method: 基于Refinitiv的企业层面数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 尽管比特币带来了大量不确定性，但信息技术和软件行业的公司通过积极设立专门的治理委员会和构建股东导向的董事会结构来实现自身可持续发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"治理动态能力"（GDCs）这一新概念，将动态能力理论扩展至公司治理领域，揭示了企业在面对加密货币市场波动等外部冲击时调整治理结构的具体机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息技术和软件行业的企业提供了应对市场波动的治理策略参考，即通过设立专门治理委员会和采用股东导向的董事会结构来增强组织韧性。同时，为其他行业企业在面对类似外部冲击时提供了治理变革的借鉴路径。

title: Fractured Livelihoods and Gendered Recovery: Baseline Evidence on Occupational Displacement and Gender Disparities in Disaster-Affected Coastal Communities of Bangladesh
affiliations: Khulna University and Khulna University

detail.title: Fractured Livelihoods and Gendered Recovery: Baseline Evidence on Occupational Displacement and Gender Disparities in Disaster-Affected Coastal Communities of Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Disasters seldom affect communities evenly. Where pre-existing inequalities are sharp, they tend to widen further, and the coastal belt of south-western Bangladesh offers a clear case in point. This paper presents baseline findings from a mixed-methods study carried out in three unions of Dacope upazila, Khulna District (Kailashganj, Laudob, and Bajua) between August and September 2025. Data were drawn from 198 household surveys, 10 focus group discussions, and 20 key informant interviews. We find that 44.9% of households experienced complete livelihood loss following recurrent cyclones, flooding, and salinity intrusion, and that 38.4% reported substantially reduced income. Female-headed households earned, on average, BDT 3,550 (about 45%) less per month than male-headed households. Roughly four out of five households held no formal bank account, and 63.2% of those who borrowed depended on informal moneylenders charging effective annual rates of 180–300%. Women reported sharper time constraints from caregiving, narrower mobility, and limited authority over productive and community decisions. Demand for skills training was nonetheless high: 71.7% of respondents expressed strong interest, with women (77%) above men (67%). Qualitative evidence suggests that the gap between this demand and historical uptake is largely supply-side, not motivational. Single-component recovery programmes are unlikely to reach the most constrained households. Gender-responsive integrated packages that combine training, fair-rate microcredit, childcare support, and household-level engagement appear necessary for durable recovery in this setting.

AI.tldr: 本文基于孟加拉西南沿海地区198户调查、10场焦点小组和20份深度访谈，揭示了灾害加剧性别与金融不平等：44.9%家庭完全失去生计，女性户主月收入低45%，63.2%借贷依赖年利率180–300%的高利贷，但71.7%受访者（女性77%高于男性67%）对技能培训需求强烈，指出单一救助无效，需性别敏感的综合性恢复方案。
AI.research_question: 在灾害频发且已有不平等严重的孟加拉西南沿海地区，灾害如何影响不同群体的生计恢复？哪些结构性因素（性别、金融排斥、照护责任）制约了恢复效果？综合干预方案是否需要以及在什么条件下有效？
AI.motivation: 灾害对社区的影响并不均等，既有的不平等在灾后往往进一步扩大，但现有研究对性别、金融排斥等结构性因素如何共同作用于灾害恢复缺乏系统性实证，尤其缺乏来自最脆弱社区的基线混合方法证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害不平等理论、性别与发展理论、金融排斥理论、生计恢复框架
AI.method: 混合方法：198份家庭调查（定量）、10场焦点小组讨论、20份关键知情人深度访谈（定性），2025年8–9月在孟加拉Khulna District Dacope upazila的Kailashganj、Laudob、Bajua三个union收集基线数据。
AI.findings: （1）44.9%家庭因反复气旋、洪水和盐碱入侵完全丧失生计，38.4%收入大幅下降；（2）女性户主家庭月均收入比男性户主家庭少3,550塔卡（约45%）；（3）约80%家庭无正规银行账户，63.2%借贷者依赖年利率180–300%的民间高利贷；（4）女性面临更重的照护时间约束、更低的流动性和社区/生产决策权；（5）71.7%受访者（女性77%>男性67%）对技能培训有强烈需求，定性证据表明需求与历史参与率的差距主要源于供给侧而非动机不足；（6）单一组件的恢复计划难以触及最受约束的家庭，需要结合培训、公平利率小额信贷、儿童照护支持和家庭层面参与的性别敏感综合方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 为灾害不平等理论和性别与发展理论提供了来自极端脆弱社区的混合方法基线证据，揭示了供给侧约束（而非动机不足）主导恢复差距的机制，拓展了综合干预必要性的理论逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确指出单一组件恢复项目无效，提出性别敏感的综合恢复方案（技能培训+公平利率小额信贷+儿童照护+家庭层面参与）的具体设计方向，为灾后恢复政策和非政府组织干预提供可操作依据。

title: AutoLineage: Operation-Level Data Lineage for Python ML Pipelines via Import-Time Hooking

detail.title: AutoLineage: Operation-Level Data Lineage for Python ML Pipelines via Import-Time Hooking
detail.abstract:
Production machine learning (ML) pipelines fail silently in ways traditional software does not: a model's F1 metric drifts from 0.95 to 0.60 over a weekend, the production system continues serving predictions, and no exception is raised. The causal chain, a subtly altered data source, a feature engineering regression, an off-by-one filter, leakage between training and evaluation splits, is invisible to the instrumentation layers most ML teams deploy. Sambasivan et al. (2021) reported that 92% of high-stakes ML practitioners have experienced such data cascades.

Existing observability tools each address part of this problem but leave a structural gap. Experiment trackers such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, and Neptune record runs and metrics but not the dataframe-level transformations between logged events. Drift detectors such as Evidently, Arize, and WhyLabs flag distributional shifts in features once a model is deployed, but operate at the post-training boundary and do not observe the pipeline that produced the data. File-level versioning tools such as DVC and lakeFS capture lineage at the artifact boundary but are oblivious to in-memory transformations. Cross-system orchestration lineage such as OpenLineage operates at the task boundary, a Spark job, an Airflow operator, rather than at the individual operation level. No existing system records the complete operation-level execution path from raw data ingestion through model evaluation in a single unified graph.

We present AutoLineage, an open-source Python library that fills this gap. Activation requires a single line of user code: import autolineage.auto. AutoLineage contributes (1) import-time method hooking across 288 operations spanning pandas, scikit-learn, and PySpark; (2) a depth-counter reentrancy guard that preserves trace integrity when hooked operations invoke other hooked operations during internal execution; (3) a plugin architecture that admits new framework support in approximately 200 lines of code per framework; and (4) automated diagnosis on the captured graph, including baseline-vs-current anomaly detection and deviation-weighted root-cause localization for metric degradations.

We evaluate AutoLineage on two case studies spanning two datasets and three frameworks. The first uses the Credit Card Fraud Detection benchmark (284,807 transactions; pandas + scikit-learn) with a RandomForest classifier achieving F1 = 0.8333 and AUC = 0.9871. The second uses the UCI Online Retail dataset (541,909 transactions; PySpark + pandas) with a customer-segmentation pipeline producing 4,338 customer-level RFM aggregates in 28.4 seconds end-to-end. Per-operation instrumentation cost is characterized in two regimes: 84.7 microseconds (95% CI: [78, 91]) on the pandas + scikit-learn stack, where the wrapper cost is precisely measurable, and an upper bound of approximately 1.5 milliseconds for PySpark transforms, where the wrapper cost lies below the noise floor of Py4J round-trip variability. A scaling study from 10^3 to 10^6 rows confirms that overhead becomes indistinguishable from baseline variance at production data scales.

We further evaluate the automated diagnosis layer on a controlled planted-bug experiment. A single line in the filter step is changed, inducing an F1 collapse from 0.984 to 0.000 with no exception raised by the pipeline. Without any change to user code, AutoLineage emits five critical anomalies ordered by severity, and its root-cause localizer correctly identifies the modified filter operation as the source of the regression, with maximal impact score 1.0 and zero manual instrumentation. The downstream operations (train/test split, the metric functions) are correctly excluded from root-cause consideration.

AutoLineage and complementary tools are not in competition: drift detectors flag that the data has changed, while operation-level lineage explains which step in the pipeline produced the change. AutoLineage is available on PyPI under the MIT license.

title: Resolution-Aware Perpetual Futures on Binary Prediction Markets: An Empirical Risk-Design Framework Using Polymarket Data

detail.title: Resolution-Aware Perpetual Futures on Binary Prediction Markets: An Empirical Risk-Design Framework Using Polymarket Data
detail.abstract: We develop and counterfactually evaluate a resolution-aware risk-design framework (PIRAP) for perpetual futures whose underlying tracks a single binary prediction-market probability through resolution. The framework specifies six components: an index estimator combining mid-price, depth-weighted mid, and time-decayed VWAP; jump-aware tiered margin sized against bounded-event terminal-collapse magnitude; leverage compression schedule contracting toward resolution; resolution-aware funding rule with boundary-aware correction; a multi-stage halt protocol; and an eligibility framework. Two formal non-portability propositions establish that standard basis-only funding paired with continuous-vol static margin fails on bounded-event underlyings. Empirical evaluation uses Polymarket's PMXT v2 archive for 2026-04-21 to 2026-04-27 (13,298-market analysis sample passing adequacy gates from 61,087 ingested; 13,115 resolved within the empirical window for E3). E1 evaluates two pre-registered stylized facts; E2 conducts counterfactual replay across three engine configurations; E3 isolates the resolution-zone protocol's contribution. Results are mixed. Five pre-registered floors: stylized-fact floors (boundary depth asymmetry, terminal-jump magnitude) PASS; welfare-side directional floors (final-hour liquidation -6%, drawdown -5.1% pooled, median PnL +14%) two FAIL one PASS; E3 mechanic floors (final-hour liquidation -80% by halt construction PASS; bad-debt frequency +2.4% FAIL). Three of five materiality floors fail: the framework as specified does not validate deployment, but the empirical record establishes a halt-versus-margin scope distinction (halt addresses execution-channel risk; terminal-jump bad-debt remains margin-side) and documents a pre-emption trade-off constraining the dynamic-margin component. The paper concludes with structural recommendations and explicit non-deployable status.

title: Local spillovers in M&A activity
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) and University of Pittsburgh - Finance Group

detail.title: Local spillovers in M&A activity
detail.abstract: Consistent with local spillovers, we find a positive association between acquisitiveness of firms in locally non-dominant industries (subjects) and valuations of firms in locally dominant industries (peers). Separating peer valuations into (idiosyncratic) equity shock and a non-idiosyncratic counterpart, we find that both parts correlate with subject firms' acquisitiveness. This suggests that managers attempt to learn from locally salient peers in order to reduce the noise in their own valuation signals, but also that, in doing so, they (inadvertently) respond to the noise embedded in these local signals. Local valuation spillovers, therefore, reflect both correlated effects reflective of learning and causal peer effects reflective of faulty informant signals. Learning from local peers positively affects deal quality, but the inability to separate signal from noise results in lower quality: Acquisitiveness spurred by the informative part of the local signal (i.e., the non-idiosyncratic component of local peer valuation) correlates with fewer and smaller impairments while those prompted by the noise component in local peer valuation results in more and larger impairments. Consistent with learning, local spillovers in acquisitiveness are stronger among firms that are expected to benefit more from extracting information from local peers' valuations.

AI.tldr: 本文发现本地非主导行业企业的收购倾向与本地主导行业企业的估值正相关。经理人试图从本地同行中学习以减少自身估值信号的噪音，但也会无意中对同行信号中的噪音做出反应。这种学习能提高交易质量，但无法区分信号与噪音则会导致更差的收购绩效。
AI.research_question: 本地估值溢出效应如何影响企业的收购行为，以及经理人是否能从本地同行的估值信号中有效学习？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注企业间学习与同行效应，但较少区分经理人从同行估值中学习的信息性成分与非信息性（噪音）成分。本文旨在分离这两种效应，考察它们对企业收购决策及交易质量的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习理论（从同行信号中提取信息减少估值不确定性）、同行效应理论（相关性效应 vs. 因果性效应）、信号与噪音分离框架。
AI.method: 将同行企业估值分解为特质性股权冲击（噪音）和非特质性成分（信息性信号），通过回归分析检验这两种成分与本地非主导行业企业收购倾向的关系，并进一步分析收购后的减值情况。
AI.findings: 1）本地非主导行业企业的收购倾向与本地主导行业企业的估值正相关。2）同行估值的两种成分（信息性和噪音）均与收购倾向相关。3）由信息性成分驱动的收购导致更少、更小的减值；由噪音成分驱动的收购导致更多、更大的减值。4）预期能从本地同行学习获益更多的企业，其本地收购溢出效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次区分了本地估值溢出中的学习效应（相关性效应）和噪音驱动的同行效应（因果性效应），并揭示了这两种效应在收购决策中的不同后果，丰富了企业间学习与同行效应的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒管理者在参考同行估值信号时需谨慎区分信息与噪音，避免因模仿噪音而导致收购质量下降；为企业优化收购决策提供参考。

title: Triple-Helix Optical Metaprotein (THOMP): A Theoretical Framework for Self-Assembling Photonic Computing Substrates and Their Role in Decentralized Bio-Digital Infrastructure

detail.title: Triple-Helix Optical Metaprotein (THOMP): A Theoretical Framework for Self-Assembling Photonic Computing Substrates and Their Role in Decentralized Bio-Digital Infrastructure

keywords: photonic amino acid analogues JEL Classifications: O31

detail.abstract:
We introduce the Triple-Helix Optical Metaprotein (THOMP), a theoretical bio-digital architectural framework proposing a class of self-assembling photonic computing substrates. In this model, biological macromolecular geometry serves as the organizational scaffold for optical logic, signal routing, and in-material computation.

​Departing from conventional silicon-based architectures, THOMP encodes computational primitives—AND, OR, XOR, and NAND operations—within the conformational geometry of a triple-helical protein analogue. This structure consists of three functionally differentiated strands: an exterior antenna helix (alpha-strand) for photon capture, a medial helix (beta-strand) for switchable logic gate execution, and a core routing helix (gamma-strand) for optical signal dispatch.

​Each strand is composed of Photonic Amino Acid Analogues (PAAs), which are engineered chromophoric units with femtosecond-scale switching times and quantum yields approaching unity. The architecture operates at room temperature without electron-mediated signaling, theoretically eliminating resistive heat generation as a thermodynamic constraint on compute density.

​We present a structural specification mapping molecular geometry to logic function, a Fourier holographic programming interface, and an analysis of theoretical gate density on the order of 10^{15} gates/cm³. Finally, we situate THOMP within the broader project of Bio-Digital Architecture and discuss its implications as a manufacturable computing substrate for distributed infrastructure at a planetary scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三重螺旋光学元蛋白（THOMP）理论框架，这是一种利用生物大分子几何结构作为光子计算基底的生物-数字架构，通过三螺旋蛋白质模拟物中的构象几何编码基本逻辑运算，有望实现10^15 gates/cm³的极高门密度和室温无热耗计算。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生物大分子的几何结构设计一种自组装的光子计算基底，突破传统硅基架构的物理限制？
AI.motivation: 传统硅基电子计算面临电阻热耗散和计算密度的物理瓶颈，亟需探索全新的计算范式，以光子替代电子、以生物分子替代硅基材料实现高效、低能耗的计算。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重螺旋蛋白质模拟物结构；光子氨基酸类似物（PAAs）的光物理特性；傅里叶全息编程接口；生物-数字建筑学。
AI.method: 理论建构与结构规范设计，将分子几何映射为逻辑功能，并通过傅里叶全息编程接口实现可编程逻辑操作。
AI.findings: THOMP架构由三条功能各异螺旋链组成（α-天线螺旋捕获光子、β-中位螺旋执行可切换逻辑门、γ-核心路由螺旋分配光信号）；采用PAAs实现飞秒级开关速度和接近统一量子产率；理论上可在室温下无电子信号传递运行，消除电阻热耗；理论门密度可达10^15 gates/cm³。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了生物大分子几何结构与光子计算功能融合的新理论框架，将分子构象几何直接编码为逻辑运算，拓展了生物-数字计算的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来行星尺度的分布式基础设施提供了一种潜在的可制造光子计算基底，具有超高计算密度和极低能耗的优势。

detail.abstract:
Chinese Abstract: 本文考察了在防策略（Strategy-proof）匹配机制中，仅仅改变偏好申报（preference-elicitation）的顺序，是否足以影响参与者的行为与匹配结果。基于“学校选择”的实验室实验，研究对比了匹配规则（序列独裁机制 SD 与随机序列独裁机制 RSD）及偏好申报顺序的交互影响，即传统的“标准程序”与从最不偏好选项开始排序的“逆向程序”。研究发现，逆向申报对真实偏好汇报的影响具有显著的机制依赖性：其降低了 RSD 机制下的真实汇报率，却显著提升了 SD 机制下的汇报表现。决策过程分析表明，参与者在排序时会同时权衡收益差异与感知的竞争程度，但逆向申报并未显著改变参与者对收益或竞争的敏感度。


English Abstract: We study whether a minimal change in preference-elicitation order alone can affect behavior and outcomes in strategy-proof matching mechanisms. In a laboratory school choice setting, we vary the matching rule (Serial Dictatorship vs. Random Serial Dictatorship) and the order in which participants rank schools (standard procedure vs. backward procedure that elicits the least-preferred option first). Across both mechanisms, backward elicitation yields mixed effects on truth-telling—it decreases truthfulness under Random Serial Dictatorship but increases it under Serial Dictatorship. Analysis of the decision-making process shows that participants respond to both payoff differences and perceived school competitiveness. However, backward elicitation fails to significantly alter participants’ sensitivity to either payoffs or competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验，研究了在防策略匹配机制中，仅改变偏好申报顺序（标准顺序 vs. 逆向顺序）如何影响参与者行为和匹配结果，发现逆向申报对真实汇报率的影响具有机制依赖性：在随机序列独裁机制（RSD）下降低真实率，在序列独裁机制（SD）下提升真实率。
AI.research_question: 在防策略匹配机制中，仅改变偏好申报顺序是否足以影响参与者行为与匹配结果？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注匹配规则设计，但偏好申报顺序这一看似中性的程序细节是否会影响行为，尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 防策略匹配机制理论、序列独裁机制（SD）、随机序列独裁机制（RSD）、偏好申报顺序效应。
AI.method: 实验室实验（学校选择场景），采用2×2设计：匹配规则（SD vs. RSD）× 申报顺序（标准程序 vs. 逆向程序）。
AI.findings: 逆向申报对真实汇报率的影响具有机制依赖性：在RSD下降低真实率，在SD下提升真实率。参与者同时权衡收益差异和感知竞争，但逆向申报未显著改变对收益或竞争的敏感度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了防策略机制中偏好申报顺序这一程序细节对行为的重要影响，丰富了匹配机制设计中"程序公平"与行为反应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校选择等实际匹配场景中如何设计偏好申报流程提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者需关注看似中性的程序细节对参与者行为的潜在影响。

detail.abstract:
El aumento de las temperaturas globales está claramente vinculado a un incremento tanto en la frecuencia como en la duración e intensidad de los eventos de calor extremo, especialmente en regiones templadas [1]. Modelos climáticos y estudios observacionales muestran que las olas de calor serán más frecuentes y severas, afectando áreas metropolitanas que no están bien adaptadas a estas condiciones [2] [3]. En este contexto, los espacios interiores, y en especial las oficinas, enfrentan crecientes desafíos para garantizar condiciones adecuadas de confort térmico sin recurrir a sistemas activos de climatización. Esta situación resulta especialmente relevante en ciudades donde el parque edilicio no ha sido diseñado para responder a escenarios climáticos más exigentes, lo que incrementa el riesgo de sobrecalentamiento durante los meses estivales.
El sobrecalentamiento no solo compromete el bienestar térmico de los usuarios, sino que también tiene implicancias directas en la salud, la productividad y el consumo energético, en la medida en que induce el uso intensivo de sistemas de refrigeración [4] [5]. En este marco, comprender la dinámica térmica de los espacios interiores bajo condiciones reales de uso adquiere un rol central para el desarrollo de estrategias de adaptación pasiva y de eficiencia energética.
Este trabajo aborda el análisis del comportamiento higrotérmico en oficinas naturalmente ventiladas en clima templado cálido, a partir de monitoreo de alta resolución, con el objetivo de evaluar el efecto de la orientación en el riesgo de sobrecalentamiento y aportar evidencia empírica para el diseño y la gestión de espacios más resilientes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过高分辨率监测，分析了温带暖气候下自然通风办公室的热湿行为，评估了建筑朝向对过热风险的影响，为更具韧性的空间设计与管理提供实证依据。

AI.motivation: 全球变暖导致极端高温事件频发，现有建筑未针对更严苛的气候条件设计，夏季过热风险增加，威胁 occupants 的热舒适、健康、生产力，并推高制冷能耗。需要理解实际使用条件下室内热动态，以制定被动适应和能效策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热舒适理论、建筑热湿行为分析、被动式建筑设计原理（自然通风、朝向影响）
AI.method: 对温带暖气候下自然通风办公室进行高分辨率监测，分析其热湿行为，重点评估建筑朝向对过热风险的影响。
AI.findings: 建筑朝向对自然通风办公室的过热风险有显著影响，不同朝向的办公室在夏季表现出不同的热湿行为模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为温带暖气候下自然通风办公空间的过热风险评估提供了实证证据，丰富了建筑朝向与被动式热舒适关系的理论研究。

detail.abstract: We extend the literature on the importance of trust for financial behaviors by examining trust, financial literacy, and financial behavior related to retirement security. Using the Health and Retirement Study, we show that Trust in Financial Institutions aligns with behaviors supportive of retirement security, while Trust in Government Programs does not. We further document racial/ethnic differences: for White respondents, Trust in Financial Institutions relates positively to retirement outcomes, but not for Blacks or Hispanics. Moreover, Trust in Government Programs among minority households is linked to reduced stockholding and lower wealth accumulation. These findings inform efforts to strengthen retirement security.

AI.tldr: 本文通过健康与退休研究数据，发现对金融机构的信任与退休安全行为正相关，而对政府项目的信任则不然；且这种关系存在种族/民族差异：信任对白人退休结果有正向作用，但对黑人和西班牙裔无效，甚至少数族裔对政府项目的信任与更低的股票持有和财富积累相关。
AI.research_question: 信任（对金融机构 vs 对政府项目）如何影响不同种族/民族的退休金融行为与财富积累？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注信任对金融行为的重要性，但缺乏对退休安全领域的细分研究，且较少探讨种族/民族差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任理论；金融素养与退休决策理论；种族/民族差异视角
AI.method: 使用健康与退休研究（HRS）数据，进行定量回归分析，区分对金融机构的信任与对政府项目的信任，并分种族/民族群体（白人、黑人、西班牙裔）进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）对金融机构的信任与退休安全行为正相关，但对政府项目的信任无此关系；（2）对白人群体，信任金融机构与更好的退休结果相关，但对黑人和西班牙裔不显著；（3）少数族裔对政府项目的信任反而与更低的股票持有和财富积累相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了信任类型（机构信任 vs 政府信任）对金融行为的差异化影响，并揭示了信任效应的种族/民族异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构设计针对不同种族/民族群体的退休安全干预措施提供了实证依据。

title: Can Economies Function Beyond FIAT Logic?

detail.title: Can Economies Function Beyond FIAT Logic?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract:
Modern economies are organized primarily through FIAT monetary structures in which economic activity is observed through prices, financial flows, and nominal monetary representations. The present theoretical approach examines the possibility of a different form of economic observation beyond conventional FIAT logic, without abolishing the function of the market or social distribution.

The essay argues that the economy does not function as a single and indivisible process but rather as the operation of three distinct levels: production, market expression, and the distribution of economic added value. At the same time, it theoretically proposes the possibility of coherent observation of these levels through a unified physical unit of economic measurement.

Within this framework, K is presented methodologically as a framework of economic measurement and institutionally as a potential economic system. The approach does not attempt to present a fully finalized economic model, but rather to theoretically open the discussion around the measurement of real economic value beyond exclusively nominal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了以FIAT货币为核心的经济观测体系，提出经济应被视为生产、市场表达和附加价值分配三个不同层次的操作过程，并探讨了通过统一物理测量单位（K框架）来超越名义货币表征、实现真实经济价值观测的可能性。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一种超越传统FIAT货币逻辑、不废除市场功能与社会分配的经济观测方式？如何通过统一的物理计量单位来连贯地观测经济的三个不同层次？
AI.motivation: 现代经济过度依赖FIAT货币体系，经济活动仅通过价格、金融流动和名义货币表征来观测，可能掩盖了真实经济价值。作者希望打开关于超越名义表征的真实经济价值测量的理论讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济三层级理论：生产、市场表达、经济附加价值分配；统一物理计量单位的观测框架。
AI.method: 理论推演与概念建构，提出K框架作为经济计量体系与潜在经济制度。
AI.findings: 经济并非单一不可分割的过程，而是三个不同层次的操作；K框架在方法论上可作为经济计量体系，在制度上可作为潜在经济系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从FIAT货币逻辑转向物理计量单位的经济观测新范式；区分了经济的三层操作结构，为重新理解经济过程提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为探索超越名义货币表征的替代性经济计量与组织方式提供了概念基础，可能对经济制度设计有启发意义。

detail.abstract: This paper examines why the United States has systematically opposed the United Kingdom's Digital Services Tax (DST) and what the dispute reveals about fiscal sovereignty in the digital economy. Drawing on a qualitative political economy case study, the analysis combines process tracing, thematic document analysis, and a structured focused comparison of four DST jurisdictions, the United Kingdom, France, Canada, and India, across the period 2018 to 2026. The paper defines fiscal geopolitics as the use of economic, diplomatic, legal, or trade power by states to shape the fiscal policy choices of other states, particularly where taxation affects the distribution of gains from cross-border economic activity. It argues that US opposition cannot be explained solely by taxprinciple concerns. The dispute reflects the strategic defence of nationally dominant digital firms and the systematic use of trade leverage to constrain another state's fiscal policy choices. Three mechanisms structure the analysis: coercive socialisation, domestic audience costs, and multilateral displacement through the OECD Pillar One process. The evidence shows that tariff threats functioned less as ordinary trade enforcement than as graduated bargaining instruments designed to alter the policy calculations of DST-implementing jurisdictions. The UK retained formal sovereignty over the DST throughout the period, but its practical policy autonomy was materially constrained by trade, diplomatic, and institutional pressures. The paper contributes to the political economy of international taxation by developing the concept of fiscal geopolitics and by distinguishing formal tax sovereignty from practical fiscal autonomy under conditions of asymmetric interdependence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性政治经济学案例研究，分析了美国为何系统性反对英国的数字服务税（DST），揭示了数字时代"财政地缘政治"如何通过贸易杠杆、外交压力和制度约束，在保留形式税收主权的同时实质性限制他国的财政自主权。
AI.research_question: 美国为何系统性地反对英国的数字服务税（DST）？这一争端揭示了数字经济中财政主权的何种性质？
AI.motivation: 既有文献通常以税收原则（如税收公平、避免双重征税）解释DST争端，但未能充分解释美国持续、系统性的反对行为。本文旨在提出"财政地缘政治"概念，揭示大国利用经济、外交、法律和贸易权力影响他国财政政策选择的政治经济逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政地缘政治（Fiscal Geopolitics）：国家运用经济、外交、法律或贸易权力塑造他国财政政策选择。三个分析机制：强制社会化（Coercive Socialisation）、国内受众成本（Domestic Audience Costs）、通过OECD第一支柱进程的多边转移（Multilateral Displacement）。
AI.method: 定性政治经济学案例研究，结合过程追踪（Process Tracing）、主题文件分析（Thematic Document Analysis）和结构化聚焦比较（Structured Focused Comparison），对英国、法国、加拿大、印度四个DST司法管辖区在2018-2026年间的案例进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）美国反对DST不能仅用税收原则解释，实质是对本国数字巨头战略利益的防御性保护；（2）关税威胁并非普通贸易执法工具，而是作为分级谈判手段（Graduated Bargaining Instruments）改变DST实施国的政策决策；（3）英国在整个时期保留了形式上的DST主权，但其实际政策自主权受到贸易、外交和制度压力的实质性约束。（4）在非对称相互依赖条件下，形式税权与实际财政自主之间存在显著张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"财政地缘政治"概念，丰富了国际税收政治经济学的理论工具箱；区分了形式税收主权（Formal Tax Sovereignty）与实际财政自主（Practical Fiscal Autonomy），为理解数字经济时代国家间不对称相互依赖下的税收权力关系提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了中小经济体在数字经济税收政策上面临的结构性约束，为发展中国家评估OECD包容性框架谈判中的权力不对称提供了实证依据；提醒政策制定者关注贸易杠杆作为财政政策间接干预工具的广泛适用性。

title: Stock Market Returns as a Valuation Convention: Structure, Dynamics, and Predictability
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Stock Market Returns as a Valuation Convention: Structure, Dynamics, and Predictability
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a unified framework for the time variation in expected stock market returns, applied to the aggregate level of the S&P 500. We show that the cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio (CAPE) and price-to-book jointly span a low-dimensional valuation state proxying for the market-implied required rate of return. Based on a generalized valuation identity, we construct X = ln(CAPE)−P/B, which explains a large share of long-horizon return variation in sample and serves as the valuation anchor of a broader specification integrating macro-financial cycles and investor sentiment.

However, this valuation relationship fails to deliver stable long-horizon out-of-sample forecasts. By contrast, it retains significant predictive power at shorter horizons. We interpret this pattern as evidence that stock market returns are governed by persistent but evolving valuation conventions formed under imperfect information, rather than by time-invariant parameters or fully stable expectation structures.

We further show that this short-horizon predictability is economically meaningful. A simple out-of-sample strategy—based on next-month average prices and extended to a three-month weighted horizon—delivers improved risk-adjusted performance relative to standard benchmarks, thereby defining a practical decision window for portfolio adjustment.

The paper connects the predictive return literature following Robert Shiller with the multifactor framework associated with Eugene Fama, reinterpreted in an aggregate time-series setting and extended to incorporate macro-financial cycle conditions and belief dynamics. More broadly, the results support a view in which market prices reflect conditional valuations formed through historically evolving belief structures under fundamental uncertainty, with direct implications for tactical asset allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于CAPE和市净率构建统一估值框架，发现X = ln(CAPE)−P/B能解释长期收益变化，但仅短期样本外预测有效，并据此提出可操作的战术配置策略。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的分析框架来刻画股票市场预期收益的时变特征？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中，CAPE和市净率等估值指标单独使用时预测能力有限，且传统模型假设时间不变参数，无法解释市场收益的动态变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义估值恒等式；不完全信息下的估值惯例演化理论；宏观金融周期与信念动态。
AI.method: 构建联合估值状态变量X = ln(CAPE)−P/B；进行样本内长预测和样本外短预测；构建基于下月平均价格和三个月加权区间的交易策略进行经济意义检验。
AI.findings: X变量在样本内能解释长期收益变化，但样本外仅在短周期（一个月、三个月）具有显著预测力；基于此的战术策略能带来优于基准的风险调整收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Shiller的预测性收益文献与Fama的多因子框架在总量时间序列视角下统一；提出市场收益受不完全信息下演化估值惯例支配，而非时间不变参数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战术资产配置提供了明确的决策窗口（三个月加权区间）和可操作的交易策略，改善了风险调整后绩效。

title: Foreign direct investment and the gravity of knowledge
affiliations: KVL Economic Policy Research

detail.title: Foreign direct investment and the gravity of knowledge

declarations.ethicsApproval: There are no ethical approval issues involved

detail.abstract: Gravity models of foreign direct investment (FDI) have until now been based on the attraction power each country's market size. This paper presents and test a new structural gravity model that explains international FDI patterns from two separate attractors, market size and national knowledge characteristics. The model allows to separate and measure the gravity push and pull forces per country pair. The model is tested using a data panel with 150 indicators for firm-based and public knowledge activities, and bilateral FDI for about 200 jurisdictions over the full period 2001-2022. We find that knowledge-based comparative advantages have a separate impact on bilateral FDI, alongside the impact of market size. The impacts differ between partner countries, quantitatively and qualitatively (type of national knowledge assets). Knowledge factors often have a stronger impact than a country's gross domestic product. We have subjected these results that are new to the literature to severe robustness tests, but the results remain standing. The FDI Knowledge-Enriched Gravity (FKEG) model can become a powerful new tool for international economics

AI.tldr: 本文提出并检验了一个新的结构性引力模型（FKEG模型），在传统市场规模的吸引力的基础上，将国家知识特征作为独立的引力因素纳入外商直接投资（FDI）分析框架。利用2001-2022年间约200个司法管辖区的双边FDI数据及150个企业型和公共知识活动指标进行实证检验，发现知识型比较优势对双边FDI具有独立且有时强于GDP的显著影响，且该结果通过了严格稳健性检验。
AI.research_question: 知识特征（国家知识资产）是否以及如何作为独立的引力因素影响双边FDI流动？其影响效应与传统市场规模的引力效应相比有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统FDI引力模型仅关注市场规模（GDP）作为吸引力量，忽视了知识资本在跨国投资决策中的重要作用；为填补这一理论空白，本文试图构建一个同时纳入市场规模和知识特征的双重引力框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识密集型FDI理论、引力模型理论、比较优势理论；作者构建了"FDI知识富集引力（FKEG）模型"，将国家知识特征作为独立于市场规模的第二类引力源。
AI.method: 结构性引力模型估计；采用2001-2022年约200个司法管辖区的面板数据；包含150个企业型与公共知识活动指标；进行多项严格稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）知识型比较优势对双边FDI具有独立于市场规模的显著影响；（2）知识因素的影响力在定量和定性（知识资产类型）上因伙伴国而异；（3）知识因素有时比GDP对FDI的影响更强；（4）上述结果通过了严格稳健性检验。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将知识特征作为独立引力因素纳入FDI引力模型，拓展了传统引力理论的分析维度；（2）提出了可测度每对国家间知识引力"推力"与"拉力"的分解方法；（3）FKEG模型为国际经济学提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为各国制定吸引外资政策提供了知识资本维度的新视角；（2）帮助企业投资者识别具有知识比较优势的东道国；（3）为国际投资流向预测和政策评估提供了更精细化的模型工具。

title: A Training Algorithm Based on Differential Evolution and Artificial Bee Colony Optimization for Forecasting Stock Exchange Time Series with Single Multiplicative Neuron Model Artificial Neural Networks
affiliations: Giresun University, Giresun University and Giresun University

detail.title: A Training Algorithm Based on Differential Evolution and Artificial Bee Colony Optimization for Forecasting Stock Exchange Time Series with Single Multiplicative Neuron Model Artificial Neural Networks
detail.abstract: Accurate forecasting of financial indices is a challenging task due to strong volatility, structural breaks and complex nonlinear patterns in the underlying time series. At the same time, even small gains in forecasting accuracy can have a substantial impact on portfolio management, algorithmic trading and risk control. Single multiplicative neuron model artificial neural networks provide a compact neural architecture that can capture multiplicative interactions among lagged inputs with relatively few parameters, but their training leads to a highly non-convex optimization problem that is sensitive to local minima and to hyperparameter choices such as the lag order. This study proposes a hybrid differential evolution–artificial bee colony optimization framework for training single multiplicative neuron model artificial neural networks in financial index forecasting. In the proposed approach, the model parameters are estimated on a normalized training segment by combining the global exploration ability of differential evolution algorithm with the local exploitation mechanisms of artificial bee colony within a unified hybrid scheme. In addition, a validation-based model selection strategy is employed to determine the optimal lag order by averaging validation root mean square error over multiple stochastic runs. Once the optimal architecture is selected, the model is retrained with the chosen lag and evaluated on a held-out test set. The hybrid differential evolution–artificial bee colony trained with single multiplicative neuron model artificial neural networks is first compared against several alternative single multiplicative neuron model artificial neural networks training algorithms, including backpropagation, genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimization, pure differential evolution and pure artificial bee colony. The proposed method is then evaluated on three real-world financial time series: the Nasdaq index, the Tesla stock index and a gold price series. Experimental results based on root mean square error and mean absolute percentage error criteria show that the hybrid differential evolution–artificial bee colony scheme consistently yields the best or near-best performance among all single multiplicative neuron model artificial neural network training methods, and that the resulting model is competitive with, and in several cases superior to, more complex neural architectures used for financial index forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合差分进化-人工蜂群优化框架（DE-ABC）来训练单乘法神经元模型人工神经网络（SMN-ANN），用于金融指数预测。通过结合DE的全局探索和ABC的局部开发能力，并采用验证模型选择策略确定最优滞后阶数，该方法在纳斯达克指数、特斯拉股价和黄金价格三个真实金融时间序列上，相比多种传统训练算法表现更优或持平，且能与更复杂的神经网络架构竞争。
AI.research_question: 如何通过混合优化算法训练单乘法神经元模型人工神经网络，以提高金融指数预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列具有强波动性、结构性断点和复杂非线性模式，即使微小的预测精度提升也能对投资组合管理、算法交易和风险控制产生重大影响。单乘法神经元模型虽能捕获滞后输入的乘法交互作用且参数较少，但其训练面临高度非凸优化问题，易陷入局部最优且对滞后阶数超参数敏感。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单乘法神经元模型人工神经网络（SMN-ANN）、差分进化算法（DE）、人工蜂群算法（ABC）、混合优化框架、验证模型选择策略。
AI.method: 提出混合DE-ABC框架训练SMN-ANN：首先在归一化的训练段上使用DE的全局探索能力与ABC的局部开发机制结合进行参数估计；然后采用基于验证集的模型选择策略，通过多次随机运行的验证均方根误差平均值确定最优滞后阶数；最后用选定滞后阶数重新训练并在保留测试集上评估。对比基准包括反向传播、遗传算法、粒子群优化、纯DE和纯ABC，并在三个真实金融时间序列上进行实验。
AI.findings: 混合DE-ABC方案在所有SMN-ANN训练方法中持续取得最佳或接近最佳的性能；该模型与更复杂的神经网络架构相比具有竞争力，且在多个案例中表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将差分进化全局探索与人工蜂群局部开发有效结合的混合优化训练方法，解决了SMN-ANN训练中的非凸优化难题；引入验证模型选择策略系统性地确定最佳滞后阶数，增强了模型选择的鲁棒性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融指数预测提供了一种参数更少、训练更高效且预测精度更高的神经网络建模方案，可与乃至超越更复杂架构，对投资组合管理、算法交易和风险控制具有实际应用价值。

title: A Physically Constrained Transformer-Diffusion Model for Data Augmentation of Gas Sensor Arrays
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Yan’an University - School of Physics and Electronic Information

detail.title: A Physically Constrained Transformer-Diffusion Model for Data Augmentation of Gas Sensor Arrays
detail.abstract: This study uses acustom-made acetone gas sensor array to collect response curve data under various experimental conditions, constructing a small-sample sensor dataset. To address the challenges of machine learning modeling with limited sample sizes, we propose a Transformer-based diffusion model (TFDM) that generates high-quality response curves and corresponding conditions (gas concentration and temperature) from raw experimental data. The model incorporates physical prior information such as shape regularization, smoothness constraints, and non-negative constraints to enhance the physical consistency and waveform fidelity of generated data, thereby expanding dataset scale. We apply backpropagation neural networks (BPNN), long short-term memory networks (LSTM), and convolutional neural networks (CNN) for acetone concentration prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that TFDM-generated data significantly improves prediction accuracy: compared to models trained solely on the original dataset, the root mean square error (RMSE) decreases by 25.08%,26.88%, and 27.17% for all three models, respectively, while the coefficient of determination (R2) increases by 0.11,0.16, and 0.14 (R2TFDM−R2origin). The predictive performance further improves with the integration of physical constraint strategies. These findings validate TFDM's effectiveness in small-sample learning for gas sensor applications and highlight its practical deployment potential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Transformer的扩散模型（TFDM），通过引入物理先验约束生成高质量气体传感器响应曲线，有效扩增小样本数据集，显著提升三种神经网络（BPNN、LSTM、CNN）的丙酮浓度预测精度（RMSE降低25%-27%，R²提升0.11-0.16）。
AI.research_question: 如何在小样本条件下，利用生成模型扩增气体传感器数据集，提升机器学习模型的浓度预测性能？
AI.motivation: 气体传感器实验中数据采集成本高、样本量有限，导致机器学习模型训练困难、预测精度不足。现有小样本学习方法在物理信号生成中缺乏对数据物理一致性的保障。
AI.theoretical_framework: Transformer架构、扩散概率模型（Diffusion Model）、物理先验约束（形状正则化、平滑性约束、非负约束）。
AI.method: 利用定制丙酮气体传感器阵列采集响应曲线，构建小样本数据集；提出TFDM生成高保真响应曲线及对应条件（浓度、温度）；将生成数据与原始数据合并，分别训练BPNN、LSTM、CNN进行浓度预测。
AI.findings: TFDM生成数据使三种模型的RMSE分别下降25.08%、26.88%、27.17%，R²分别提升0.11、0.16、0.14；物理约束策略进一步提升了预测性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将扩散模型引入气体传感器小样本学习场景，结合物理先验约束提升生成数据的物理一致性，为传感器信号生成提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一种可部署的小样本数据扩增方案，显著提升气体传感器浓度预测精度，降低实验数据采集成本，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Styling Optimization Design of New Energy SUV Wheel Hubs Based on Positive Emotional Granularity (PEG): PSO-BP-GA Model Prediction and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Verification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Styling Optimization Design of New Energy SUV Wheel Hubs Based on Positive Emotional Granularity (PEG): PSO-BP-GA Model Prediction and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Verification

keywords.keywords: New Energy SUV Wheel HubsPositive Emotional GranularityPSO-BPSSA-SVRNSGA-IIIFinite Element Analysis

detail.abstract: To meet the emotional requirements of users of new energy sport utility vehicles (SUVs), this study proposes a styling optimization design method for new energy SUV wheel hubs based on Positive Emotional Granularity (PEG). First, the emotional image dimensions were obtained and summarized through questionnaire survey, high-emotional-granularity expert interviews and Factor Analysis, and the key morphological features of wheel hub samples were extracted using Generalized Morphological Analysis and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Based on the dataset, a back propagation neural network optimized by Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm (PSO-BP) was constructed to capture the nonlinear relationship between wheel hub styling features and emotional images, and support vector regression optimized by Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA-SVR) was introduced as the benchmark model to systematically compare the effectiveness of the proposed model. Subsequently, the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III) and entropy-weighted TOPSIS were combined to search for the optimal design scheme. The research results show that the PSO-BP model outperforms the SSA-SVR model in terms of prediction accuracy, generalization ability and robustness. The constructed PSO-BP-GA model can effectively predict the design scheme that meets users' emotional requirements, and the engineering feasibility of the design scheme is verified through finite element analysis (FEA).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于积极情感粒度（PEG）的新能源SUV轮毂造型优化设计方法，通过PSO-BP神经网络、NSGA-III与TOPSIS相结合，有效预测并优化了满足用户情感需求的设计方案，并通过有限元分析验证了工程可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何基于积极情感粒度（PEG）对新能源SUV轮毂进行造型优化设计，以满足用户的情感需求？
AI.motivation: 满足新能源SUV用户对轮毂造型的积极情感需求，解决传统设计方法难以量化用户情感与造型特征之间非线性关系的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 积极情感粒度（PEG）、因子分析、广义形态分析、层次分析法（AHP）、粒子群优化反向传播神经网络（PSO-BP）、麻雀搜索算法支持向量回归（SSA-SVR）、NSGA-III、熵权TOPSIS。
AI.method: 问卷调查与专家访谈提取情感维度；广义形态分析与AHP提取轮毂形态特征；构建PSO-BP神经网络预测情感意象；以SSA-SVR为基准模型对比；NSGA-III与熵权TOPSIS联合寻优；有限元分析验证工程可行性。
AI.findings: PSO-BP模型在预测精度、泛化能力和鲁棒性上优于SSA-SVR模型；PSO-BP-GA模型能有效预测满足用户情感需求的设计方案；优化方案通过有限元分析验证了工程可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将积极情感粒度（PEG）引入新能源汽车轮毂造型设计领域，拓展了情感化设计理论在工业设计中的应用边界。提出并验证了PSO-BP模型在捕捉造型特征与情感意象非线性关系方面的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新能源SUV轮毂造型设计提供了一套可量化的情感化设计流程和方法，能够帮助企业精准把握用户情感需求，提升产品市场竞争力；有限元分析验证了设计方案的实际工程可行性。

title: Structured carbon composites from date palm (Phoenix dactylifera) fronds and polyethylene waste: Impact of electricity mix on environmental trade-offs and process contributions in Qatar
affiliations: Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Qatar University, HBKU and Hamad Bin Khalifa University

detail.title: Structured carbon composites from date palm (Phoenix dactylifera) fronds and polyethylene waste: Impact of electricity mix on environmental trade-offs and process contributions in Qatar
detail.abstract: Biomass–plastic integration offers a promising route to convert powdered activated carbon (AC) into structured composites with improved handling, recovery, and applicability in environmental systems. However, the environmental performance of such composites is strongly affected by energy systems, particularly the electricity source used during thermal processing, which remains insufficiently examined. This study presents a process-based life cycle assessment (LCA) of polyethylene (PE)-integrated AC composites derived from date palm (Phoenix dactylifera) fronds (PF), a locally available biomass residue in Qatar. The analysis evaluates climate change (CC) and net energy demand (EN) under different electricity generation scenarios, supported by contribution and sensitivity analyses. The results show that CC impacts are highly sensitive to electricity carbon intensity, decreasing from 7.82–8.54 kg CO₂ eq. under coal-based electricity to 1.04–2.21 kg CO₂ eq. under low-carbon sources such as nuclear and biomass, corresponding to reductions of 70–87%. In contrast, EN follows an inverse trend, increasing from 115–145 MJ under natural gas-based electricity to 160–191 MJ under low-carbon scenarios. This divergence highlights that emission reductions do not necessarily translate into lower energy demand. Contribution analysis reveals a shift from energy-driven CC impacts under fossil-based electricity, dominated by thermal processing, to material-driven impacts under low-carbon electricity, where chemical activation and polymer integration become major contributors. Sensitivity analysis identifies pyrolysis as the most influential parameter, while solvent consumption has a smaller but still relevant effect. Overall, this study demonstrates that environmental performance is governed by the combined effects of electricity mix, thermal efficiency, and material inputs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过生命周期评估（LCA）方法，分析了椰枣叶基生物质与聚乙烯（PE）复合制备活性炭（AC）复合材料的环境性能。研究发现，气候变化影响对电力碳强度高度敏感，从煤电下的7.82-8.54 kg CO₂ eq降至低碳电力下的1.04-2.21 kg CO₂ eq（降低70-87%）；而净能量需求则呈现相反趋势，从天然气发电下的115-145 MJ升至低碳场景下的160-191 MJ。贡献分析表明，化石能源电力下以热加工为主的能源驱动型影响，转向低碳电力下以化学活化和聚合物整合为主的材料驱动型影响。热解是最敏感的参数。
AI.research_question: 生物质-塑料整合制备的活性炭复合材料的生命周期环境绩效如何受电力来源影响？气候变化影响和能量需求之间存在怎样的权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 粉末活性炭（AC）通过生物质-塑料整合可转化为结构型复合材料，改善其处理性、回收性和环境系统适用性。但电力来源（尤其是热加工过程中的电力）对该类复合材料环境绩效的影响尚缺乏充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于过程的生命周期评估（LCA）方法，结合贡献分析与敏感性分析，评估气候变化（CC）和净能量需求（EN）两大指标。
AI.method: 以卡塔尔当地农业废弃物——椰枣叶（PF）与聚乙烯（PE）整合制备活性炭复合材料为研究对象，采用基于过程的LCA方法，设置不同电力生成情景（煤电、天然气、核能、生物质等），进行贡献分析和敏感性分析。
AI.findings: （1）CC影响对电力碳强度高度敏感，低碳电力可降低70-87%的碳排放；（2）EN呈相反趋势，低碳场景下能量需求反而增加；（3）电力来源从化石能源转向低碳时，主要贡献因素从热加工（能源驱动）转向化学活化和聚合物整合（材料驱动）；（4）热解是最敏感的参数，溶剂消耗影响较小但不可忽视。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了电力系统与材料系统之间的耦合效应，证明碳排放减少并不必然转化为更低的能量需求，为生物质-塑料复合材料的环境绩效评估提供了更全面的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生物质-塑料活性炭复合材料的工艺优化和能源选择提供了决策依据，指导在低碳电力情境下重点关注化学活化剂和聚合物输入的优化，而非单纯追求热加工效率。

title: Does Early Pain Management Pay Off? Evidence on Utilization, Costs, and Surgeries
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business, Kelley School of Business, Indiana University, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business, Indiana University School of Medicine and

detail.title: Does Early Pain Management Pay Off? Evidence on Utilization, Costs, and Surgeries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Chronic pain is a significant and growing public health concern that affects an estimated 50 million U.S. adults annually and incurs substantial healthcare costs and productivity losses. We examine whether early intervention by pain management specialists can reduce utilization, costs, and surgeries for patients with new-onset chronic pain. Leveraging a 2019 pilot program by a major national insurer that eliminated patient cost-sharing for the first three physical therapy sessions for low back pain across 13 states, we implement a novel two-stage model in which a difference-in-differences (DiD) estimate serves as an instrumental variable (IV) for early pain management consultation. The first stage estimates the exogenous change in the likelihood of patients receiving early pain management intervention in a DiD framework. The second stage uses the change as an IV for early pain management intervention. We find that early intervention significantly reduces healthcare utilization, costs, surgeries, and opioid reliance for patients with new-onset chronic pain. We validate our findings using insurance claims from a chronic-pain specialist network in Southern California. Our work provides large-scale causal evidence for strategically shifting PM consultation in the care trajectory. These findings underscore the critical need for providers, payers, and policymakers to restructure referral pathways and benefit designs to prioritize timely pain management specialist access.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国一家大型保险公司在13个州取消腰痛患者前三次物理治疗自付费用的试点项目，通过双重差分与工具变量相结合的两阶段模型，发现早期疼痛管理专家干预能显著降低医疗利用、成本、手术和 opioid 依赖。研究为将疼痛管理咨询提前纳入治疗路径提供了大规模因果证据。
AI.research_question: 早期疼痛管理专家干预能否减少新发慢性疼痛患者的医疗利用、成本及手术？
AI.motivation: 慢性疼痛影响约5000万美国成年人，造成巨大的医疗成本和生产力损失，但早期干预的因果效应缺乏大样本证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用双重差分（DiD）估计作为工具变量（IV）的两阶段模型：第一阶段估计DiD框架下患者接受早期疼痛管理的外生变化，第二阶段将该变化作为早期干预的工具变量。
AI.method: 两阶段模型：DiD + IV。利用2019年一家大型保险公司在13个州取消腰痛患者前三次物理治疗自付费用的试点项目，并使用南加州慢性疼痛专科网络的索赔数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 早期干预显著降低了新发慢性疼痛患者的医疗利用、医疗成本、手术率和 opioid 依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了大规模因果证据，证明将疼痛管理咨询提前至治疗早期能够改善健康结果和经济效率，为慢性疼痛治疗路径的重构提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议医疗服务提供者、支付方和政策制定者重新设计转诊路径和福利方案，优先保障患者及时获得疼痛管理专家的诊治。

title: Styling Optimization Design of New Energy SUV Wheel Hubs Based on Positive Emotional Granularity (PEG): PSO-BP-GA Model Prediction and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Verification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Styling Optimization Design of New Energy SUV Wheel Hubs Based on Positive Emotional Granularity (PEG): PSO-BP-GA Model Prediction and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Verification

keywords.keywords: New Energy SUV Wheel HubsPositive Emotional GranularityPSO-BPSSA-SVRNSGA-IIIFinite Element Analysis

detail.abstract: To meet the emotional requirements of users of new energy sport utility vehicles (SUVs), this study proposes a styling optimization design method for new energy SUV wheel hubs based on Positive Emotional Granularity (PEG). First, the emotional image dimensions were obtained and summarized through questionnaire survey, high-emotional-granularity expert interviews and Factor Analysis, and the key morphological features of wheel hub samples were extracted using Generalized Morphological Analysis and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Based on the dataset, a back propagation neural network optimized by Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm (PSO-BP) was constructed to capture the nonlinear relationship between wheel hub styling features and emotional images, and support vector regression optimized by Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA-SVR) was introduced as the benchmark model to systematically compare the effectiveness of the proposed model. Subsequently, the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III) and entropy-weighted TOPSIS were combined to search for the optimal design scheme. The research results show that the PSO-BP model outperforms the SSA-SVR model in terms of prediction accuracy, generalization ability and robustness. The constructed PSO-BP-GA model can effectively predict the design scheme that meets users' emotional requirements, and the engineering feasibility of the design scheme is verified through finite element analysis (FEA).

AI.tldr: 本研究针对新能源SUV轮毂造型，提出了一种基于积极情感粒度（PEG）的优化设计方法。通过问卷、专家访谈和因子分析获取情感意象维度，利用广义形态分析和层次分析法提取轮毂关键形态特征，构建PSO-BP神经网络模型预测非线性关系，结合NSGA-III和熵权TOPSIS搜索最优设计方案。结果表明PSO-BP模型优于SSA-SVR模型，并通过有限元分析验证了方案的工程可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计新能源SUV轮毂造型以满足用户的情感需求？
AI.motivation: 新能源SUV用户对轮毂造型有较高的情感需求，但现有设计方法难以有效捕捉轮毂造型特征与用户情感意象之间的非线性关系，缺乏系统性的情感化设计优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 积极情感粒度（PEG）、因子分析、广义形态分析、层次分析法（AHP）、PSO-BP神经网络、SSA-SVR、NSGA-III、熵权TOPSIS
AI.method: （1）问卷+专家访谈+因子分析提取情感意象维度；（2）广义形态分析+AHP提取轮毂关键形态特征；（3）构建PSO-BP神经网络模型预测轮毂造型与情感意象的关系，以SSA-SVR为基准模型对比；（4）NSGA-III结合熵权TOPSIS搜索最优设计方案；（5）有限元分析验证工程可行性。
AI.findings: （1）PSO-BP模型在预测精度、泛化能力和鲁棒性上优于SSA-SVR模型；（2）构建的PSO-BP-GA模型能有效预测满足用户情感需求的设计方案；（3）通过有限元分析验证了设计方案的工程可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将积极情感粒度（PEG）引入新能源SUV轮毂造型设计领域，建立了基于PSO-BP神经网络的情感预测模型，为情感化工业设计提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一套完整的新能源SUV轮毂造型情感化设计优化流程，可帮助企业更精准地捕捉用户情感需求，提升产品市场竞争力，并通过有限元分析确保设计方案具备工程可行性。

AI.tldr: 本文探讨超低成本、抗灾住房技术，以联合国技术白皮书形式呈现。
AI.research_question: 如何开发超低成本且具备抗灾能力的住房技术？
AI.motivation: 全球自然灾害频发，低收入群体住房脆弱且缺乏抗灾能力，亟需低成本、易推广的解决方案。

AI.method: 采用技术白皮书形式，综合案例研究、工程设计与实地验证。
