detail.abstract: Economic freedom as a. driver of ICT Service exports This paper examines whether economic freedom, as measured by the Index of Economic Freedom, has a positive and time-lagged impact on the share of ICT services exports in total service exports, and whether this effect corresponds to a regression coefficient of at least 0,20 per additional score point. The study is based on a dynamic panel data model according to Arellano-Bond using international secondary data, which maps time-delayed effects over up to ten years. The results show time-delayed effects: For lag 1 (ß = 0,827; p = 0,014) and lag 3 (ß = 0,418; p = 0,032), there is a positive and statistically significant influence that exceeds the required minimum coefficient. The remaining calculated lags are predominantly positive, but not statistically significant. The study thus confirms the hypothesis: an increase in economic freedom by one score point leads to a time-delayed increase in the share of ICT service exports. The result underscore the importance of open, constitutionally stable, and economically free framework conditions for the international competitiveness of digital service sectors and is therefore also relevant to economic policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用动态面板数据模型（Arellano-Bond估计法）检验经济自由度对ICT服务出口比重的正向时滞效应，发现滞后1年和滞后3年的影响显著且系数超过0.20的阈值，证实经济自由度提升有助于数字服务出口竞争力。
AI.research_question: 经济自由度（以经济自由指数衡量）是否对ICT服务出口占服务出口总额的比重产生正向且具有时滞的影响？该效应是否对应每个额外得分点至少0.20的回归系数？
AI.motivation: 探讨制度性因素（经济自由）如何影响数字时代服务贸易竞争力，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济自由理论、制度经济学、动态面板数据模型（Arellano-Bond估计）
AI.method: 采用Arellano-Bond动态面板数据模型，基于国际二手数据，分析长达十年的时滞效应。
AI.findings: 滞后1年（ß=0.827, p=0.014）和滞后3年（ß=0.418, p=0.032）存在正向显著影响且超过最低系数阈值；其余滞后期多为正向但不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了经济自由对数字服务出口跨期影响的机制，丰富了制度经济学与国际贸易理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供依据：开放、宪法稳定、经济自由的制度环境对数字服务部门国际竞争力具有重要意义。

title: Discovering the Why of Process Models – A Systematic Literature Review on Decision Mining
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Ottawa

detail.title: Discovering the Why of Process Models – A Systematic Literature Review on Decision Mining
detail.abstract: Within the field of Process Mining, process discovery is a data-driven method for discovering the control flow of processes—the how of a process. However, control flow alone does not explain why cases follow different branches at decision points. Decision Mining (DM) addresses this limitation by leveraging Machine Learning (ML) techniques to discover decisional criteria, also known as guards, from event logs. While two decades have passed since DM’s introduction, there is still no systematic and comprehensive overview of research in this field. This study presents a systematic literature review of DM, conducted across digital libraries using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, resulting in 30 primary research studies. We examine these articles from multiple perspectives, including investigated problems and proposed solutions, employed algorithms and available implementations, relevant application domains and datasets, and challenges that remain in the literature. Our findings identify four categories of DM research problems being investigated: problems related to event logs, types of decisions, evaluation practices, and model types. Across these categories, incomplete event logs—where key contextual data required to extract guards is missing—were the most prevalent problem. We further identified multiple challenges for the practical adoption of DM in process-aware information systems. The reviewed studies have mainly focused on decision trees, with limited uptake of more advanced ML algorithms or other types of techniques (e.g., local search) that may improve performance. We also found the literature fragmented, as studies rarely build upon earlier work or leverage advancements in the Process Mining field.

AI.tldr: 本文对决策挖掘（Decision Mining）领域进行了系统性文献综述，分析了30篇相关研究，识别出四类研究问题（事件日志、决策类型、评估实践、模型类型），发现不完整事件日志是最普遍的问题，并指出该领域存在文献碎片化、机器学习算法应用有限等挑战。
AI.research_question: 决策挖掘领域的研究现状如何？现有研究关注哪些问题、使用什么方法、存在哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 尽管决策挖掘提出已有20年，但尚缺乏系统性和全面的研究综述，因此需要进行系统性文献综述来梳理该领域的研究进展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流程挖掘（Process Mining）中的流程发现（Process Discovery）与决策挖掘（Decision Mining）相结合，利用机器学习技术从事件日志中发现决策条件（guards）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review），在数字图书馆中按照预定义的纳入和排除标准筛选出30篇主要研究论文，从问题、解决方案、算法、实现、应用领域、数据集和挑战等多个维度进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出四类DM研究问题：事件日志相关、决策类型、评估实践、模型类型；2. 不完整事件日志是最普遍的问题；3. 文献主要聚焦于决策树算法，对更先进的ML算法或其他技术（如局部搜索）应用有限；4. 文献存在碎片化问题，研究之间缺乏继承性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对决策挖掘领域进行系统性文献综述，构建了DM研究问题的分类框架，揭示了该领域的知识空白和研究碎片化现状。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策挖掘的实践应用识别了多重挑战，为流程感知信息系统中决策挖掘的实际采纳提供了指导，指出了未来改进方向（如采用更先进的机器学习算法）。

title: PHOENIX CENTER FOR ADVANCED LEGAL & ECONOMIC PUBLIC POLICY STUDIES
affiliations: Phoenix Center for Advanced Legal & Economic Public Policy Studies and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: PHOENIX CENTER FOR ADVANCED LEGAL & ECONOMIC PUBLIC POLICY STUDIES
detail.abstract: This paper uses new data from the U.S. Census Bureau's Household Pulse Survey (Wave 2506) to examine demographic determinants of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption and uses, fear of AI's career consequences, and active resistance to AI use. Regression analysis on a sample of 7,209 adults finds that AI use rises strongly with education and income and declines with age. In contrast, among those who have adopted AI, the breadth of use is driven primarily by education and age, with income playing little role beyond the adoption decision. Among users, concern about AI's impact on careers is concentrated among more educated and teleworking individuals, with income providing little explanatory power for career concern. Among non-users, sex and race are the dominant predictors of deliberate abstention. These findings have direct implications for AI literacy programs, workforce policy, and the design of consumer AI regulations.

AI.tldr: 利用美国人口普查局家庭脉搏调查数据，研究了AI采用的人口统计学决定因素、对AI职业影响的恐惧以及主动抵制AI使用的行为。
AI.research_question: AI采用、使用广度、职业担忧以及主动抵制的 demographic determinants 是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解不同人口群体在AI采用和使用上的差异，以及这种差异对劳动力市场和政策制定的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口统计学决定因素（教育、收入、年龄、性别、种族）对AI采用与使用的影响。
AI.method: 使用美国人口普查局家庭脉搏调查（Wave 2506）数据，对7,209名成年人进行回归分析。
AI.findings: AI采用随教育和收入增加而增加，随年龄增长而下降；使用广度主要由教育和年龄驱动；职业担忧集中在受教育程度较高和远程工作者中；非用户中，性别和种族是主动放弃使用的主要预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI采用决策与使用广度的不同驱动因素，以及用户与非用户间对AI态度的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI素养计划、劳动力政策和消费者AI监管设计提供了直接启示。

title: Six Decades of Solutions: What Commercial Space Law Teaches AI Governance About Accountability
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Six Decades of Solutions: What Commercial Space Law Teaches AI Governance About Accountability
detail.abstract:
Frontier AI developers operate without mandatory liability, insurance, or enforceable

fiduciary duties — the private law mechanisms that discipline every other high-risk

industry. Current AI governance discourse focuses almost exclusively on ex ante

regulation and voluntary commitments, leaving the question of ex post accountability

structurally unresolved. This paper argues that the missing analytical framework for

designing AI accountability mechanisms already exists in commercial space law: the only

domain where private actors have deployed capabilities with global systemic risk potential

without clear territorial jurisdiction, with externalities affecting populations that had no

representation in governance negotiations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过类比商业航天法，论证前沿AI开发者应像其他高风险行业一样，承担强制性责任、保险和信义义务等私法问责机制，以弥补当前AI治理中事后问责的结构性缺失。
AI.research_question: 如何为前沿AI开发设计有效的事后问责机制？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理过度依赖事前监管和自愿承诺，缺乏强制性私法问责机制，而前沿AI系统具有全球系统性风险潜力，其外部性影响未参与治理谈判的人群。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私法问责理论（强制性责任、保险、信义义务）；商业航天法作为类比框架。
AI.method: 法律比较分析方法，将AI治理困境与商业航天法的法律框架进行结构性类比。
AI.findings: 商业航天法是唯一一个私人行为者部署具有全球系统性风险潜力、缺乏明确属地管辖权、且外部性影响未在治理谈判中有代表人群的领域，其法律框架可为AI问责机制设计提供现成的分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将私法问责机制（而非仅关注事前监管）引入AI治理的理论框架，并通过商业航天法这一新颖类比填补了AI事后问责机制设计的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了设计AI强制性责任、保险制度和信义义务等问责机制的具体法律参照系，推动AI行业向其他高风险行业看齐。

title: Trend and Selection: A Behavioral Framework for Understanding Core Economic Principles -A Car Analogy Approach

detail.title: Trend and Selection: A Behavioral Framework for Understanding Core Economic Principles -A Car Analogy Approach
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel conceptual framework for understanding consumer behavior and macroeconomic fluctuations through the lens of two foundational psychological forces: Trend and Selection. Trend is defined as demand driven by social imitation and conspicuous consumption, while Selection represents demand driven by rational, need-based decisionmaking. Drawing on illustrative economic narratives and analogical reasoning rooted in Indian socioeconomic contexts, the paper argues that the interplay of these two forces constitutes the primary engine of economic movement, influencing interest rate differentiation, supply-demand volatility, price mechanisms, and monetary policy. The framework further introduces the concept of 'Daitya Mohini'-a structural influence dynamic categorically distinct from the contemporary social influencer-as the steering mechanism of economic cycles, and proposes that effective economic policy must manage the combined effect of Trend and Selection to maintain macroeconomic equilibrium. Policy implications are discussed across eight fundamental domains including pricing, monetary supply, investment regulation, taxation, wastage control, trade policy, and currency valuation. The paper presents a structural analysis demonstrating why citizen tax burdens of 2-10% of income are fiscally achievable under nationalized industry models, rising to 10-30% when industries are privatized and public revenue base is correspondingly reduced. Additionally, the paper Trend and Selection: A Behavioral Framework for Core Economics | Page 2 proposes a binding international principle prohibiting currency manipulation for political or competitive purposes, distinguishing permissible product price adjustments from impermissible currency value manipulation. The paper also presents a typology of economic agents (private versus social economists) and an original vehicle analogy for the structure of modern economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于两种基础心理力量——趋势（Trend，社会模仿与炫耀性消费驱动）与选择（Selection，理性需求驱动）——的概念框架来解释消费者行为与宏观经济波动，并引入“Daitya Mohini”作为经济周期调控机制，讨论了货币政策、税收、产业国有化等八大政策领域的影响。
AI.research_question: 趋势（Trend）与选择（Selection）这两种心理力量如何相互作用构成经济运动的主要驱动力，以及如何通过政策管理维持宏观经济均衡？
AI.motivation: 现有经济理论对消费者行为的心理基础解释不足，特别是社会模仿与理性选择在宏观层面的交互作用缺乏系统框架。作者试图从印度社会经济背景出发，构建一个更贴合发展中国家现实的概念模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 趋势（Trend）：社会模仿与炫耀性消费驱动的需求；2. 选择（Selection）：理性、基于实际需求的需求决策；3. Daitya Mohini：与当代社会影响者截然不同的结构性影响动态，作为经济周期的调控机制。
AI.method: 说明性经济叙事（illustrative economic narratives）与基于印度社会经济背景的类比推理（analogical reasoning）。
AI.findings: 1. 趋势与选择的互动是经济运动的主要引擎，影响利率差异化、供需波动、价格机制与货币政策；2. 在国有化产业模式下，公民税负可维持在收入的2-10%，而在私有化模式下则升至10-30%；3. 提出禁止出于政治或竞争目的操纵货币的国际约束原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“趋势-选择”二元心理动力框架，将社会心理学概念引入宏观经济学分析；提出了“Daitya Mohini”这一区别于当代社会影响者的结构性影响概念；区分了私人经济学家与社会经济学家两种经济行为者类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为定价、货币供应、投资监管、税收、浪费控制、贸易政策、货币估值等八大领域提供了政策建议；提出了产业国有化与私有化下税负水平的量化估算；提出了禁止货币操纵的国际原则。

reference: International Review of Management and Marketing, volume 16, issue 4, 2026[10.32479/irmm.23298]
title: Drivers of Carbon Credit Adoption among Low-Cost Airline Passengers in Thailand: APLS-SEM Study of Consumer Attitudes, Perceived Value, and Behavioral Intention
affiliations: , Asia eLearning Management Center, Singapore, Iqra Business School - University Geomatika Malaysia, Iqra Business School - University Geomatika Malaysia and Mahasarakham Business School, Mahasarakham University, Thailand

detail.title: Drivers of Carbon Credit Adoption among Low-Cost Airline Passengers in Thailand: APLS-SEM Study of Consumer Attitudes, Perceived Value, and Behavioral Intention

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Review of Management and Marketing, volume 16, issue 4, 2026[10.32479/irmm.23298]

detail.abstract: This study investigates the key drivers of consumer adoption of carbon credits in the low-cost airline context in Thailand. Drawing on consumer behavior and sustainable marketing perspectives, the study examines how psychological, social, and economic factors shape passengers' attitudes, perceived value, and behavioral intention toward carbon offset programs. A quantitative survey of 500 low-cost airline passengers in Thailand was conducted. Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) was employed to test the proposed model linking environmental awareness, climate change concern, perceived environmental responsibility, trust in carbon credit programs, perceived effectiveness, social norms, and price sensitivity to attitude, perceived value, and behavioral intention. The findings indicate that environmental awareness, climate change concern, perceived environmental responsibility, trust in carbon credit programs, perceived effectiveness, and social norms positively influence consumer attitudes toward carbon credit adoption, while price sensitivity negatively affects attitude formation. Attitude significantly enhances perceived value, and both attitude and perceived value strongly predict consumers' intention to adopt carbon credits when purchasing low-cost airline tickets. This study relies on cross-sectional selfreported data from low-cost airline passengers in Thailand, which may limit causal inference and generalizability to other airline segments or national contexts. The results provide actionable insights for airline managers and marketers. Airlines should integrate carbon offset options into the ticketing process, enhance transparency and trust in carbon credit programs, communicate tangible environmental impacts, and design affordable pricing or bundled offers to increase perceived value among price-sensitive consumers.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于泰国低成本航空情境，调查消费者采用碳信用的关键驱动因素。通过对500名乘客的定量调查和PLS-SEM分析，发现环境意识、气候变化关注、环境责任感、信任、感知有效性、社会规范正向影响态度，价格敏感性负向影响态度，进而影响感知价值和行为意向。
AI.research_question: 在泰国低成本航空背景下，哪些心理、社会和经济因素驱动消费者采用碳信用（碳抵消计划）？这些因素如何影响乘客的态度、感知价值和行为意向？
AI.motivation: 航空业碳排放问题日益突出，碳抵消计划是重要减碳手段，但消费者对碳信用的采纳率仍然较低。现有研究对低成本航空这一特定情境下碳信用采纳驱动因素的关注不足，尤其缺乏对心理、社会和经济因素综合作用的系统考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、可持续营销视角；整合了环境意识、气候变化关注、感知环境责任感、信任、感知有效性、社会规范、价格敏感性等因素，构建了态度→感知价值→行为意向的理论路径模型。
AI.method: 定量问卷调查法（500名泰国低成本航空乘客），采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行假设检验。
AI.findings: （1）环境意识、气候变化关注、感知环境责任感、信任、感知有效性、社会规范正向影响消费者对碳信用的态度；（2）价格敏感性负向影响态度；（3）态度显著增强感知价值；（4）态度与感知价值均显著正向预测消费者购买低成本航空机票时采纳碳信用的行为意向。
AI.theory_contributions: 将碳信用采纳研究拓展至低成本航空情境，构建并验证了整合心理、社会和经济因素的综合理论模型，揭示了态度在碳信用采纳决策中的中介作用以及态度对感知价值的驱动路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空管理者提供可操作建议：将碳抵消选项整合到订票流程、增强碳信用项目的透明度与信任度、传达可量化的环境效益、针对价格敏感群体设计平价定价或捆绑优惠以提升感知价值。

title: A Study on Digital Nomadism and Cognitive-Affective Responses: Impact of Novel Environments on Remote Work Behaviour
affiliations: NSB Academy, Bengaluru, NSB Academy, Bengaluru, NSB Academy, Bengaluru and NSB Academy, Bengaluru

detail.title: A Study on Digital Nomadism and Cognitive-Affective Responses: Impact of Novel Environments on Remote Work Behaviour
detail.abstract: In today's remote work world, digital nomadism is a big trend. People mix work with travel. This study looks at how new places change remote workers' behavior through feelings and thoughts. We use the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-OR) model to see how fresh environments spark emotions and brain load, affecting productivity and interest in work. Methodology: We used a simple quantitative design with secondary data from Kaggle on remote work productivity and worker tiredness. We checked things like stress, fatigue, job happiness, and output using basic stats and correlations. Findings: New spots can excite workers and boost happiness, but they also tire the brain, mixing up productivity. Workers feel more engaged, yet too much strain hurts performance.

AI.tldr: 本文基于S-O-R模型，研究远程工作者的新环境如何通过情绪和认知负荷影响其生产力与工作投入。采用Kaggle二手数据进行定量分析，发现新环境既能激发兴奋感与幸福感，也会增加脑力疲劳，从而对生产力产生混合影响。
AI.research_question: 新的工作场所环境如何通过情绪（情感状态）和认知负荷（大脑负担）影响远程工作者的生产力与工作投入？
AI.motivation: 数字游民趋势日益普及，但新环境对远程工作者行为的影响机制尚不清晰，尤其是情绪与认知负荷在其中的中介作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) 模型：新环境作为刺激（Stimulus），通过情绪和认知负荷（Organism）影响生产力与工作投入（Response）。
AI.method: 定量研究设计，使用Kaggle平台的二手数据（远程工作生产力与员工疲劳数据），采用描述性统计和相关性分析检验压力、疲劳、工作满意度与产出之间的关系。
AI.findings: 新环境能激发工作者的兴奋感和幸福感，提升工作投入；但同时增加脑力疲劳，对生产力产生正向与负向的混合效应。过度认知负担会损害绩效表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将S-O-R模型拓展应用于数字游民与远程工作情境，揭示了情绪和认知负荷在环境-行为关系中的双重中介路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和数字游民提供建议：在追求新环境带来的激励效果时，需注意控制认知负担，避免过度疲劳损害生产力。

title: The Signal is the Ceiling: Measurement Limits of LLM-Predicted Experience Ratings from Open-Ended Survey Text
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: The Signal is the Ceiling: Measurement Limits of LLM-Predicted Experience Ratings from Open-Ended Survey Text

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors are employees of Dimension Labs, a causal intelligence platform that links unstructured customer conversations to business metrics, producing statistical evidence of what drives outcomes. The annotation described in this study was conducted on the Dimension Labs platform, which also provided the computational infrastructure used to execute the annotation pipeline. No external funding was received for this research. The study design, analysis, and interpretation were conducted independently by the authors.

detail.abstract: An earlier paper (Hong, Potteiger, and Zapata 'LLM Predictive Scoring and Validation' 2026) established that an unoptimized GPT 4.1 prompt predicts fan-reported experience ratings within one point 67% of the time from open-ended survey text. This paper tests the relative impact of prompt design and model selection on that performance. We compared four configurations on approximately 10,000 post-game surveys from five MLB teams: the original baseline prompt and a moderately customized version, crossed with three GPT models (4.1, 4.1-mini, 5.2). Prompt customization added roughly two percentage points of within-±1 agreement on GPT 4.1 (from 67% to 69%). Both model swaps from that best configuration degraded performance: GPT 5.2 returned to the baseline, and GPT 4.1-mini fell six percentage points below it. Both levers combined were dwarfed by the input itself: across capable configurations, accuracy varied more than an order of magnitude more by the linguistic character of the text than by the choice of prompt or model. The ceiling has two parts. One is a bias in how the model reads text, which prompt design can correct. The other is a difference between what fans write about and what they actually decide, which no engineering can close because the missing information is not in the text. Prompt customization moved the first part; model selection moved neither reliably. The result is not that "prompt engineering helps a little" but that prompt engineering helps in a specific and predictable way, on the part of the ceiling it can reach.

AI.tldr: 本文测试提示设计和模型选择对LLM预测球迷体验评分的影响。提示定制化能小幅提升准确率（约2个百分点），而模型更换效果不可靠且可能更差。最大的预测瓶颈在于文本本身的信息局限性——球迷写的内容与其真实决策之间的差距无法通过工程手段弥补。
AI.research_question: 在LLM预测粉丝自报体验评分任务中，提示设计（prompt design）与模型选择（model selection）的相对影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 前期研究已证明GPT 4.1能预测评分（±1内67%准确率），但尚不清楚这种表现受提示设计还是模型选择的影响更大，以及预测天花板在哪里。
AI.theoretical_framework: LLM预测性能的分解：提示效应、模型效应、文本固有信息限制（偏差+信息缺口）。
AI.method: 在约10,000份来自5支MLB球队的赛后开放式调查问卷上，比较4种配置：基础提示 vs. 中度定制化提示，交叉3个GPT模型（4.1, 4.1-mini, 5.2）。
AI.findings: (1) 提示定制化在GPT 4.1上提升了约2个百分点（67%→69%）；(2) 模型更换均导致性能下降（5.2退回基线，4.1-mini下降6个百分点）；(3) 文本的语言特征差异对准确率的影响比提示或模型选择高出逾一个数量级；(4) 天花板来自两部分：模型阅读文本的偏差（提示可修正）和粉丝所写与所决之间的信息缺口（无法通过工程弥补）。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了LLM预测性能的两个天花板来源（偏差 vs. 信息缺口），并明确了提示工程仅在偏差部分起可预测的、有限的作用，而非笼统地"有用"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用LLM进行开放式文本评分的从业者提供了指引：投入资源优化提示设计比更换模型更可靠，且应认识到预测存在无法通过工程手段突破的文本信息上限。

title: Breaking the Early Bell: Lessons from the First Statewide Mandate on School Start Times
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh and University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Breaking the Early Bell: Lessons from the First Statewide Mandate on School Start Times
detail.abstract:
We examine the impact of California’s Senate Bill 328 (SB 328), the first statewide mandate requiring later school start times for middle and high schools, on adolescent sleep, mental health, and academic outcomes. Using difference-in-differences and eventstudy designs across five data sources, we find that SB 328 increased the share of students sleeping at least 8 hours per night by 13%, meeting the CDC-recommended minimum for this age group. Average mental health effects are imprecisely estimated, but boys show significant reductions in sadness, hopelessness, and suicidal ideation, and Hispanic students, who experienced the largest sleep-timing shifts, show parallel reductions in difficulty concentrating; together these patterns are consistent with a dose-response relationship between sleep improvement and mental well-being. Math and English scores in grade 8 improved by approximately 0.08–0.10 standard deviations, with the largest gains among Hispanic and economically disadvantaged students. A within-state analysis using teachers’ commute arrival times as a proxy for pre-policy school start times corroborates these findings, and shows academic gains accumulating over 2023–2025 alongside a suggestive decline in high school dropout rates. The absence of effects on chronic absenteeism rules out an attendance-driven mechanism, pointing instead to the direct cognitive benefits of aligning school schedules with adolescents’ biological rhythms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 加州参议院第328号法案（SB 328）要求中学和高中推迟上学时间。研究发现，该法案使达到CDC建议睡眠时长（≥8小时）的学生比例提高了13%，并显著改善了八年级学生的数学和英语成绩（提高0.08-0.10个标准差），尤其对西班牙裔和经济弱势学生效果最为明显。心理健康方面，男生在悲伤、绝望和自杀意念方面有显著改善，西班牙裔学生在集中注意力方面也有改善，呈现剂量-反应关系。
AI.research_question: 加州SB 328法案（全美首个全州性推迟中学上学时间强制令）对青少年睡眠、心理健康和学业成绩产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 青少年普遍面临睡眠不足问题，而生物钟延迟与早期上学时间之间存在矛盾。此前缺乏全州性政策实施的因果证据，SB 328提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物钟理论/昼夜节律理论：青少年青春期生物钟自然延迟，与早期上学时间不匹配导致睡眠剥夺；剂量-反应关系：睡眠改善程度与心理健康改善程度呈正相关。
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）和事件研究法（Event Study），使用五个数据来源；并在州内分析中使用教师通勤到达时间作为政策前学校上课时间的代理变量进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）达到至少8小时睡眠的学生比例提高13%；（2）男生在心理健康指标（悲伤、绝望、自杀意念）上有显著改善，西班牙裔学生在注意力集中困难方面有改善；（3）八年级数学和英语成绩提高0.08-0.10个标准差，西班牙裔和经济弱势学生受益最大；（4）学术收益在2023-2025年持续累积，高中辍学率呈下降趋势；（5）慢性缺勤率无显著变化，排除了出勤率驱动机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为青少年生物钟与上学时间不匹配的"社会时差"理论提供了来自全州性政策的因果证据；验证了睡眠改善与心理健康之间的剂量-反应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为推迟上学时间的政策提供了实证支持，证明了此类政策在改善睡眠、心理健康和学业成绩方面的有效性；特别指出西班牙裔和经济弱势学生受益最大，提示政策具有缩小教育不平等的作用；排除了缺勤率改善作为替代机制，支持了直接认知收益的解释。

title: Cross Cultural Marketing AI Report

detail.title: Cross Cultural Marketing AI Report
detail.abstract: This report examines the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in growth culture marketing, focusing on how AI helps businesses improve customer engagement, personalized advertising, content creation, and marketing strategies. It also highlights the benefits, challenges, and growing impact of AI on modern digital marketing practices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在增长文化营销中的作用，重点分析AI如何帮助企业改善客户参与度、个性化广告、内容创作和营销策略，并强调了AI对现代数字营销实践的益处、挑战及日益增长的影响。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响和推动增长文化营销中的客户参与、个性化广告、内容创作和营销策略？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，数字营销领域正在经历深刻变革，理解AI在增长文化营销中的具体作用和影响对于企业和营销从业者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长文化营销理论、AI驱动的营销自动化理论、个性化推荐理论
AI.method: 该报告为综述性研究，基于文献梳理和案例分析与观察。
AI.findings: AI能够显著提升客户参与度，实现更精准的个性化广告投放，优化内容创作效率，并帮助制定更有效的营销策略；同时也面临着数据隐私、算法偏见和技术成本等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了AI与增长文化营销的交叉领域，为数字营销理论的发展提供了AI视角的整合框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和营销人员提供了AI应用于增长文化营销的实践指南，包括具体应用场景、潜在收益以及需要关注的挑战和风险。

title: Anti-Harassment Policy and the Startup Labor Market
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago,  and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department

detail.title: Anti-Harassment Policy and the Startup Labor Market
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how anti-harassment legal reforms that weaken non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) in cases of workplace sexual harassment affect startups' hiring and organizational decisions. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design and LinkedIn data on over 50,000 U.S. venture-capital-backed startups from 2014–2022, we find that NDA reforms, although intended for employee protection, reduce female hiring by about 8%, with effects concentrated among junior women, who are statistically more prone to sexual harassment, and in small or male-dominated startups. The results apply to both the intensive and extensive margins of female hiring. Treated entrepreneurial firms also witness more departures of male managers, promote more women, and receive less VC funding. These results suggest that while NDA-weakening laws increase firms’ perceived legal risk and reduce female hiring, they also trigger internal restructuring that promotes women's advancement into leadership and may, over time, foster more accountable and inclusive organizational cultures.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究削弱NDA的反性骚扰法律改革如何影响初创企业的招聘与组织决策，发现改革反而减少了约8%的女性招聘，尤其对初级女性和小规模或男性主导的初创企业影响显著，但同时推动了女性晋升和管理层重组。
AI.research_question: 削弱NDA的反性骚扰法律改革如何影响初创企业的女性招聘、管理层构成及融资决策？
AI.motivation: 反骚扰法律改革旨在保护员工，但可能增加企业法律风险感知，进而意外地抑制女性招聘。作者希望探究这一悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律风险与招聘决策理论；组织变革理论；性别歧视与法律经济学。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered DiD），基于2014-2022年美国超过5万家VC支持的初创企业的LinkedIn数据。
AI.findings: NDA削弱改革使女性招聘减少约8%，集中在初级女性和小规模/男性主导的初创企业；同时导致男性管理者离职增加、女性晋升增多、VC融资减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了旨在保护员工的法律改革可能产生非预期的负面劳动力市场后果，丰富了法律风险与性别雇佣关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了反性骚扰法律改革的意外效应的实证证据，提示需要配套措施以减轻对女性招聘的抑制影响。

title: The Pause That Wasn't Hesitation: Validating What Platform Traces Really Mean
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Management

detail.title: The Pause That Wasn't Hesitation: Validating What Platform Traces Really Mean
detail.abstract: Platform traces are abundant, psychologically tempting, and increasingly consequential when embedded in automated interventions. We develop an evidence-to-permission mapping for platform behavioral metadata: before a trace is labeled as a user state or used for treatment, researchers should assign it to the population, construct domain, and use class its evidence warrants. We apply the mapping to three timestamp traces from a leading Chinese ticketing platform. Among 108,924 completed transactions, pre-payment hesitation time (PPHT) initially looks like hesitation, but stronger tests reassign it to account-keyed latency: PPHT-only prediction is near chance, residual PPHT does not predict no-show, account structure explains 72.1% of PPHT variance, and repeated accounts are stable (ICC = 0.464). By contrast, advance-purchase timing behaves as an event-structured planning trace whose no-show association survives saturated fixed effects, while check-in timing is an attendee-arrival operations trace observed only after attendance. The completed-transaction scope is essential: PPHT may still capture hesitation at the unobserved abandonment margin. The paper shows that platform-log validity is not a trace-construct property alone, but a trace-construct-population-use relation governing what researchers and platforms may infer, report, and automate.

title: AlphaGlass: Interpretable Characteristic-Based Portfolio Choice
affiliations: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology - Department of Economics and Management, University of California, Berkeley, University of California - Haas School of Business and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: AlphaGlass: Interpretable Characteristic-Based Portfolio Choice
detail.abstract:
We propose AlphaGlass, an inherently interpretable machine-learning framework for constructing portfolios that directly optimize investment objectives. AlphaGlass maps stock characteristics into additive signals with sparse interactions and converts these signals into long-short portfolios through a differentiable rank-and-mask layer. This end-to-end design allows the model to optimize objectives such as the Sharpe ratio or mean-variance utility while keeping portfolio weights interpretable and traceable to specific characteristics and interactions. We show theoretically that in-sample objective maximization consistently estimates the population objective and that the differentiable rank-and-mask layer is a faithful smooth proxy for the corresponding conventional long-short quantile portfolio. In U.S. equities, AlphaGlass delivers strong out-of-sample performance and reveals economically interpretable drivers of long and short positions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: AlphaGlass是一个内在可解释的机器学习框架，通过可微分的排序-掩码层将股票特征映射为可加性信号并直接优化投资目标（如夏普比率），在保持投资组合权重可解释的同时实现优异表现。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个内在可解释的机器学习框架，使其能够直接优化投资目标（如夏普比率）并生成权重可追溯至具体股票特征的多空投资组合？
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法在构建投资组合时往往缺乏可解释性，投资者难以理解投资组合权重背后的驱动因素。作者希望设计一个端到端可解释的框架，既保持模型性能，又能让每个持仓权重都可追溯到具体的股票特征及其交互关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内在可解释机器学习（Inherently Interpretable ML）、可加性信号模型、可微分排序-掩码层、样本内目标最大化的一致估计理论
AI.method: 提出AlphaGlass框架：（1）将股票特征映射为具有稀疏交互的可加性信号；（2）通过可微分的排序-掩码层将信号转换为多空投资组合；（3）端到端优化投资目标（如夏普比率或均值-方差效用）；（4）理论证明样本内目标最大化可一致估计总体目标，且可微分排序-掩码层是传统多空分位数组合的忠实平滑代理。
AI.findings: 在美国股票市场中，AlphaGlass实现了强劲的样本外表现，并揭示了多头和空头头寸中具有经济解释力的驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明了样本内目标最大化可一致估计总体目标的理论性质；（2）证明了可微分排序-掩码层是传统多空分位数组合的忠实平滑代理。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个内在可解释的投资组合构建框架，投资者能够清晰理解每笔持仓权重来源于哪些特征及交互，为量化投资决策提供了可解释、可信任的工具。

title: Algorithmic Credentialism
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Graduate School of Education and Harvard University

detail.title: Algorithmic Credentialism
detail.abstract:
The paper develops a framework for evaluating credential-coded algorithmic screens under existing civil rights law. AI-powered hiring tools trained on historical data often encode and automate bachelor's degree requirements as a proxy for worker skill, producing what this paper terms algorithmic credentialism. Drawing on labor economics research on workers Skilled Through Alternative Routes (STARs), disability theory's critique of the medical model, and disparate-impact doctrine from Griggs v. Duke Power Co. through the Civil Rights Act of 1991, it argues that such screens misidentify the source of hiring exclusion, locating it in the worker rather than in the design of the selection system. This institutional-design problem is amenable to evaluation under the existing disparate-impact doctrine. Under the paper's proposed framework, a credential-coded screen producing disparate impact triggers a legal obligation to validate the screen as job-related and consistent with business necessity, with skills-based hiring supplying the less-discriminatory alternative. The paper further argues that the efficiency rationale historically offered for degree screens is weakened, not strengthened, by AI. The same computational power that automates credentialism at scale can instead match applicants to jobs on multidimensional skill profiles, making the bachelor's degree a less necessary (and less legally defensible) proxy than it was in the pre-AI labor market.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个法律评估框架，论证AI驱动的基于学历的算法筛选（算法学历主义）在民权法下可被认定为歧视，并提出基于技能的替代方案更具合法性与效率。
AI.research_question: 在现有民权法框架下，如何评估AI驱动的学历编码算法筛选工具的合法性与公平性？
AI.motivation: AI招聘工具将本科学历要求编码为技能代理，导致对"非传统途径技能型人才"（STARs）的系统性排斥，需从法律与制度设计角度解决这一新兴歧视问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学（STARs研究）、残疾理论（对医学模型的批判）、民权法中"差异性影响"原则（从Griggs案到1991年民权法案）。
AI.method: 法律与跨学科理论分析，构建规范性评估框架。
AI.findings: 1）学历编码算法筛选属于制度设计问题而非工人素质问题；2）该筛选可依据差异性影响原则进行法律评估；3）AI并未强化学历筛选的效率合理性，反而降低了其必要性；4）基于多维度技能画像的匹配是更合法且更有效的替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"算法学历主义"概念；将残疾理论的制度设计批判引入AI招聘法律分析；挑战了AI强化学历筛选效率的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者提供评估算法招聘歧视的可操作框架；为企业推动从学历筛选到技能本位的招聘转型提供法律依据与商业理由。

title: Deep Research on a Loop: Using AI Agents to Construct Economic Datasets
affiliations: University of Buenos Aires (UBA) - Faculty of Economic Science, Students, Department of Economics,  and University of San Andres (UdeSA)

detail.title: Deep Research on a Loop: Using AI Agents to Construct Economic Datasets
detail.abstract:
Constructing datasets from primary sources is one of the costliest tasks in empirical economics. We propose Deep Research on a Loop (DRIL), a methodology that uses AI agents to assemble datasets from publicly available sources. DRIL applies a fixed research instrument across a mapped unit space (e.g., countries by years), with a two-stage architecture separating design from implementation. The instrument specifies variables and coding rules, an evidence policy governs sources and citations, and data quality mechanisms track gaps and uncertainty explicitly. We exercise DRIL on a 2025 update of the Global Tax Expenditures Database for eight Latin American and Caribbean countries. The run produces 129 sources and 136 evidence records, covering 22 qualitative fields fully and 6 quantitative estimate types with documented gaps, at the cost of a standard LLM subscription comparable to a few hours of research-assistant work. We argue that even partial automation of dataset construction can shift the production function of empirical economics.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRIL方法，利用AI代理从公开来源自动构建数据集，以大幅降低实证经济学中数据构建的成本。通过拉美八国税收支出数据库的案例验证，该方法能以低成本（相当于几小时研究助理工作）覆盖大量字段，并明确记录数据缺口与不确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI代理自动化构建经济学研究所需的数据集，以降低数据构建的高昂成本？
AI.motivation: 从一手来源构建数据集是实证经济学中成本最高的任务之一，亟需一种自动化方法来提升效率、降低成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: DRIL方法采用两级架构（设计与实施分离）、固定研究工具跨单元空间映射、证据政策规范来源与引用、以及数据质量机制显式追踪缺口与不确定性。
AI.method: 提出DRIL流程：固定研究工具 → 映射单元空间（如国家×年份）→ 两阶段架构（设计阶段制定变量与编码规则；实施阶段由AI代理执行）。通过2025年全球税收支出数据库更新案例（覆盖8个拉美和加勒比国家）进行实证验证。
AI.findings: DRIL运行产生了129个来源和136条证据记录，完全覆盖22个定性字段，6个定量估计类型均有记录（含缺口标注），成本仅为标准LLM订阅费用，相当于几小时研究助理工作量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出数据构建自动化的方法论框架，论证即使部分自动化也能改变实证经济学的生产函数，为AI在经济学研究中的应用提供理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证经济学提供低成本、可复制的数据集构建方案；通过显式追踪数据缺口与不确定性，提升了数据质量的可信度与透明度；显著降低研究人员的时间和资金成本。

title: Mortality Rates by Race and Ethnicity Among People with Disabilities
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), University of California, Berkeley and Hunter College, CUNY

detail.title: Mortality Rates by Race and Ethnicity Among People with Disabilities
detail.abstract:
This paper uses Medicaid claims data from 2017-2021 to measure racial/ethnic disparities in mid-life mortality among low-income adults with disabilities receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI). We find that American Indian and Alaska Native and White SSI recipients have the highest age-adjusted mid-life mortality rates (2.9% and 2.6%, respectively), followed by Black and Hispanic recipients (2.3% and 1.9%), and then Asian recipients (1.6%). We also find differences in diagnosed chronic conditions, "despair-related" conditions, substance use disorders, and disabling conditions by race/ethnicity. Controlling for these differences attenuates the White-Hispanic, White-Asian, and AIAN-White mortality gaps; however, differences in clinical diagnoses by race do not affect the White-Black mortality gap. Our results show that within a socioeconomically vulnerable population, Black adults outlive Whites.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2017-2021年Medicaid索赔数据，测量了领取补充保障收入（SSI）的低收入残疾成年人中，不同种族/族裔在中年死亡率上的差异。研究发现，美国印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民和白人SSI受助者的年龄调整中年死亡率最高（分别为2.9%和2.6%），其次是黑人和西班牙裔（2.3%和1.9%），亚裔最低（1.6%）。控制慢性病、绝望相关疾病、物质使用障碍等诊断差异后，白人-西班牙裔、白人-亚裔、原住民-白人之间的死亡率差距缩小，但临床诊断差异并未影响白人-黑人死亡率差距。结果表明，在同一社会经济弱势群体中，黑人成年人的寿命长于白人。
AI.research_question: 在领取补充保障收入（SSI）的低收入残疾成年人中，不同种族/族裔在中年死亡率方面存在哪些差异？以及这些差异在多大程度上可归因于慢性疾病、绝望相关疾病、物质使用障碍和致残性疾病等诊断条件的差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量文献关注种族/族裔死亡率差异，但很少有研究聚焦于社会经济弱势群体内部（如低收入残疾人群）的种族健康差异。本文旨在考察在同等社会经济弱势条件下，种族/族裔间的中年死亡率差异及其潜在解释机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康不平等的社会决定因素理论、少数族裔健康悖论（Minority Health Paradox）以及绝望死亡（Deaths of Despair）相关理论。
AI.method: 利用2017-2021年Medicaid索赔数据，使用年龄调整死亡率计算方法，并通过控制慢性病、绝望相关疾病、物质使用障碍和致残性疾病等诊断变量，分析种族/族裔中年死亡率差异的变化。
AI.findings: （1）美国印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民（2.9%）和白人（2.6%）SSI受助者年龄调整中年死亡率最高，黑人（2.3%）和西班牙裔（1.9%）居中，亚裔（1.6%）最低；（2）不同种族/族裔在慢性病、绝望相关条件、物质使用障碍和致残性疾病方面存在差异；（3）控制诊断差异后，白人-西班牙裔、白人-亚裔、原住民-白人的死亡率差距缩小，但白人-黑人死亡率差距未受影响；（4）在同一社会经济弱势群体中，黑人成年人的寿命长于白人。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统种族健康梯度假设，揭示了在高度社会经济弱势群体中，传统的种族死亡率排序（白人优于黑人）发生逆转，为少数族裔健康悖论提供了新的经验证据。同时表明临床诊断差异对部分种族间死亡率差距有解释力，但对白-黑差距缺乏解释力，提示需要探索其他机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对SSI受助人群的精准健康干预提供依据：需重点关注美国印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民和白人SSI受助者的高死亡率问题，同时认识到黑人SSI受助者的相对生存优势，避免基于普适种族刻板印象制定政策，应针对不同种族群体的具体疾病负担采取差异化干预策略。
